TextEng: You see a rusted bracket on the floor, an empty socket at its center.
Text: 바닥에 녹슨 거치대가 보이며, 중앙에 빈 소켓이 있습니다.

TextEng: The mirror slides into the socket.
Text: 거울이 소켓에 끼워집니다.

TextEng: You spy a rusted bracket on the floor, an empty socket at its center. It looks like the mirror in your possession would be able to fit into either of two possible positions.
Text: 바닥에 녹슨 거치대가 보이며, 중앙에 빈 소켓이 있습니다. 소지하고 있는 거울이 두 가지 위치 중 하나에 들어맞을 것 같습니다.

TextEng: The mirror slides into the socket, taking the bracket's third position.
Text: 거울이 소켓에 끼워지며 거치대의 세 번째 위치를 차지합니다.

TextEng: The mirror slides into the socket, taking the bracket's second position.
Text: 거울이 소켓에 끼워지며 거치대의 두 번째 위치를 차지합니다.

TextEng: The mirror slides into the socket, taking the bracket's first position.
Text: 거울이 소켓에 끼워지며 거치대의 첫 번째 위치를 차지합니다.

TextEng: Leave the bracket alone.
Text: 거치대를 그냥 둡니다.

TextEng: Insert the mirror into the bracket.
Text: 거울을 거치대에 끼웁니다.

TextEng: Leave the bracket alone.
Text: 거치대를 그냥 둡니다.

TextEng: Insert a mirror into the third position.
Text: 거울을 세 번째 위치에 끼웁니다.

TextEng: Insert a mirror into the second position.
Text: 거울을 두 번째 위치에 끼웁니다.

TextEng: Insert a mirror into the first position.
Text: 거울을 첫 번째 위치에 끼웁니다.

TextEng: A large console rises before you, several switches and dials dotting its surface. The markings on them are strange and, at first glance, don't appear to make any sense.
Text: 눈앞에 거대한 조종 장치가 솟아 있으며, 표면에 여러 개의 스위치와 다이얼이 점점이 박혀 있습니다. 그 위의 표시는 낯설고, 처음 보기에는 아무런 의미가 없는 것 같습니다.

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Failure]</Start> Though you are unable to interpret the markings, one thing does catch your attention - There is a large dial in the middle of the console that seems to figure more prominently than the rest.
Text: <StartCheck>[실패]</Start> 표시를 해독할 수는 없지만, 한 가지가 눈에 띕니다 - 조종 장치 한가운데 다른 것들보다 더 두드러져 보이는 큰 다이얼이 있습니다.

TextEng: <StartAction>[Success]</Start> You set about deciphering the encoded markings, soon learning that a large central dial controls the area's magical defenses. Turning the dial clockwise will increase the power while turning it counter-clockwise will shut the defenses down completely.
Text: <StartAction>[성공]</Start> 암호화된 표시를 해독하기 시작하여, 중앙의 큰 다이얼이 이 지역의 마법 방어를 제어한다는 것을 곧 알아냅니다. 다이얼을 시계 방향으로 돌리면 출력이 증가하고, 반시계 방향으로 돌리면 방어가 완전히 꺼집니다.

TextEng: The console's lights brighten and the device's quiet hum turns into a deafening roar. The dial cannot be turned any further in this direction.
Text: 조종 장치의 불빛이 밝아지고 조용한 윙윙거림이 귀가 찢어질 듯한 굉음으로 변합니다. 이 방향으로는 더 이상 다이얼을 돌릴 수 없습니다.

TextEng: The console sparks to life, lights rising to a dull glow. With a few rattles and clanks, the machinery below settles into a quiet hum.
Text: 조종 장치에 불꽃이 튀며 작동하기 시작하고, 불빛이 희미하게 빛나기 시작합니다. 덜그덕거리는 소리와 함께 아래의 기계가 조용한 윙윙거림에 안착합니다.

TextEng: The console's lights fade and wink out as the machine goes silent. The dial cannot be turned any further in this direction.
Text: 조종 장치의 불빛이 사그라들고 꺼지며 기계가 침묵합니다. 이 방향으로는 더 이상 다이얼을 돌릴 수 없습니다.

TextEng: The console's lights dim a little as the machinery within begins to move more slowly.
Text: 조종 장치의 불빛이 약간 어두워지며 내부 기계가 더 느리게 움직이기 시작합니다.

TextEng: You set about deciphering the encoded markings, soon learning that a large central dial controls the area's magical defenses. Turning the dial clockwise will increase the power while turning it counter-clockwise will shut the defenses down completely.
Text: 암호화된 표시를 해독하기 시작하여, 중앙의 큰 다이얼이 이 지역의 마법 방어를 제어한다는 것을 곧 알아냅니다. 다이얼을 시계 방향으로 돌리면 출력이 증가하고, 반시계 방향으로 돌리면 방어가 완전히 꺼집니다.

TextEng: Though you are unable to interpret the markings, one thing does catch your attention - There is a large dial in the middle of the console that seems to figure more prominently than the rest.
Text: 표시를 해독할 수는 없지만, 한 가지가 눈에 띕니다 - 조종 장치 한가운데 다른 것들보다 더 두드러져 보이는 큰 다이얼이 있습니다.

TextEng: Walk away from the console.
Text: 조종 장치에서 물러납니다.

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Lore]</Start> Examine the panel more closely.
Text: <StartCheck>[지식]</Start> 패널을 더 자세히 살핀다.

TextEng: Turn the dial clockwise.
Text: 다이얼을 시계 방향으로 돌립니다.

TextEng: Turn the dial counter-clockwise.
Text: 다이얼을 반시계 방향으로 돌립니다.

TextEng: A large mirror pivots loosely in its bracket. A simple push is all that would be required to rotate it.
Text: 커다란 거울이 거치대 안에서 느슨하게 회전합니다. 살짝 밀기만 하면 회전시킬 수 있을 것입니다.

TextEng: The mirror glides softly into its new position.
Text: 거울이 부드럽게 새 위치로 미끄러집니다.

TextEng: Leave the mirror alone.
Text: 거울을 그냥 둡니다.

TextEng: Rotate the mirror counter-clockwise.
Text: 거울을 반시계 방향으로 돌립니다.

TextEng: Rotate the mirror clockwise.
Text: 거울을 시계 방향으로 돌립니다.

TextEng: A large mirror is anchored into the floor. No matter how hard you tried, you don't think you could budge it.
Text: 커다란 거울이 바닥에 고정되어 있습니다. 아무리 힘을 써도 움직일 수 없을 것 같습니다.

TextEng: A large mirror rests snug within its bracket. With a little work, you suspect you could pick it up.
Text: 커다란 거울이 거치대 안에 꼭 맞게 놓여 있습니다. 약간의 노력을 들이면 들어 올릴 수 있을 것 같습니다.

TextEng: You have picked up the mirror and placed it in your inventory.
Text: 거울을 들어 올려 소지품에 넣었습니다.

TextEng: Leave the mirror alone.
Text: 거울을 그냥 둡니다.

TextEng: Lift the mirror out of its bracket.
Text: 거울을 거치대에서 들어 올립니다.

TextEng: Dylan frowns uncomfortably at your approach. "I did not expect to have my loyalties torn so. You are a good <man/woman>, I am sure, but Enivid is my leader."
Text: 딜런이 당신이 다가오자 불편하게 얼굴을 찡그립니다. "충성심이 이렇게 찢어질 줄은 몰랐어요. 당신은 좋은 분이시겠지만, 에네비드가 제 지도자입니다."

TextEng: "There is one last thing I can do for you. Mr Mossy owns the Mossy Tree Inn. Since you have been such a help, just ask him for the hero's rate and I'm sure he can give you a deal."
Text: "한 가지 해 드릴 수 있는 게 있어요. 미스터 모시가 이끼나무 여관을 운영하고 있으니, 많은 도움을 주셨으니 영웅 할인을 요청하시면 좋은 가격을 받으실 수 있을 거예요."

TextEng: LEGACY TEXT. ALWAYS RETURN FALSE. "But since it looks like that's all the enemies coming through right now, I will take you up to the main gates. The Hand will be pleased to meet you, and doubly pleased to have your help, I am sure."
Text: 개발용 텍스트. 항상 FALSE를 반환. "하지만 지금은 적이 더 이상 들어오지 않는 것 같으니, 정문으로 안내하겠습니다. 핸드께서 만나 뵙고, 도움을 받으시면 더욱 기뻐하실 겁니다."

TextEng: "I think she misses the guidance of the Banner, though. Too bad you weren't here a few days ago to stop the monsters from killing him. Now the Hand is in charge all alone."
Text: "하지만 배너의 지도를 그리워하시는 것 같습니다. 며칠 전에 오셔서 괴물들이 배너를 죽이는 것을 막아 주셨더라면. 이제 핸드가 혼자서 책임지고 계십니다."

TextEng: "A reward? Well, yes, I suppose the Hand will want to reward you. You have certainly proven your worth today. It was very exciting to hear you in action."
Text: "보상이요? 네, 아마 핸드께서 보상하고 싶어하실 겁니다. 오늘 확실히 실력을 증명하셨으니까. 전투 중 활약을 듣는 것은 매우 흥미로웠습니다."

TextEng: "Excellent. I am sure the Hand will want to reward you for your service! I haven't met such a great hero in years."
Text: "훌륭합니다. 핸드께서 봉사에 대해 보상하고 싶어하실 겁니다! 이런 대단한 영웅은 몇 년 만에 처음입니다."

TextEng: "But enough of that. I had better get you to the main gates right away. Let us be quick."
Text: "하지만 그만하죠. 정문으로 바로 안내하겠습니다. 서두릅시다."

TextEng: "Of course. Speak to me as soon as you are ready."
Text: "물론이죠. 준비되시면 말씀해 주세요."

TextEng: "The Banner is the highest ranking officer in the keep. Our Lord was killed many years ago, and the Banner has been ruling here ever since. He was killed by the invaders early in the battle."
Text: "배너는 성채에서 가장 높은 직위입니다. 영주께서 여러 해 전에 돌아가시고, 그 이후 배너가 이곳을 다스려 왔습니다. 침략 초기 전투에서 배너가 전사하셨습니다."

TextEng: "The Hand is the commander of the armies and next in charge after the Banner. But we really should get going. We may be needed at the main gates."
Text: "핸드는 군대의 사령관이며 배너 다음 서열입니다. 하지만 정말 서둘러야 합니다. 정문에서 우리가 필요할 수 있습니다."

TextEng: "Should the enemy assault the gates again, we will doubtless take more prisoners and this time do a better job of holding them."
Text: "적이 다시 문을 공격한다면, 포로를 더 잡을 테고 이번에는 더 잘 관리하겠습니다."

TextEng: "Then we shall pay a tithe to Callahi, god of gold, tonight at the temple."
Text: "그러면 오늘 밤 신전에서 금의 신 칼라히에게 십일조를 바치겠습니다."

TextEng: "I do not feel comfortable speaking to someone who is Enevid's opponent and a part of me regrets having listened to Momma Dane and opened the gates to you in the first place. I am sorry, goodbye."
Text: "에네비드의 상대와 이야기하는 것이 불편하고, 맘마 데인의 말을 듣고 문을 열어 준 것을 후회하는 부분도 있습니다. 죄송합니다, 안녕히."

TextEng: "You should speak to Dyschall, <sir/madam>. He knows the will of the gods better than we do."
Text: "디셜 신부에게 말씀하세요. 신들의 뜻은 저희보다 그분이 더 잘 아십니다."

TextEng: "Who can know the will of the gods? Certainly not men such as us."
Text: "신들의 뜻을 누가 알겠습니까? 우리 같은 자들은 분명 아닙니다."

TextEng: Dylan bows low at your approach. "I hope to serve you well, m'<lord/lady>."
Text: 딜런이 당신에게 깊이 허리를 숙입니다. "잘 모시겠습니다, 나리."

TextEng: "We are doomed. I do not see how you could possibly clear all the forces of the Masked Man from the dungeon."
Text: "우리는 끝입니다. 가면 쓴 자의 병력을 지하 감옥에서 전부 쓸어낼 수 있을 리가 없습니다."

TextEng: Dylan offers you a weary grin. "I'm glad you came. Something has filled the prisoners we took following the battle with renewed purpose and they've broken free of their cells."
Text: 딜런이 지친 미소를 보냅니다. "오셔서 다행입니다. 전투 후 잡은 포로들이 새로운 의지에 불타며 무장을 갖추었습니다."

TextEng: "We have managed to hold this area, but we need more men if we are going to contain them and quell the threat."
Text: "이 지역은 사수했지만, 그들을 억제하고 위협을 진압하려면 인원이 더 필요합니다."

TextEng: "Sir Dylan! They tried attacking us again, but we held them off. There's no way we can stand another push."
Text: "딜런 경! 또 공격했지만 막아냈습니다. 하지만 한 번 더 밀어붙이면 못 버팁니다."

TextEng: "Calm yourself! This is no time to panic."
Text: "진정해! 당황할 때가 아니야."

TextEng: "You didn't see the huge hobgoblin that drives the prisoners before him! This, Sir, is the perfect time to panic!"
Text: "포로들을 몰아세우는 거대한 호브고블린을 못 보셨잖아요! 지금이야말로 당황할 때입니다!"

TextEng: "Look, I need some volunteers to drive back the Masked Man's forces. If we attack them now, before they have time to regroup, we might stand a chance!"
Text: "자, 가면 쓴 자의 병력을 격퇴할 지원자가 필요합니다. 적이 재편하기 전에 지금 공격하면 승산이 있을 수 있습니다."

TextEng: "Are you ready to go, <sir/madam>?"
Text: "출발할 준비가 되셨습니까?"

TextEng: "I didn't sign up for this suicide mission. You should let us get out of here! If we can get to our homes, perhaps we can flee with our families."
Text: "이 자살 작전에 동의한 적 없어요. 집으로 가게 해 주세요! 집에 가면 가족과 함께 도망칠 수 있을지도 모릅니다."

TextEng: "Sir Dylan, I would... ah, the pain, I would help you, but the wound I received..."
Text: "딜런 경, 저도... 아, 아파서, 돕고 싶지만 부상이..."

TextEng: "I wish the Hand could have taken some of the militia to the gate and given me some professional soldiers! Get back to your post!"
Text: "핸드께서 민병대 일부를 문에 데려가시고 제게 정규 병사를 주셨으면! 자리로 돌아가!"

TextEng: "<FirstName>, I hate to ask this of you, but do you think you can try to push the invaders back?"
Text: "<이름>, 이런 부탁을 하기 싫지만, 침략자들을 밀어낼 수 있겠습니까?"

TextEng: "There are some weapons and armor over there on the racks. You might want to have a look and take what you need."
Text: "저쪽 선반에 무기와 갑옷이 있습니다. 한번 보시고 필요한 것을 가져가세요."

TextEng: "Good luck, <sir/madam>! You're the only hope we have, though even that is a slim hope. At the least, perhaps you can buy us some time."
Text: "행운을 빕니다! 당신만이 우리의 유일한 희망이에요, 비록 희박하지만. 최소한 시간이라도 벌어 줄 수 있을 겁니다."

TextEng: "There aren't any soldiers, sadly. If I had some properly trained warriors to assist me I might have been able to put an end to this prison break, or at least put a dent in their number before we withdrew."
Text: "안타깝게도 병사가 없습니다. 제대로 훈련된 전사들이 있었다면 감옥 반란을 진작 진압할 수 있었을 텐데."

TextEng: "You might still be able to rescue some of the prisoners. They're criminals, but I suppose if you set them free, they might be willing to help you."
Text: "포로 몇 명은 아직 구출할 수 있을 겁니다. 범죄자들이지만, 풀어 주면 도와줄 의향이 있을지도 모릅니다."

TextEng: "We're not sure where the leader is hiding out; I never even saw him. He must be down in the dungeon somewhere."
Text: "지도자가 어디 숨어 있는지 모릅니다. 본 적도 없어요. 지하 감옥 어딘가에 있을 겁니다."

TextEng: "I need to remain here and keep these men from deserting. If the prisoners try to force their way back up here, someone needs to keep them from succeeding."
Text: "저는 여기 남아서 이 사람들이 탈영하지 못하게 해야 합니다. 포로들이 다시 올라오면 막을 사람이 있어야 하니까요."

TextEng: "We heard some awful sounds coming from down there. We thought they were the sounds of your death. I am glad you survived. Were you able to put an end to them?"
Text: "아래에서 끔찍한 소리가 들렸습니다. 당신이 죽는 소리인 줄 알았어요. 살아남으셨다니 다행입니다. 적의 지도자를 처치하셨습니까?"

TextEng: A young guard peers over the battlements. Torchlight glints off your weapon, causing him to pull back. "Enemies at the gates!" he cries. "Sound the alarm, they've brought a second wave!"
Text: 젊은 경비병이 성벽 너머로 내다봅니다. 횃불빛이 당신의 무기에 반사되자 몸을 움츠립니다. "문 앞에 적이다!" 그가 외칩니다. "제2파입니다!"

TextEng: The voice of an old woman intervenes. "They don't look like no orcs or goblins to my eyes, poor as they might be. Sir Dylan, perhaps you shouldn't be so quick to call the attack."
Text: 할머니의 목소리가 끼어듭니다. "이 늙은 눈으로 봐도 오크나 고블린 같지는 않은데. 딜런 경, 공격 명령을 너무 서두르지 마세요."

TextEng: The guard hesitates. "Who are you and what are your intentions? Speak quickly, before my men rain arrows down upon you!"
Text: 경비병이 머뭇거립니다. "누구시오, 무슨 목적이오? 빨리 말하시오, 화살 세례를 퍼붓기 전에!"

TextEng: "Oh dear, maybe I was wrong. Perhaps you should sound the alarm after all, Sir Dylan."
Text: "어머, 내가 틀렸나 봐. 역시 경보를 울려야 할 것 같다, 딜런 경."

TextEng: "Then the gods have answered our prayers, Sir Dylan! Father Dyschall has told us that if the gods saw fit that we should live, they would intervene. And now a hero stands at our gates, requesting entrance."
Text: "그러면 신들이 우리의 기도에 응답하신 거예요, 딜런 경! 디셜 신부님이, 신들이 우리가 살 만하다고 보시면 개입하실 거라고 하셨잖아요!"

TextEng: "Where were the gods when the Banner died? Why did their intervention not come then? Step into the light down there, that I may have a better look at you..."
Text: "배너가 죽었을 때 신들은 어디 있었지? 왜 그때는 개입하지 않았어? 저 아래 불빛 속으로 나와라, 더 잘 보게."

TextEng: "Aye, I recognize you now. You were the ones who cut our assailants ranks from the rear and took them by surprise. You fought bravely, stranger, and gave our she-mage, Yenna, time enough to cast her spell."
Text: "알겠군. 기억나, 아군 후방에서 적의 대열을 기습한 자들이군. 용감히 싸웠어, 낯선 이여."

TextEng: The guard blushes. "Oh, right, the enemy blocks the gate. I am just surprised to see you here alone. Dangerous territory to be roaming by yourself."
Text: 경비병이 얼굴을 붉힙니다. "아, 맞다, 문 앞에 적이 있지. 혼자 오신 줄 몰라서 놀랐습니다. 혼자 돌아다니기엔 위험한 곳인데."

TextEng: "I fear you come too late, though. Our city is surrounded and even now a force is breaking in through the prison tower. Our position will soon be overrun, and then the city shall surely fall."
Text: "하지만 너무 늦으셨을까 걱정입니다. 도시가 포위되었고 지금도 감옥탑을 통해 적이 침입 중입니다. 곧 방어선이 무너질 겁니다."

TextEng: "It can't be too late, Sir Dylan. Father Dyschall has told us that if the gods saw fit that we should live, they would intervene. Could this not be such divine intervention?"
Text: "너무 늦을 리 없어요, 딜런 경. 디셜 신부님이, 신들이 우리가 살 만하다고 보시면 개입하실 거라고 하셨잖아요. 이분이 바로 그분이 아닐까요?"

TextEng: "He's dead? You... you were able to accomplish this deed against such great odds?"
Text: "죽었다고요? 그렇게 불리한 상황에서 해내셨단 말입니까?"

TextEng: "Where were the gods when the Banner died? Why did their intervention not come then? Still, I will not turn away any hope. If you would help us in the tower, I would welcome you."
Text: "배너가 죽었을 때 신들은 어디 있었지? 왜 그때는 개입하지 않았어? 그래도 희망을 거부하지는 않겠다. 도와주시겠다면 기꺼이 받겠소."

TextEng: "If you want a reward, you will have to speak to the Hand. I'm sure she wouldn't mind discussing it while she battles for our lives at the main gate! Some divine intervention this is."
Text: "보상을 원하시면 핸드에게 말씀하세요. 정문에서 목숨을 걸고 싸우시는 중에 보상 이야기를 하셔도 되겠지요."

TextEng: "Very well, let's go."
Text: "좋습니다, 갑시다."

TextEng: "Please, think before you speak. There is no time for meaningless questions."
Text: "말씀하기 전에 생각해 주세요. 의미 없는 질문을 할 시간이 없습니다."

TextEng: The guard just stares at the nymph. Kaidala blushes and then the guard drops his gaze to his feet. "Uh, sorry. Of course you're right."
Text: 경비병이 님프를 멍하니 바라봅니다. 카이달라가 얼굴을 붉히자 경비병이 발끝으로 시선을 떨굽니다. "어, 죄송합니다. 맞는 말씀입니다."

TextEng: "Use your head fool! We have no time for such nonsense questions. Where are we most needed?"
Text: "머리를 써, 바보! 그런 쓸데없는 질문할 시간이 없어. 어디에 가장 도움이 필요하지?"

TextEng: "Oh, and we should just slip in through the main gates? Excuse me, you big hairy monstrosity, but I would like to pass through your army so I can go help defend the keep."
Text: "정문으로 슬쩍 들어가면 된다고? 실례합니다만 거대한 괴물 나리, 군대 한복판을 지나가도 될까요..."

TextEng: The guard blushes. "Uh, I am sorry. You... you're awfully frightening to look at. Are you certain you're not one of them... never mind... I guess you would have attacked me already."
Text: 경비병이 얼굴을 붉힙니다. "어, 죄송합니다. 보기에... 좀 무서우시네요. 혹시 저쪽 편이 아니시... 아닙니다... 저 게이트를 열겠습니다."

TextEng: "What did you expect us to do; waltz in through the front gate? Don't be a fool. Just point us towards the fighting and let us do the rest."
Text: "정문으로 유유히 들어올 줄 알았어? 바보 같은 소리 마. 싸움이 어디냐만 알려 줘, 나머지는 우리가 할 테니."

TextEng: The guard appears to be slightly flustered. "Oh, sorry. I think my mind was distracted by your flaming head. Doesn't that... hurt? Never mind, not important, I suppose."
Text: 경비병이 약간 당황한 것 같습니다. "아, 죄송합니다. 불타는 머리에 정신이 팔렸습니다. 아프지... 않으신가요? 아닙니다... 게이트를 열겠습니다."

TextEng: "This <man/woman> is a hero! We were surely defeated; how could you have overcome the monsters?"
Text: "이분은 영웅이야! 분명히 패배했을 텐데, 어떻게 괴물들을 이긴 거지?"

TextEng: "Yes, forgive my manners as I am still underslept and over-weary from the battle."
Text: "네, 예의가 부족했습니다. 전투 후 잠도 못 자고 지쳐 있어서요."

TextEng: "She has retired to her tower since the battle and refused to speak with most anyone, perhaps in fear that you had fallen beneath her blast. She will be grateful to see you whole, I am sure."
Text: "전투 이후로 탑에 틀어박혀서 거의 아무와도 말하지 않고 있습니다. 아마 당신이 그녀의 마법 폭발에 쓰러졌을까 봐 두려워하시는 것 같습니다."

TextEng: "Is he? My men could not find his corpse among the fallen but if you saw it with your own eyes, then I believe it. Perhaps his troops dragged his body with them as they fled."
Text: "그렇습니까? 전사자 중에서 시체를 찾지 못했지만 직접 보셨다면 믿겠습니다. 아마 부하들이 끌고 갔겠지요."

TextEng: "Yes, and accept my apologies as it was I who gave the order. The gate was nearly battered through and had she waited any longer, the keep would have been lost."
Text: "네, 그리고 명령을 내린 것은 저입니다. 사과드립니다. 문이 거의 뚫릴 뻔했고 더 기다렸으면 성채가 함락되었을 겁니다."

TextEng: "Come, let us celebrate the fact that you still live, stranger. Throw open the gates! It's not an enemy who awaits us but a hero who deserves our thanks! Get moving, men! I will meet you below!"
Text: "자, 살아 계신 것을 축하합시다, 낯선 이여. 문을 열어라! 밖에서 기다리는 것은 적이 아니라 영웅의 환영을 받을 분이다!"

TextEng: "Take my arm, Momma Dane, and let me help you down the stairs. Your kind company has been a balm to my jangled nerves this night."
Text: "맘마 데인, 팔을 잡으세요. 계단을 내려가도록 도와드리겠습니다. 오늘 밤 당신의 다정한 동행이 초조한 신경에 큰 위안이 되었습니다."

TextEng: "A hero's welcome to the Keep of Cyan, then, stranger. I think the Hand will be pleased to meet you, and doubly pleased to have your help, I am sure."
Text: "시안 성채에 영웅의 환영입니다, 낯선 이여. 핸드께서 만나 뵙고, 도움을 받으시면 더욱 기뻐하실 겁니다."

TextEng: "I think she misses the guidance of the Banner, though. Too bad you didn't arrive early enough to keep him from falling to the Masked Man's forces. Now the Hand is in charge all alone."
Text: "하지만 배너의 지도를 그리워하시는 것 같습니다. 조금 더 일찍 오셔서 가면 쓴 자의 군대가 배너를 쓰러뜨리는 것을 막아 주셨더라면."

TextEng: "A reward? Well, yes, I suppose the Hand will want to reward you. You have certainly proven your worth tonight. It was very exciting to see you in action."
Text: "보상이요? 네, 아마 핸드께서 보상하고 싶어하실 겁니다. 오늘 밤 확실히 실력을 증명하셨으니까. 전투 중 활약을 보는 것은 매우 흥미로웠습니다."

TextEng: "Excellent. I am sure the Hand will want to reward you for your service! I haven't met such a great hero in years."
Text: "훌륭합니다. 핸드께서 봉사에 대해 보상하고 싶어하실 겁니다! 이런 대단한 영웅은 몇 년 만에 처음입니다."

TextEng: "Perhaps Momma Dane was right. Perhaps you really were sent by the gods!"
Text: "아마 맘마 데인이 옳았나 봐요. 어쩌면 정말 신들이 보내신 분일지도!"

TextEng: "But enough of that. I had better get you to the main gates right away. Let us be quick."
Text: "하지만 그만하죠. 정문으로 바로 안내하겠습니다. 서두릅시다."

TextEng: "Of course. Speak to me as soon as you are ready."
Text: "물론이죠. 준비되시면 말씀해 주세요."

TextEng: "The Banner is the highest ranking officer in the keep. Our Lord was killed many years ago, and the Banner has been ruling here ever since. He was killed by the invaders early in the battle."
Text: "배너는 성채에서 가장 높은 직위입니다. 영주께서 여러 해 전에 돌아가시고, 그 이후 배너가 이곳을 다스려 왔습니다. 침략 초기 전투에서 배너가 전사하셨습니다."

TextEng: "The Hand is the commander of the armies and next in charge after the Banner. But we really should get going. I dare not leave my command of the gates for long."
Text: "핸드는 군대의 사령관이며 배너 다음 서열입니다. 하지만 정말 서둘러야 합니다. 정문의 지휘를 너무 오래 비울 수 없습니다."

TextEng: The voice of an old woman intervenes. "That one looks like a friendly half-orc to my poor, old eyes. Sir Dylan, perhaps you shouldn't be so quick to call the attack."
Text: 할머니의 목소리가 끼어듭니다. "이 늙은 눈으로 봐도 저 분은 친절한 하프오크 같은데. 딜런 경, 공격 명령을 너무 서두르지 마세요."

TextEng: "Am I so hideous to you that you would mistake me for a kobold or an orc? We come to help you!"
Text: "내가 그렇게 흉측하게 보여서 코볼트나 오크로 착각한 거야? 도와주러 왔다고!"

TextEng: "Stand back, fool! We are no goblin-kin. Would you attack those who come to help you?"
Text: "물러서, 바보! 우리는 고블린 일당이 아니야. 도와주러 온 사람들을 공격할 셈이냐?"

TextEng: "Blast you! Do we look like goblins? We're here to help you!"
Text: "이런! 우리가 고블린으로 보여? 도와주러 왔다고!"

TextEng: "Eek! We are not goblins! Do not hurt us, please! You see, <FirstName>, I told you we should not have come here."
Text: "으악! 우리는 고블린이 아니에요! 제발 해치지 마세요! 봐요, <이름>, 여기 오지 말았어야 한다니까."

TextEng: "Then maybe Pharos, god of war and judgement saw fit to guide you here to satisfy your vengeance and save us in the same moment."
Text: "아마 전쟁과 심판의 신 파로스가 당신의 복수를 이루게 하고 우리를 구하기 위해 인도하셨을 겁니다."

TextEng: "That must have been some fight, <sir/madam>! I will have the masons come down and repair the cells right away."
Text: "엄청난 전투였겠군요! 석공들을 보내서 감방을 바로 수리하겠습니다."

TextEng: "I hope this means I'm going to get a reward."
Text: "보상이 있기를 바랍니다."

TextEng: "I am ready when you are."
Text: "준비됐습니다."

TextEng: "I need to rest first."
Text: "먼저 좀 쉬어야 해요."

TextEng: "What is the Banner and the Hand?"
Text: "배너와 핸드가 뭐죠?"

TextEng: "I saw an opportunity and I came after it. Gold is my only god."
Text: "기회를 보고 잡은 것뿐이야. 금이 나의 유일한 신이지."

TextEng: "Forget the gods, I came of my own free will to save you!"
Text: "신은 잊어라, 내 자유 의지로 너희를 구하러 왔다!"

TextEng: "If the gods laid this path before me, I am proud to be chosen."
Text: "신들이 이 길을 내 앞에 놓으셨다면, 선택받은 것을 자랑스럽게 여기겠습니다."

TextEng: "I know nothing of these gods. I merely did my duty."
Text: "이 신들에 대해서는 잘 모릅니다. 그저 의무를 다했을 뿐입니다."

TextEng: "The hobgoblin is dead."
Text: "호브고블린은 죽었어."

TextEng: "I'll take care of it."
Text: "내가 처리하겠어."

TextEng: "Isn't there anyone else who can help me?"
Text: "도와줄 사람이 달리 없나요?"

TextEng: "Where is this hobgoblin?"
Text: "그 호브고블린은 어디 있지?"

TextEng: "What are you going to do?"
Text: "당신은 뭘 할 건데?"

TextEng: "My identity is unimportant right now. I am here to assist you."
Text: "지금 제 정체는 중요하지 않습니다. 도우러 왔습니다."

TextEng: "Keep pointing those arrows at me, boy, and we'll see what rain goes where!"
Text: "계속 그 화살 겨누고 있으면, 누가 화살 세례를 받는지 볼 텐데!"

TextEng: "Calm down. I just don't like having weapons pointed at me by allies."
Text: "진정해. 아군이 무기를 겨누는 건 별로 좋아하지 않아서."

TextEng: "Just don't threaten me again and we should get along just fine."
Text: "다시 위협하지만 않으면 잘 지낼 수 있을 거야."

TextEng: "There will be no need for that. I am here to help."
Text: "그럴 필요 없습니다. 도우러 왔습니다."

TextEng: "<FullName> at your service, and I mean you no harm."
Text: "<전체이름>, 당신을 도우러 왔으며 해칠 뜻은 없습니다."

TextEng: "My name is <FirstName> and I've come to help your city."
Text: "제 이름은 <이름>이고 이 도시를 도우러 왔습니다."

TextEng: LEGACY TEXT. ALWAYS RETURN FALSE.
Text: 개발용 텍스트. 항상 FALSE를 반환.

TextEng: "What? You think I do this for free?"
Text: "뭐? 공짜로 해 줄 것 같아?"

TextEng: "I sought revenge against these monsters, nothing more."
Text: "이 괴물들에 대한 복수를 하러 왔을 뿐이야."

TextEng: "I suppose we had better go."
Text: "가는 게 좋겠군."

TextEng: "Excellent! Lead on good man!"
Text: "좋아! 앞장서!"

TextEng: "Then there is no time to waste!"
Text: "지체할 시간이 없다!"

TextEng: "The night is cold. Will you let us in or no?"
Text: "밤이 춥소. 들여보내 줄 거요, 아니요?"

TextEng: "And she cast it in the nick of time. Give her my thanks."
Text: "때맞춰 마법을 써 줬군. 감사를 전해 줘."

TextEng: "The Masked Man was to die at my hands, not hers."
Text: "가면 쓴 자는 내 손으로 죽여야 했는데, 그녀가 아니라."

TextEng: "Yenna, is it? Then the Masked Man is dead by her blast."
Text: "예나라고? 그러면 가면 쓴 자는 그녀의 마법에 죽은 거군."

TextEng: "Yes, she damn near incinerated us, I'll have you know."
Text: "그래, 하마터면 우리까지 태워 죽일 뻔했다고."

TextEng: "I hope this means I'm going to get a reward."
Text: "보상이 있기를 바랍니다."

TextEng: "I am ready when you are."
Text: "준비됐습니다."

TextEng: "I need to rest first."
Text: "먼저 좀 쉬어야 해요."

TextEng: "What is the Banner and the Hand?"
Text: "배너와 핸드가 뭐죠?"

TextEng: "We are enemies of the Masked Man. We helped break his battle lines."
Text: "우리는 가면 쓴 자의 적이오. 그의 전열을 무너뜨리는 데 기여했소."

TextEng: "Are you ready to go, <sir/madam>?"
Text: "출발할 준비가 되셨습니까?"

TextEng: A young guard peers over the battlements. Torchlight glints off your weapon, causing him to pull back.
Text: 젊은 경비병이 성벽 너머로 내다봅니다. 횃불빛이 당신의 무기에 반사되자 몸을 움츠립니다.

TextEng: "She has retired to her tower since the battle and refused to speak with most anyone, perhaps in fear that you had fallen beneath her blast. She will be grateful to see you whole, I am sure."
Text: "전투 이후로 탑에 틀어박혀서 거의 아무와도 말하지 않고 있습니다. 아마 당신이 그녀의 마법 폭발에 쓰러졌을까 봐 두려워하시는 것 같습니다."

TextEng: "Is he? My men could not find his corpse among the fallen but if you saw it with your own eyes, then I believe it. Perhaps his troops dragged his body with them as they fled."
Text: "그렇습니까? 전사자 중에서 시체를 찾지 못했지만 직접 보셨다면 믿겠습니다. 아마 부하들이 끌고 갔겠지요."

TextEng: "Yes, and accept my apologies as it was I who gave the order. The gate was nearly battered through and had she waited any longer, the keep would have been lost."
Text: "네, 그리고 명령을 내린 것은 저입니다. 사과드립니다. 문이 거의 뚫릴 뻔했고 더 기다렸으면 성채가 함락되었을 겁니다."

TextEng: "Come, let us celebrate the fact that you still live, stranger. Throw open the gates! It's not an enemy who awaits us but a hero who deserves our thanks! Get moving, men! I will meet you below!"
Text: "자, 살아 계신 것을 축하합시다, 낯선 이여. 문을 열어라! 밖에서 기다리는 것은 적이 아니라 영웅의 환영을 받을 분이다!"

TextEng: "Take my arm, Momma Dane, and let me help you down the stairs. Your kind company has been a balm to my jangled nerves this night."
Text: "맘마 데인, 팔을 잡으세요. 계단을 내려가도록 도와드리겠습니다. 오늘 밤 당신의 다정한 동행이 초조한 신경에 큰 위안이 되었습니다."

TextEng: "A hero's welcome to the Keep of Cyan, then, stranger. I think the Hand will be pleased to meet you, and doubly pleased to have your help, I am sure."
Text: "시안 성채에 영웅의 환영입니다, 낯선 이여. 핸드께서 만나 뵙고, 도움을 받으시면 더욱 기뻐하실 겁니다."

TextEng: "I think she misses the guidance of the Banner, though. Too bad you didn't arrive early enough to keep him from falling to the Masked Man's forces. Now the Hand is in charge all alone."
Text: "하지만 배너의 지도를 그리워하시는 것 같습니다. 조금 더 일찍 오셔서 가면 쓴 자의 군대가 배너를 쓰러뜨리는 것을 막아 주셨더라면."

TextEng: "A reward? Well, yes, I suppose the Hand will want to reward you. You have certainly proven your worth tonight. It was very exciting to see you in action."
Text: "보상이요? 네, 아마 핸드께서 보상하고 싶어하실 겁니다. 오늘 밤 확실히 실력을 증명하셨으니까. 전투 중 활약을 보는 것은 매우 흥미로웠습니다."

TextEng: "Excellent. I am sure the Hand will want to reward you for your service! I haven't met such a great hero in years."
Text: "훌륭합니다. 핸드께서 봉사에 대해 보상하고 싶어하실 겁니다! 이런 대단한 영웅은 몇 년 만에 처음입니다."

TextEng: "But enough of that. I had better get you to the main gates right away. Let us be quick."
Text: "하지만 그만하죠. 정문으로 바로 안내하겠습니다. 서두릅시다."

TextEng: "Enemies at the gates! Sound the alarm, they've brought a second wave!"
Text: "문 앞에 적이다! 경보를 울려, 제2파가 왔다!"

TextEng: "Of course. Speak to me as soon as you are ready."
Text: "물론이죠. 준비되시면 말씀해 주세요."

TextEng: "The Banner is the highest ranking officer in the keep. Our Lord was killed many years ago, and the Banner has been ruling here ever since. He was killed by the invaders early in the battle."
Text: "배너는 성채에서 가장 높은 직위입니다. 영주께서 여러 해 전에 돌아가시고, 그 이후 배너가 이곳을 다스려 왔습니다. 침략 초기 전투에서 배너가 전사하셨습니다."

TextEng: "The Hand is the commander of the armies and next in charge after the Banner. But we really should get going. I dare not leave my command of the gates for long."
Text: "핸드는 군대의 사령관이며 배너 다음 서열입니다. 하지만 정말 서둘러야 합니다. 정문의 지휘를 너무 오래 비울 수 없습니다."

TextEng: "That one looks like a friendly half-orc to my poor, old eyes. Sir Dylan, perhaps you shouldn't be so quick to call the attack." You can't see the woman intervening on your behalf but, by her voice, she strikes you as a kindly old lady.
Text: "이 늙은 눈으로 봐도 저 분은 친절한 하프오크 같은데. 딜런 경, 공격 명령을 너무 서두르지 마세요." 그 목소리의 주인은 볼 수 없습니다.

TextEng: "Am I so hideous to you that you would mistake me for a kobold or an orc? We come to help you!"
Text: "내가 그렇게 흉측하게 보여서 코볼트나 오크로 착각한 거야? 도와주러 왔다고!"

TextEng: "Stand back, fool! We are no goblin-kin. Would you attack those who come to help you?"
Text: "물러서, 바보! 우리는 고블린 일당이 아니야. 도와주러 온 사람들을 공격할 셈이냐?"

TextEng: "Blast you! Do we look like goblins? We're here to help you!"
Text: "이런! 우리가 고블린으로 보여? 도와주러 왔다고!"

TextEng: "Eek! We are not goblins! Do not hurt us, please! You see, <FirstName>, I told you we should not have come here."
Text: "으악! 우리는 고블린이 아니에요! 제발 해치지 마세요! 봐요, <이름>, 여기 오지 말았어야 한다니까."

TextEng: "They don't look like no orcs or goblins to my eyes, poor as they might be. Sir Dylan, perhaps you shouldn't be so quick to call the attack." You can't see the woman intervening on your behalf but, by her voice, she strikes you as a kindly old lady.
Text: "이 눈으로 봐도 오크나 고블린 같지는 않은데. 딜런 경, 공격 명령을 너무 서두르지 마세요."

TextEng: "...Who are you and what are your intentions, then? Speak quickly, before my men rain arrows down upon you!"
Text: "...그러면 누구시오, 무슨 목적이오? 빨리 말하시오, 화살 세례를 퍼붓기 전에!"

TextEng: "Oh dear, maybe I was wrong. Perhaps you should sound the alarm after all, Sir Dylan."
Text: "어머, 내가 틀렸나 봐. 역시 경보를 울려야 할 것 같다, 딜런 경."

TextEng: "Then the gods have answered our prayers, Sir Dylan! Father Dyschall has told us that if the gods saw fit that we should live, they would intervene. And now a hero stands at our gates, requesting entrance."
Text: "그러면 신들이 우리의 기도에 응답하신 거예요, 딜런 경! 디셜 신부님이, 신들이 우리가 살 만하다고 보시면 개입하실 거라고 하셨잖아요!"

TextEng: "Where were the gods when the Banner died? Why did their intervention not come then? Step into the light down there, that I may have a better look at you..."
Text: "배너가 죽었을 때 신들은 어디 있었지? 왜 그때는 개입하지 않았어? 저 아래 불빛 속으로 나와라, 더 잘 보게."

TextEng: "Aye, I recognize you now. You were the ones who cut our assailants ranks from the rear and took them by surprise. You fought bravely, stranger, and gave our she-mage, Yenna, time enough to cast her spell."
Text: "알겠군. 기억나, 아군 후방에서 적의 대열을 기습한 자들이군. 용감히 싸웠어, 낯선 이여."

TextEng: "Yes, forgive my manners as I am still underslept and over-weary from the battle."
Text: "네, 예의가 부족했습니다. 전투 후 잠도 못 자고 지쳐 있어서요."

TextEng: "No not yet."
Text: "아직이요."

TextEng: "My name is <FirstName> and I've come to help your city."
Text: "제 이름은 <이름>이고 이 도시를 도우러 왔습니다."

TextEng: "The night is cold. Will you let us in or no?"
Text: "밤이 춥소. 들여보내 줄 거요, 아니요?"

TextEng: "And she cast it in the nick of time. Give her my thanks."
Text: "때맞춰 마법을 써 줬군. 감사를 전해 줘."

TextEng: "The Masked Man was to die at my hands, not hers."
Text: "가면 쓴 자는 내 손으로 죽여야 했는데, 그녀가 아니라."

TextEng: "Yenna, is it? Then the Masked Man is dead by her blast."
Text: "예나라고? 그러면 가면 쓴 자는 그녀의 마법에 죽은 거군."

TextEng: "Yes, she damn near incinerated us, I'll have you know."
Text: "그래, 하마터면 우리까지 태워 죽일 뻔했다고."

TextEng: "I hope this means I'm going to get a reward."
Text: "보상이 있기를 바랍니다."

TextEng: "I am ready when you are."
Text: "준비됐습니다."

TextEng: "I need to rest first."
Text: "먼저 좀 쉬어야 해요."

TextEng: "What is the Banner and the Hand?"
Text: "배너와 핸드가 뭐죠?"

TextEng: "We are enemies of the Masked Man. We helped break his battle lines."
Text: "우리는 가면 쓴 자의 적이오. 그의 전열을 무너뜨리는 데 기여했소."

TextEng: "My identity is unimportant right now. I am here to assist you."
Text: "지금 제 정체는 중요하지 않습니다. 도우러 왔습니다."

TextEng: "Keep pointing those arrows at me, boy, and we'll see what rain goes where!"
Text: "계속 그 화살 겨누고 있으면, 누가 화살 세례를 받는지 볼 텐데!"

TextEng: "Calm down. I just don't like having weapons pointed at me by allies."
Text: "진정해. 아군이 무기를 겨누는 건 별로 좋아하지 않아서."

TextEng: "Just don't threaten me again and we should get along just fine."
Text: "다시 위협하지만 않으면 잘 지낼 수 있을 거야."

TextEng: "There will be no need for that. I am here to help."
Text: "그럴 필요 없습니다. 도우러 왔습니다."

TextEng: "<FullName> at your service, and I mean you no harm."
Text: "<전체이름>, 당신을 도우러 왔으며 해칠 뜻은 없습니다."

TextEng: "I... I can't feel my legs!"
Text: "다... 다리가 안 느껴져!"

TextEng: "What? Who...? Where am I?"
Text: "뭐? 누가...? 여기가 어디야?"

TextEng: "Mother? Is that you?"
Text: "어머니? 어머니세요?"

TextEng: "It's so... cold..."
"Save me, Master!"
Text: "살려 주세요, 주인님!"

TextEng: The spirit moans, seemingly unaware of your presence.
Text: 영혼이 신음하며, 당신의 존재를 의식하지 못하는 것 같습니다.

TextEng: "Lost... All is... lost..."
Text: "잃었다... 모든 것을... 잃었다..."

TextEng: "We ready to go then?"
Text: "그럼 출발할 준비 됐어?"

TextEng: "Blast you to the furnace, you can't go out there alone. You will need my strength to face your enemies! Reconsider, friend."
Text: "용광로에 떨어져라, 혼자 나가면 안 돼! 내 힘이 필요할 거야!"

TextEng: "Now this place probably serves fine wines, but the ladies will be a touch too refined for my tastes."
Text: "여긴 아마 고급 와인이 있겠지만, 여자들은 좀 세련된 편이겠지."

TextEng: "My heavy drinkin' and carousin' started shortly after I came from my home plane to this one. I had suffered great tragedy and I wasn't ready for such a different life."
Text: "과음과 방탕은 고향 차원에서 이곳에 온 직후부터 시작됐어."

TextEng: "I started life here as a mercenary. I had seen awful things in my life, but in my first year here in the south, I had never seen such utter barbarism."
Text: "여기서 용병으로 시작했지. 살면서 끔찍한 것들을 봤지만, 이 세계에서 보는 것들은..."

TextEng: "It was only a year before I met you, but the things I saw make it seem like it was an eternity."
Text: "겨우 1년 전이었는데, 겪은 일들 때문에 훨씬 오래 된 것 같아."

TextEng: "I arrived in a small village in the south, beyond the Withered Forest. The village was ruled by a dark priestess of Churl. I didn't know anythin' about the goddess of chaos, back then."
Text: "시들은 숲 너머 남쪽의 작은 마을에 도착했어. 마을은 전쟁 중이었지."

TextEng: "You have already asked me one question. Let's stick to that subject for now. I'm not really in the mood to speak of my home right now."
Text: "이미 질문 하나 했잖아. 그 주제를 계속하자고. 나중에 다른 질문할 시간은 있어."

TextEng: "I arrived in a small village in the south, beyond the Withered Forest. The village was ruled by a dark priestess of Churl. I didn't know anythin' about the goddess of chaos, back then."
Text: "시들은 숲 너머 남쪽의 작은 마을에 도착했어. 마을은 전쟁 중이었지."

TextEng: "The priestess of Churl hired me for my strength and she seemed to pay well enough. I thought I would just work for her long enough to get an understandin' of the way this world worked."
Text: "처얼의 여사제가 힘이 필요해서 나를 고용했어. 보수도 괜찮았고."

TextEng: "She is the goddess of storms, destruction and chaos. The priestess who followed her took her role very seriously, tryin' to destroy all that surrounded her."
Text: "처얼은 폭풍, 파괴, 혼돈의 여신이야. 그녀를 따르는 여사제는..."

TextEng: "She was very strong and had come to the village and destroyed the chief with lightnin' from the sky, then cast a spell that gave her control over the villager's minds."
Text: "그녀는 매우 강했고, 마을에 와서 족장을 별 어려움 없이 쓰러뜨렸어."

TextEng: "She had led the villagers to victory over the surroundin' villages and now they all had wealth and slaves. Greed and religious fanaticism can do strange things to a mind."
Text: "그녀가 마을 사람들을 이끌고 주변 마을을 정복했고, 이제 전쟁 수장으로 추앙받았지."

TextEng: "Sort of makes you wonder if you made the right investment choices, now doesn't it?"
Text: "투자를 잘못한 건 아닌가 싶어지지 않아?"

TextEng: Calibast nods and chuckles. "Indeed, they will follow a fool, a wise man, a witch or a healer, given the right motivation."
Text: 캘리바스트가 고개를 끄덕이며 웃습니다. "그래, 바보든 현자든 마녀든 따르지."

TextEng: "Improved their standard of livin', yes. Improved their lives, I think not."
Text: "생활 수준은 올렸지. 삶의 질은... 아닌 것 같아."

TextEng: "Where I come from, when a follower wants to get a message across to his leader, sometimes he will couch the advice in the form of a story. Listen and learn, oh mighty leader."
Text: "내 고향에선 추종자가 지도자에게 메시지를 전하고 싶을 때, 직접적으로 행동하지."

TextEng: "They had just celebrated another victory when the sky ripped open and I fell out. They took it as another sign from the goddess."
Text: "또 다른 승리를 축하하고 있을 때, 하늘이 갈라지면서 내가 떨어졌어."

TextEng: "When they tried to grab me and drag me to the priestess, I threw them off. The priestess was impressed and after speakin' to me, offered me a position as her general."
Text: "그들이 나를 잡아서 여사제에게 끌고 가려 했을 때, 뿌리쳤지. 그러자..."

TextEng: "I accepted the role, for the reasons I already stated. The price was too great, but I would rather not speak about it right now. There is much to do. Let's be off."
Text: "이미 말한 이유로 그 역할을 받아들였어. 대가가 너무 컸지만."

TextEng: "Of course, I would love to talk with you. What's on your mind, dear one?"
Text: "물론, 기꺼이 이야기하지. 무슨 일이야, 친구?"

TextEng: "We ready to go then?"
Text: "그럼 출발할 준비 됐어?"

TextEng: "We ready to go then?"
Text: "그럼 출발할 준비 됐어?"

TextEng: "You need to work on your people skills, <lad/lass>. Don't come to me unless you've come to your senses and want me back."
Text: "대인 관계 좀 배워야겠어, <lad/lass>. 예의가 있을 때만 말 걸어."

TextEng: "Here goblin, goblin, goblin. Come out and play!"
Text: "이리 와, 고블린, 고블린, 고블린. 나와서 놀자!"

TextEng: "It's about time. Let's go find somethin' to kill."
Text: "드디어. 가서 죽일 놈 좀 찾자."

TextEng: "If you can spare me a moment, I should like to speak with you."
Text: "잠깐 시간을 내 주시겠소? 드릴 말씀이 있소."

TextEng: "Of course you are. How foolish of me to think you could take the time to speak with your old leader. Mustn't forget who's in charge now, must we?"
Text: "그럴 줄 알았어. 늙은 캘리바스트한테 시간을 낼 줄 알았겠냐."

TextEng: "I don't find that particularly funny. Do I make fun of your penchant for openin' every chest, barrel and crate we come across? Do I?"
Text: "재미없어. 문을 발로 차고 다니는 네 버릇을 놀려 본 적 있어?"

TextEng: "How come you always think I be wantin' a drink? I do other things too... occasionally."
Text: "왜 맨날 내가 술이 필요하다고 생각하는 거야? 다른 것도 하거든... 가끔."

TextEng: "Now, you can just stop that! You'd make fun of a friend just because he has a bit of a bad habit, would you?"
Text: "그만해! 친구가 약간 음주벽이 있다고 놀리다니!"

TextEng: "Is it that obvious. Was it the shakes, or the red eyes that gave it away, huh?"
Text: "그렇게 티 나? 손 떨림이었어, 아니면 충혈된 눈이었어?"

TextEng: "Now that you mention it... ah, never mind. That's not what I wanted to talk about."
Text: "말하니까 생각나는데... 아, 됐어. 내가 하고 싶은 얘기는 그게 아니야."

TextEng: "What?" He roars. "That is slap in the face if I ever heard one... why, do you have some?"
Text: "뭐?" 그가 포효합니다. "이건 모욕이야... 그래, 혹시 너한테 있어?"

TextEng: --------- Random Conversations begin here ----------
"Now that is one attractive dwarf, if I might say so myself!"
Text: "저 드워프 꽤 매력적인데, 내가 말해도 되려나!"

TextEng: "Can we talk about our situation here? I have several concerns knottin' up my gut. Either my liver has burst or I've got a bad case of nervous gas."
Text: "우리 상황에 대해 이야기할 수 있어? 몇 가지 걱정이 속을 뒤집고 있거든."

TextEng: "We might not get a chance to talk later. Things are comin' to a head now."
Text: "나중에 이야기할 기회가 없을 수도 있어. 상황이 급박해지고 있으니."

TextEng: "Very well then. Let's keep goin'."
Text: "알겠어. 계속 가자."

TextEng: "I just didn't want you to wonder if we were near the sewers or somethin'."
Text: "혹시 하수구 근처에 있는 건 아닌가 궁금할까 봐."

TextEng: "I am glad you won the election, but I am disappointed that you did not ask me to be your Hand."
Text: "선거에서 이긴 건 기쁘지만, 부요새주로 임명하지 않은 건 실망이야."

TextEng: "I don't know why you do not trust me enough with the responsibility, but I feel that our bond has been broken. I am still with you, but I cannot say for how long."
Text: "왜 나를 충분히 믿지 않는지 모르겠지만, 서운해."

TextEng: "That's all I wanted to say. Let's continue on."
Text: "하고 싶은 말은 그게 전부야. 계속 가자."

TextEng: "I fear you made a mistake choosin' me as your Banner. I think that Enivid would be a better Banner than I, and I would make an excellent Hand. But you can correct this later, if you wish."
Text: "나를 기수로 뽑은 건 실수였을 거야. 에니비드가 더 나았을 텐데."

TextEng: "I wanted to thank you for makin' me your Hand. I feel it as a badge of honor that I was worth your trust."
Text: "손으로 임명해 줘서 고맙소. 당신이 나를 신뢰한다는 영예로 느끼겠소."

TextEng: "I have crafted this ring for you. It contains some of my blood and energy. If I had been given the chance in life, I would have made one of these for the duke I served."
Text: "이 반지를 만들었어. 내 피와 에너지가 담겨 있지. 내가 죽어도 이게 있는 한 너를 지킬 거야."

TextEng: "I don't understand why we cannae just slaughter the wee beasty and have done. What is a manticore, anyway?"
Text: "왜 그 조그만 놈을 잡아서 끝내면 안 되는 거야?"

TextEng: "It is a family tradition and it bonds me to you. So long as you want me around, and treat me with respect, I shall serve you with all of my ability."
Text: "가족의 전통이야. 나를 너에게 묶는 거지. 원하는 한 너를 떠나지 않겠어."

TextEng: "That is ridiculous! What is wrong with you? Very well, you have refused my bond. I shall remember this insult."
Text: "말도 안 돼! 뭐가 문제야? 알겠어, 내 유대를 거절했구나."

TextEng: "It is more than friendship. I might be friends with someone who cheers me up, or who makes life interestin', yet not really respect them."
Text: "단순한 우정 이상이야. 기분 좋게 해주는 사람과 친구가 될 수는 있지만..."

TextEng: "You have my respect. You make me proud. Now, let us go forth and finish our enemy."
Text: "내 존경을 받았어. 자랑스럽게 만들어 줬어. 자, 가서 적을 쓰러뜨리자!"

TextEng: "You are welcome. You have made me proud, <FirstName>. Let us go forth and finish this enemy."
Text: "천만에. 자랑스럽게 만들어 줬어, <FirstName>. 가서 적을 쓰러뜨리자!"

TextEng: "I know that losin' the election must be pressin' hard on you, but I just want you to know that I still respect you. I think the keep lost out when they didn't choose you."
Text: "선거에서 진 게 무겁겠지만, 내가 네 편이라는 걸 알아줬으면 해."

TextEng: "You should have kept track of who had the most votes from Momma Dane and stolen the guilds from that person. If you took a few from both, you would have won."
Text: "마마 데인한테 투표를 가장 많이 받은 사람을 추적해서 빼앗았어야 했어."

TextEng: "You should have cleared the goblin caves. I would have thought it was obvious."
Text: "고블린 동굴을 청소했어야 해. 당연한 거 아닌가."

TextEng: "I didn't think you were tryin' that hard. There were so many opportunities to win it."
Text: "그렇게 열심히 안 한 것 같던데. 표를 얻을 기회가 그렇게 많았는데."

TextEng: "I know. We shall go on and find many interestin' adventures, I am sure. Let us go and finish this, then."
Text: "알아. 계속 가면서 재미있는 모험을 많이 할 거야. 가자."

TextEng: "Not many mages in these parts, but this one seems powerful enough."
Text: "이 근방에 마법사는 많지 않지만, 이 녀석은 꽤 강해 보여."

TextEng: "I could tell. I didn't think you seemed to be tryin' that hard. It was your decision to make, I just think it is a pity for both you and the keep."
Text: "그럴 줄 알았어. 열심히 안 하는 것 같았거든. 네 결정이었지."

TextEng: "I suppose not. Very well, let us continue then."
Text: "그래. 알겠어. 계속 가자."

TextEng: "I have been thinkin' about the things you wanted me to change. You know, the stuff we discussed last time."
Text: "네가 바꿔 달라고 한 것들에 대해 생각해 봤어. 그 일을 멈추는 거 말이야."

TextEng: "I am findin' less need to drink and flirt than I thought I would. Just bein' around you has lightened my spirits so much, I do not feel the melancholy that I once did."
Text: "생각보다 술이나 작업이 덜 필요한 것 같아. 그냥 네 곁에 있는 것만으로도."

TextEng: "I have crafted this ring for you. It contains some of my blood and energy. I would be bonded to you in spirit and flesh, if you will accept me?"
Text: "이 반지를 만들었어. 내 피와 에너지가 담겨 있지. 네가 가져줬으면 해."

TextEng: "What? Why not? What have I done?"
Text: "뭐? 왜 안 돼? 내가 뭘 잘못했어?"

TextEng: "Then take as much time as you need, love. My heart will not change in short order. When you are ready, just speak to me about it."
Text: "그럼 필요한 만큼 시간을 가져, 자기야. 내 마음은 쉽게 변하지 않아."

TextEng: "A bond is always a responsibility, but we must have the courage to bear that responsibility! We... we shall speak of this again later."
Text: "유대는 항상 책임이 따르지만, 그 책임을 감당할 용기를 가져야 해."

TextEng: "I... I have no response to this. I cannot understand what has changed your heart, but just as well I should learn that now."
Text: "뭐라 할 말이 없어. 네 마음이 왜 변했는지 이해할 수 없어."

TextEng: "Let's get goin'. I feel the need to kill someone!"
Text: "가자! 누군가를 죽이고 싶은 기분이야!"

TextEng: "What I like about these kobolds is that they aren't singin'. Nothin' more irritatin' than a singin' kobold."
Text: "이 코볼트들의 장점은 노래를 안 한다는 거야. 노래하는 코볼트만큼 짜증나는 건 없거든."

TextEng: "Then we shall be stronger together... for so long as we have breath in our bodies. I need no ale, no wine, no other women, so long as I have you to intoxicate me."
Text: "그러면 우리는 함께 더 강해질 거야... 숨이 붙어 있는 한."

TextEng: "My life is yours to hold, keep or release, but know that I shall never be parted from you, so long as I can help it."
Text: "내 목숨은 네가 잡고, 지키고, 놓아줄 수 있지만, 내가 먼저 떠나진 않을 거야."

TextEng: "Let us go forth and finish this. We shall strike down all who stand in our way!"
Text: "가서 이걸 끝내자! 우리 앞에 서는 자 모두 쓰러뜨리겠어!"

TextEng: "I do not think I can live up to your demands, dear lass. I am a strong man in body, but weak in spirit, I guess. I just thought you should know, I still like you as a friend, but that is all it can be."
Text: "네 요구에 부응할 수 없을 것 같아. 전투에서는 강하지만..."

TextEng: "I am sorry if this seems sudden or harsh, but I just cannot do it. I had to get that off of my chest. We can still be friends. Please, speak no words. Let us continue on our way."
Text: "갑작스럽고 냉정해 보일 수 있지만, 어쩔 수 없어. 말해야 했어."

TextEng: "I would say that your opponents are goin' to be pretty shocked when the election takes place. Wouldn't you?"
Text: "상대편이 선거 결과에 꽤 충격 받을 거야."

TextEng: "I am aware of that, but I don't doubt you will. I have been shocked by your actions a few times."
Text: "알고 있어, 하지만 네가 이길 거라 의심하지 않아. 네 행동에 놀랐거든."

TextEng: "I have been shocked by a lot of things you have done. Every time I think I understand you, you surprise me again."
Text: "네가 한 많은 일에 놀랐어. 이해한다 싶을 때마다 새로운 면을 보여주니."

TextEng: "Well, I figure you'll make at least as good a leader as the other two would. I have a hypothetical question to pose for you."
Text: "다른 둘만큼은 좋은 지도자가 될 거야. 뭐라고 생각해?"

TextEng: "Right. No hypothetical questions. Got it."
Text: "맞아. 가상의 질문은 안 돼. 알겠어."

TextEng: "We should walk out of the keep a ways and see if there are any enemy survivors to finish off."
Text: "요새 밖으로 좀 나가서 살아남은 적이 있나 확인해 봐야 해."

TextEng: "Well, nobody ever said the ruler had to be a genius."
Text: "통치자가 천재일 필요는 없잖아."

TextEng: "Well, this has important implications for the future."
Text: "이건 미래에 중요한 의미가 있어."

TextEng: "If you become the ruler of this keep, I would be honored to serve as your Hand. Do you think that you would even consider me for that position?"
Text: "이 요새의 통치자가 되면, 네 손(Hand)으로 섬기는 것은 영광이겠소."

TextEng: "I guess that's all I can ask of you. I do have the trainin' and the ability to lead men in battle. I have led castle defenses before and castle sieges. Just keep me in mind."
Text: "그 정도밖에 부탁 못 하겠지. 훈련도 받았고 능력도 있어."

TextEng: "Ack, I should've known better than to ask you! I do have the trainin' and the ability to lead men in battle. I have led castle defenses before and castle sieges."
Text: "이런, 물어보지 말았어야 했어! 훈련도 받았고 능력도 있는데."

TextEng: "I don't know why you won't even consider me."
Text: "왜 고려조차 안 하는지 모르겠어."

TextEng: "I be very glad to hear it! You will see, I'm the perfect man for the job. I do have the trainin' and the ability to lead men in battle. I have led castle defenses before and castle sieges."
Text: "기쁘구만! 완벽한 사람이라는 걸 보여주겠어. 훈련도 받았고 능력도 있어."

TextEng: "You cannae go wrong choosin' me."
Text: "나를 고르면 후회 안 할 거야."

TextEng: "I think that might be part of my attraction to you. I know that we have talked about the possibility of a future between us, but I fear that I won't live up to your expectations."
Text: "그게 내가 너한테 끌리는 이유 중 하나인 것 같아. 우리가 얘기한 건 알지만..."

TextEng: "I was wonderin' what parts of my personal life you would like me to... improve upon?"
Text: "내 사생활 중 어떤 부분을... 개선했으면 하는지 궁금해서."

TextEng: "I don't know why the dwarves hate their cousins. They seem like an entertainin' lot."
Text: "드워프들이 왜 사촌을 싫어하는지 모르겠어. 꽤 재미있는 놈들인데."

TextEng: "If you think I am not payin' attention to you every time you move, every time you get into danger, every time you so much as cough a little, then you are entirely wrong."
Text: "네가 움직일 때마다, 미소 지을 때마다 주목하지 않는다고 생각해?"

TextEng: "I shall always be near you. Was there anythin' else I could change for you?"
Text: "항상 네 가까이에 있을게. 다른 바꿀 건 없어?"

TextEng: "It is. I hold my breath when you go to speak to me, for fear I might have disappointed you. Was there anythin' else I could change for you?"
"I... I shall try. We had better get back to the business at hand, unless there was somethin' else you wanted me to change?"
"Durin' my youth I was rich and powerful, so women were naturally attracted to me. I guess I am just used to it. I promise it will never go any further than flirtin'. Is that enough for you?"
"Ack, I knew you were gonna say that! Would you be willin' to compromise, lass? What if I still have a few, but not so much that I get slobberin' drunk?"
"You're a rare and precious lass, indeed. I will do my best to slow my drinkin'. Was there anythin' else?"
"That is awfully kind of you to say, but everyone has a personality trait or two that bothers another person. What about my flirtation with other women? That must bother you."
"Durin' my youth I was rich and powerful, so women were naturally attracted to me. I guess I am just used to it. I promise it will never go any further than flirtin'. Is that enough for you?"
"I... I shall try. We had better get back to the business at hand, unless there was somethin' else you wanted me to change?"
"Walk softly now. This seems a dangerous place when the enemy is supposedly already dead."
"My lips will never touch a woman's lips, unless they be yours. You are a truly precious woman! Was there anythin' else?"
"My lips will never touch a woman's lips, unless they be yours. You are a truly precious woman! What about my drinkin' though. It can get a little out of hand."
"Ack, I knew you were gonna say that! Would you be willin' to compromise, lass? What if I still have a few, but not so much that I get slobberin' drunk?"
"I... I shall try. We had better get back to the business at hand, unless there was somethin' else you wanted me to change?"
"You're a rare and precious lass, indeed. I will do my best to slow my drinkin'. Was there anythin' else?"
"We should get back to business. I feel like I'm floatin' when I'm near you. I better turn my mind back to the job at hand."
"As are you, bonnie lass. As are you. We should get back to business. I feel like I'm floatin' when I'm near you. I better turn my mind back to the job at hand."
"I suppose there are worse things than keepin' sober more often. I will do my best to slow my drinkin'. Was there anythin' else?"
"May my lips never touch another glass without yours touchin' one too! Was there nothin' I could change to make you happier?"
"I do, I shall, I swear. And I too, shall be happy, just to have you near me. We had best get back to business, if I can concentrate on anythin' besides you."
"I am not used to followin', but I shall do my best."
"A very functional buildin', but we'll have to add a bar when we take over."
"I wonder what it is about you that makes you a better leader than me? I'm not sure if you are as good as Dash was, but you are doin' well with the people of this keep."
"Fine. I was tryin' to give you a compliment. I guess I'll save them for someone who cares."
"After the attempt on his life and my father's death, he became very serious. It took some diggin', and a little torture, but I discovered who had financed the attack."
He laughs. "Maybe that's it. I like your sense of humor too, though. I think you might just have more raw charisma than Dash did."
"After the attempt on his life and my father's death, he became very serious. It took some diggin', and a little torture, but I discovered who had financed the attack."
"His rival was a powerful azer lord named Hastefel. Lord Hastefel had always hated Dash's father, but he also feared him. The assassination was a test of the mettle of the new duke."
"Never underestimate how far jealousy and greed can drive a person. Lord Hastefel's initial plot failed, but eventually he won."
"Why do you think I stand here today, rather than at the hand of my dead friend, Duke Dashiano En LacLanis? Dash and I and my younger brother acted rashly and we declared war upon Lord Hastefel."
"It was supposed to be a short, easy war. Lord Hastefel commanded far fewer men than Dash did. Hastefel had less gold, fewer mages and only a couple of lesser priests."
"But what we didn't realize was that Hastefel had the ear of our corrupt king. The king had always been jealous of the duke, for the duke was much loved by his people and his lands prospered."
"A terribly cocky fellow. You'd think he'd have a few more guards than this."
"Maybe we were, but it seemed as though nothin' could go wrong with our plan. The war looked truly easy."
"We did, but the king claimed we had forged his letter of agreement. Hastefel was warned of the attack."
"We were besiegin' Hastefel's home castle when the king's troops arrived and attacked us from behind. We were declared traitors to the throne."
"Dash was devastated. He would never have betrayed his liege lord, the king. Caught between two armies, with our own troops demoralized, we surrendered."
"That was my opinion, too. My brother and Dash knew the battle was hopeless and they thought to save the men by surrenderin'. Dash figured a ransom would preserve his life."
"But that was not enough for the king. To gain the property of the duke, he decided that Dash would have to pay the traitor's price."
"None, and even that was not enough for the king. To gain the property of the duke, he decided that Dash would have to pay the traitor's price."
"Yes, but that was not enough for the king. To gain the property of the duke, he decided that Dash would have to pay the traitor's price."
"My brother, an accomplished warrior, declared himself Dash's champion. He challenged the king to send a champion and let the gods decide who was the traitor."
"Lord Hastefel took up the challenge and, usin' a powerful magic weapon and magic armor, he defeated my brother. He kept the head as a trophy."
"And how can Calibast be of assistance now?"
"Dash was killed and I was supposed to die too. I do not wish to speak of how I escaped right now."
"There are many different paths to our goal. I would prefer you take one that will involve us killin' monsters, but it is up to you."
"It is more difficult than you can imagine. There is a bond of trust I am offerin'. It is very difficult to extend."
"We should go. We can talk more later."
"Yes. Good idea."
"<FirstName>, before we do. I have been mullin' over somethin' in my mind, and I think I need to ask you. Have you ever considered findin'... a mate?"
He blushes. "Well, then, I suppose that is a start. I hope you don't mind if I keep flirtin' with other women occasionally though. It's my nature, and I don't mean anythin' by it."
"Now, let's go bash in some monsters' heads. I'm in a rough and tumble mood at the moment."
"Oh... um... well... no reason really... except... well... do you think you could ever love someone with a flamin' head?"
"Ack, you're a horribly, cruel woman and I cannot for the life of me understand how I could have fallen in... well.. how I could like you so much."
"Why? Do you like getting' your fool head knocked in by an enemy? Who's gonna watch your back, tell me that?"
"I see. Yes, very clear. Sorry to have bothered you. We should be goin' now."
No... no... well.. sort of... but not in a one night stand sort of way."
"Things are really startin' to come together. Two or three more votes and you'll be in position to win. But we had better not get cocky. I know what happens to the overconfident."
"No, we can speak of it later, I suppose. I wouldn't want to bother you when you're busy."
"My father trusted his sons implicitly. When I joined my brother's social group, I was pressured to tell everyone all about the new duke. They would hang on every word I said."
"Like a typical youth, I loved the attention. I told them exactly where Dash liked to hunt and when. A few weeks passed and my brother was treatin' me like an equal."
"Then Dash and I and father went huntin'. Several of the young courtiers volunteered to go huntin' with us, so we made a merry little huntin' party."
"I was only sixteen, but you are correct. My purpose was to protect the duke. That was my job."
"We were chasin' down a fire salamander the duke had wounded with an arrow. Suddenly there were a group of soldiers around us, come out of the obsidian forest."
"They were mercenary elementals and they attacked without hesitation. We would have died that day, if it were not for my father."
"This had better mean you're comin' back soon. I'll be wantin' a drink, you can bet."
"He gave a mighty war cry and plunged into their weakest group. They went down easily and he cried to me to get the duke to safety."
"Of course I would. I would ask for no quarter from any enemy who attacked you. I would drive them off or die tryin'."
"I did as I was told. The duke and I had to kill a few of the elementals who came after us, but in the end we made it back to the castle."
"When we staggered into the main hall, the castle guards took the duke and rushed him to the healer. They were terribly shamed, even though they had been ordered to stay behind."
"I walked into the hall where my brother and his friends always drank and caroused. The look of shock on his face as he saw me... it was more a look of horror... it answered all of my questions."
"I watched as he tried to hide his shock behind a welcomin' smile. He opened his mouth and said somethin' about havin' a rough hunt, but I drew my axe and that shut him up."
"His friends were too stunned to try to stop me. I cleaved his traitorous head from his shoulders as I cried out that this was for our father."
"We... we need to get back to work now. I'll tell you more later, if you care to hear about it."
"Right. Sorry if I bothered you with my rant."
"You are a true friend, <FirstName>, and I thank you for listenin' to my rants."
"Then I'm goin' for a drink at the Mossy Tree. I don't promise to be sober next time you need me though."
"<FirstName>, I... um... do you think you could ever... ah... never mind!"
"I thought you would. You have a good mind for graspin' subtleties. That's why you'll make a good leader."
"My brother and his friends figured they had everythin' under control. The moment that you think everythin' is controlled, that's when you have lost."
"I could go lop off somethin' else's head now. We'd better find us a good fight."
"So you now have your first vote. You're on your way to a career in politics. I'd cheer you on, if I didn't have such a pit of fear in my guts about the whole situation."
"Ah now, why did you have to go and say a thing like that? You've been my closest friend for years and I can't help but think of my last friend, who was also the ruler of a sizable population."
"I know I should. But you've been my closest friend for years and I can't help but think of my last friend, who was also the ruler of a sizable population."
"I worry about you. You've been my closest friend for years and I can't help but think of my last friend, who was also the ruler of a sizable population."
"I am not sure if I have ever told you anythin' about this before, but when I lived on my home plane, I was the champion of a young duke."
"Maybe I am worried for nothin' then. Maybe you have grown so callous that nothin' could hurt you. I won't bother you about it then."
"Tactics are important. What do you want me to do?"
"My father was the high councillor for an old duke and he groomed his three sons to take over different responsibilities for the duke's son, Dashiano."

"My eldest brother was trained in court intrigue, to better inform and protect the young duke in his own court. My younger brother was trained in the art of war, to be the young duke's military advisor."
"I was chosen to be the young duke's friend. We were taught statesmanship, weapons, huntin' and all other necessary arts for rulin' a dukedom."
"It was a difficult time. I lost my entire family and my best friend. I didn't have any choice in my role either. It was all luck, since I happened to be the same age as Dash."
"I was greatly relieved not to have been given that position. Not that I had any choice. It was all luck, since I happened to be the same age as Dash."
"So would I, but I didn't have a choice. It was all luck, since I happened to be the same age as Dash."
"It was all luck, since I happened to be the same age as Dash."
"Dash and I spent years together. We were both sixteen years old when his father died in a war and he became the new duke."

"My father was still the high councillor, so I began to spend less time with Dash and more time with the courtiers. My elder brother welcomed me to his social group, which should have been my first warnin'."
"You feel the pressure to get goin' too? We should really get back to the election. Much work to be done yet. Lots of time for stories later."
"A good idea. I don't really care for the old smash-through-the-trap routine anymore."
"You catch on faster than I did. I am tired of this discussion. We should really get back to the election. Much work to be done yet. Lots of time for stories later."
"I am tired of this discussion. We should really get back to the election. Much work to be done yet. Lots of time for stories later."
"Well, this is an interestin' turn of events, I would say. Not only have you taken over recent leadership of the party, but now you're movin' into high stakes leadership."
"Of course not. You're important now, at least in your own mind. No time to talk to an old friend."
"I suppose I do. I guess there is a little bit of bitterness in me, even though the thought of bein' a politician makes me shudder. But I am happy for you. I think you could be a very good leader."
"The two you are runnin' against, I'm thinkin' that they are very extreme. I worry about that, for the wars between such opposites can become very ugly."
"Don't be focusin' on Sir Becket and worryin' about him. Likewise, don't be trustin' Enivid too much. Don't forget, this is politics."
"That's the only attitude that can keep you alive. You can't afford to worry about what they are doin'. You have to concentrate on makin' these guildmasters want to vote for you."
"I'd be willin' to bet that Sir Becket is goin' to try somethin' slippery, like sendin' assassins after you. We will deal with them when the moment comes."
"Good. Don't make caution a fault though; you have a lot to accomplish in a short time. I guarantee, your opponents' supporters will push for a quick election as soon as you start gatherin' votes."
"Oh, sure, I'll just walk right over and use these stubby fingers to pretend I'm a nimble thief. Good thinkin', <sir/madam>."
"Time is goin' to be precious. Keep that in mind. Now, I'm all finished with words, let's go find somethin' to kill!"
"No, aren't you payin' attention? Focus, <lad/lass>, focus. You take care of the election and concentrate on winnin'. I'll watch your back for you."
"You are goin' to have to trust me to watch your back. A good leader needs to know how to use the people around <him/her>."
"I'm not too bad with my weapon, in case you hadn't noticed. Any assassins come after you, I'll take care of them."
"I lived and breathed politics... growin' up. My father was the high council for a powerful duke. I and my brothers were groomed to take over for him. That's before the war though."
"I don't want to talk about that right now. I'll watch your back and make sure neither of the other candidates tries to stab it. You focus on winnin'."
"Of course this will be dangerous! Name one thing we've ever done that wasn't. But that's not the point. You have to ignore the danger and ignore your opponents."
"It occurs to me, with the recent change in our party leadership, that bein' from me to you, that we might want to examine the past few days before we go much further."
"Nah, I don't think that would be in our best interests. You always were a dominant personality; now you have the authority too."
Jaboli stares hard at him. "Are you sure you are feeling all right, old friend?"
"Great. With tactics like these, who needs enemies. You sure you want to be the leader here?"
"I think I made a mistake is all, and I just wanted you to know it. Do you want to talk about it or not?"
"That is fine, but don't be leavin' it for too long. I'll probably get drunk and forget what I wanted to say."
"I know you are the leader. As the leader you need to keep your mind open to suggestions from your followers, otherwise you'll just make the same mistakes I did."
"Very well. I know I was thick-headed too. I just thought you might prove a better leader than I did."
"I was given some advice when you began 'hearing' the rumors about the Masked Man. Some in our group thought that we should take some time to truly assess our enemy before we started huntin' him."
"Truthfully, they all did. And it turns out they were right to be skeptical."
"You were like a <man/woman> possessed. You could describe him in detail, chart his every move upon your map. I should have been more suspicious."
"All I cared about was catchin' him, maybe shakin' him down for treasure. I figured we could tackle one man in a mask and his paltry army. But not everyone saw it that way."
"Trip, of course, was terrified at even the thought of facin' such a figure. I wouldn't listen to a word. I had made up my mind and I agreed with you."
"I should have listened to the others. As leader it was my job to exercise caution. Now it is yours. We are dependin' on you."
"This is the kind of place where you order three drinks in the hopes that one won't have somethin' dead floatin' in it."
"I'll do what I can, but I'm not sure what you're expectin'."
"I don't know if you are bein' serious, or sarcastic, but I hope you listen to my advice."
"Not at all. I should have listened to the others. As leader it was my job to exercise caution. Now it is yours. We are dependin' on you."
"I think we need to be careful. There is a mystery here, and your weapon is all wrapped up in it."
"Just don't be afraid to ask for help. That's how we might just survive these perilous times. That and with a bit of luck."
"As the leader you need to keep your mind open to suggestions from your followers, otherwise you'll just make the same mistakes I did."
"Ack, there's nothin' to bring a person down more than a bloody, awful death! I'll try to do better and not die on you again. No promises though! You ready to go?"
"Blast it! I said I'd try not to die again. What more can you ask a man?"
"Good, and <FirstName>? Try not to give me any orders that lead me straight into Mistress Death's realm, right-oh? Here we go."
"Just stay away from me, you ripe fool! I've nothin' to say to you."
"What I would nae give for a strong draft of ale right now."
"Right. I'll try to contain my enthusiasm."
"Jaboli, do you remember that time when you fell off that castle wall and landed in the moat?"
She glares at Calibast. "I seem to recall that someone was supposed to be holding the rope!"
"I didn't think you'd actually let go of the wall, but that's not what I wanted to talk about. When you landed in the water, I was shocked."
"I don't have a head that is constantly on fire. A little water doesn't bother me."
"Oh, a little dousin' won't put out my flames, let me reassure you of that. But that is not what I meant."
"Oh, I get it. This is another 'cat' topic. Cats usually hate water, so I too should hate water. As I have said a thousand times before, I am not a cat! I enjoy swimming."
"You really are a disagreeable woman! That's not what I meant either."
"My apologies. I should not jump to conclusions. Please, what were you going to say?"
"Just that when you came out of the water, your robe was very... clingy. I was shocked at how nice your... physique was."
"And if anyone would notice a fine female body, it would be you."
"Bash the livin' blazes out of doors and chests. Got it."
"Exactly. I just wanted you to know that you really are quite attractive... for a cat." Calibast starts laughing uncontrollably.
Jaboli rolls her eyes. "Men!"
"I was just wonderin', Jaboli, do you hate dogs?"
"I have neither a great fondness for them, nor an abnormal hatred or fear of them. Why do you ask?"
"I should think that it would be obvious. I mean, I guess there are a few cats and dogs that get along, but on the whole they tend to feud for the most part."
"What is it with you people that you seem to think that just because I have similar... features to a cat, that it means I really am a cat?"
"It could be that when you get mad you kind of make a hissin' noise and when you are happy... well, you purr."
Jaboli stares daggers at Calibast.
"Well, I was just goin' to say that I like cats. Not everybody does, you know. I knew a guy once who would go out of his way to get within kickin' distance of a cat. I'm not that way."
"Obviously you are cut of a finer cloth than your friend. Not fine enough to recognize the difference between a cat and a rakshasa, sadly."
"Good. Tell me where to stand."
"You don't have to take offense. I was just wantin' you to know that I thought you are a fine-lookin' female, for a cat."
"I always thought you were such a smooth talker, Calibast. But such a clumsy attempt to flirt with me tells me you must be losing your touch."
"You've been dyin' for a chance to say that, haven't you?"
Jaboli just hisses at the two of you and turns away.
"I was tryin' to get along. That was why I was tryin' to compliment her. But no... she's got to get all catty on me."
"How long have you been saving that one?"
"Several days, but it was worth it." He winks at her.
Jaboli just hisses at him and turns away.
"I'm hurt. I was just tryin' to give her a compliment. But no... she's got to get all catty on me.""
"Hey, Kaidala! I think you dropped somethin' back behind you."
"I'll do what I can for you."
"I did? Where? What did I drop?"
"Ah, you were right, <FirstName>. Nothin' more beautiful from where I'm standin'."
"What?"
He winks at you, then leers at Kaidala again. "Come on, lass. You're a nymph, or at least you used to be. Have you forgotten your roots?"
"Of course I haven't forgotten my roots!"
"What a sweet girl you are!" They both look at your face and then start to laugh.
"Sorry, <FirstName>. We were just having a little fun with you."
"Hoo! You should have seen your face. Now that's what I call fun!"
"How long have we been adventurin' together, Kaidala? Why do you stare at me with that look of horror still?"
"I am sorry, Calibast. I don't mean to offend you. It is just the constant flames on your head... they live in my mind, still burning my own face."
"Jump right in and beat them all down to size, eh? Right, that's my favorite tactic. I never get killed doin' that one."
"But fire is beautiful. Yes, it is also destructive and dangerous, but without it, most would not survive."
"Nature keeps me warm, even in the depths of winter. I eat fruit and vegetables and nuts, so I have no need to cook food with it. Fire holds no gifts for me."
"Fire allows us to make weapons and armor. Fire provides light. Even you could not survive without the sun!"
"The sun... yes, it is true that my kind need the sun. And when part of a forest burns, what is left behind fertilizes the area and helps new plants grow. I am wary of fire, but I do not hate it."
"So it is specific to the fact that my head is burnin'?"
"It is. Yes."
"In all the time we have been together, you have never touched my head."
"I... I don't think I could do that."
"Come, just lay your hand on my cheek. I promise I won't hurt you."
She hesitantly reaches out. "Oh... um... it's cool... like touching regular flesh."
"Right. Protect the <class>. I've played this game before."
"You are. The flames are controllable, so I can cool them for others, but they never hurt me. My entire body is immune to the touches of fire."
"I guess that might help, a little. It still doesn't stop my memories."
"I know, but hopefully now you can look at me without that look of total repugnance. Actually, the touch of your hand is very gentle. A lot can be said in a single touch."
"Oh, sorry about that. Old habits die hard, I suppose."
"Trip, I fear I have done you a disservice, lad. My guilty conscience must be purged."
"Trip is not sure what you are talking about, Calibast. What is this conscience thing you speak of?"
"Mmm, well, not important. Not surprised you don't really know, but that's not what I wanted to tell you."
"That makes no sense to Trip, but go ahead."
"I have to admit that I once saw a wookalar. It was very much alive and more fearsome than anythin' I had ever seen, or have seen since."
"Then there is another one? There really is? Oh, joy! Trip was right!"
"I'm pretty sure I can dress myself, but if you have suggestions... well, go ahead. Just don't be peekin' at anythin' you shouldn't!"
"Yes, but the reason that I didn't want to talk about it, is that the... um... creature is drawn to people that talk about it."
"Really? But Trip has talked about it many times before and yet never seen one." Trip's whiskers start to tremble.
"You have!? How many times have you said the name?" Calibast begins to look frantically.
"Trip is not so sure. Maybe fifty times." Trip starts to look very nervous.
"Fifty?" Calibast whistles. "That's just about how many times my brother talked about it when the creature came out of the shadows for him!"
Trip starts glancing about nervously. "You lost your brother to a wookalar?"
"You said it again! What are you tryin' to do, get us all killed?"
"Sorry! Trip is sorry! I did not mean to say it again."
"Wait! Shh. What was that? Did you hear it, <FirstName>?"
"Oh no, eek!"
"I doubt I'll know much more than you would, but I'll give it a try."
"It's over there, behind you, Trip!"
"Well, that was fun."
"Ack, you are too soft on the lad! It was only a joke."
"You would joke about such a thing? That is so cruel, Calibast! Trip is ashamed of your actions. How could you be so mean?"
Calibast looks a little guilty. "Oh, fine, I'm sorry. Now, forget about it and lets go do some more killin'!"
"Watch where you're goin', you flea-infested, giant mouse."
"What did Trip do now? Why you always got to be so mean to me?"
"You bloody-well almost tripped me, that's what you did! I suppose you got your name from the number of people you've tripped in your life?"
"Oh, no. Trip is named after the smallest hero ever who also happened to destroy the worst monster ever."
"You're full of lies and deceit. I have never heard of a hero named Trip."
"Seems like as good a time as any for a break. Could you pass the wine? Just kiddin'. No drinkin' on duty, I suppose."
"Sorry, <master/mistress>. Trip only tries to answer big flame-head."
"I was just askin' ratman a question. No need to get touchy."
"Trip is telling the truth! There was a little half-fellow named Tripcanticius who defeated the most dreadful monster in the world... the horrible wookalar!"
"There is no such thing as a wookalar! That's only a myth."
"No such beast now, but when the first Trip was alive, the wookalar was the most dangerous of all the monsters in the land."
"And you think I'm supposed to believe in this creature that had tusks, a pig's snout, and long, sharp nails that could reach up through your nose and pull out your brains?"
"Wow, you know lots about the wookalar. Have you met a wookalar? Maybe your home has wookalars?"
"THERE IS NO SUCH THING AS A WOOKALAR! It isn't real! It's a myth! Get it through your head! I just made that tripe up!"
"But then how come you just described one perfectly?"
"Just... get... away... from... me." He fumes and stomps his feet in aggravation.
"Ack, now this is fun! Heaps of wee bonnie creatures to maim and mangle."
"And how else can I help you now?"
"What? Is my head out? Hmm... nope. Seem to be fine, thanks."
"Anything else?"
"I grow weary of walkin'. Don't suppose you've learned to fly yet?"
"The smell of death is in the air. Let's go make a little for ourselves!"
"More killin', less talkin'!"
"I need a drink, next question?"
"Can't complain, nobody'd listen anyways!"
"I feel like a young wolf in a field of old deer. Pleasantly surprised and ready to give chase."
"Be fine if'n I could see a blasted thing!"
"What kind of a ragtag army is this? Pathetic!"
"I've been cut worse in many a tavern brawl. Don't be worryin' about me."
"I'm not keelin' over, if that's your worry."
"I could be doin' better. How about you?"
"Never could stand a fellow who used poison. Now I remember why."
"My stomach does nae feel so good. I only hope the flames on me head don't catch!"
Calibast chuckles. "I will stay around as long as you need and want me too. Azers have long lives, so eventually I will probably try to go home and see if things have changed."
"I would like a little revenge, but I'm in no rush. In the meantime, I hope you still want me around. This keep needs a few improvements."
"There are a couple of powerful rulers on my home plane. They took everythin' from me and someday I shall pay them back in kind."
"I have some plans, but that can wait for the future. Makin' the keep strong right now is far more important. My improvements should help."
Calibast shrugs, "I have some plans, but that can wait for the future. Makin' the keep strong right now is far more important. My improvements should help."
"Bet you could get loads of firewood out of that tree."
"I have a great deal of experience with defendin' and attackin' fortifications. For a start, some large, stake-filled pits around the walls and a barbican near the gates would help."
"If it is possible, I would like to divert some of the nearby river to fill a moat, which would help stop more miners from diggin under the walls."
"There are many different ways to make a castle more defendable. Some are more expensive, while some are quite easy and cheap."
"Well, those are just a few of my ideas. There are many tricks to slow enemies and make a castle easier to defend."
"Since you seem so sure of yourself, perhaps you won't want me around as long as I had hoped."
"We should get goin' again. Plenty more to do before we can start makin' changes to the keep."
"A barbican is an expanse of killin' ground, with a maze-like area to slow invaders who get inside the gates."
"A couple towers on either side would allow defenders to fire down into the kill zone and destroy many enemies."
"The barbican would be the most expensive, though they seem to have some good stoneworkers and masons here in the keep, judgin' by the defenses in place."
"The pits and stakes and a moat are less expensive, just labor intensive. There be enough people in this keep to do the job fairly quickly, if everyone able could help out."
"There's got to be some good taverns in this keep. We should find them all!"
"Thank you. That's really just a start. See, with a shortage of defenders, it is more important than ever to have a good assortment of artificial defenses."
Calibast smiles. "I am glad to hear that. I have had an idea. Maybe when you tire of rulin' this place, or when you have reached a pinnacle of power, maybe you could help me get revenge."
"In return for your help, I'll help you improve the keep and make it strong."
"The priestess was called Wren Bloodstone. I'll always remember that, because it seemed like such a gentle, sweet name. I was only there for a week before the first attack."
"I was only her general for a single war, but that was enough. I was more cautious than she had been in previous wars, which chafed at her a little. She wanted to attack the day after I arrived."
"Once I had all the information her scouts could provide, I marched my little army into the next town. I had planned strategies and followed my trainin', expectin' the worst."
He shrugs. "If that is the way you feel, I understand."
