Text: "가까이 있어."

TextEng: "How is that perplexing?"
"Yes. That is rather frightening."
"Tell me if you come up with anything."
"That's nonsense! I don't believe it."
"That's just great. Who wants to vote for the evil one?"
"You think I am a devil?"
"But we know the Masked Man is an illithid."
"You think the Masked Man might be a demon."
"I doubt it, but I'll be careful."
"I shall keep that in mind."
"And I thought Trip was crazy!"
"You're just paranoid!"
"Go ahead and attack as soon as you see enemies."
Text: "적이 보이면 바로 공격해."

TextEng: "Is there anything I can do to help?"
"Quit wasting my time with this nonsense."
"What about it?"
"I like your thinking. Yes... treasure!"
"You aren't normally the gold digger of the group."
"The only reason you want it is for treasure?"
"It sounds too dangerous to waste time on."
<StartCheck>[Insight]</Start> "You are hedging around something. What else is there?"
"I don't care about that, but the treasure sounds good."
"I guess those are good reasons."
"I guess we should be going."
"Right."
"*Our* new home?"
"Defend me and don't attack until I do."
Text: "나를 방어하고, 내가 공격할 때까지 공격하지 마."

TextEng: "What does that mean?"
Text: "그게 무슨 뜻이야?"

TextEng: "*We* own the house?"
"I like your thinking. Yes... treasure!"
"You aren't normally the gold digger of the group."
"The only reason you want it is for treasure?"
"It sounds too dangerous to waste time on."
<StartCheck>[Insight]</Start> "You are hedging around something. What else is there?"
"I don't care about that, but the treasure sounds good."
"I guess those are good reasons."
"I guess we should be going."
"What does that mean?"
Text: "그게 무슨 뜻이야?"

TextEng: "I don't care about your hunches. It's probably just stomach cramps."
"I guess it would be kind of nice to have our own private quarters."
"We'll see."
"I want to adjust your equipment."
Text: "네 장비를 조정하고 싶어."

TextEng: "I think we should trust your hunch."
"I don't want to hear about this right now."
Text: "지금은 그 이야기 듣고 싶지 않아."

TextEng: "I guess you have a point. Where should we start?"
"First I become the <lord/lady>, then we worry about the Masked Man."
"We choose our own destinies. Nothing can force us to do what we would not do."
"I know, the same thought crossed my mind."
"Good idea. I'll give that a try."
"I don't really want to take any chances."
"How do we test the limits?"
"You worry too much. Whatever comes, comes."
"What is wrong with you now?"
"Quit yelling, Jaboli."
"Jaboli, what are you talking about?"
"Jaboli, why are you getting so excited?"
"Never mind."
Text: "신경 쓰지 마."

TextEng: "Can you identify my equipment?"
Text: "내 장비를 감정해 줄 수 있어?"

TextEng: "You must protect the innocents of the keep!"
"Jaboli, the keep needs you as their Banner!"
<StartCheck>[Intimidate]</Start> "You will stay and help me finish what we started, or you are a traitor!"
<StartCheck>[Bluff]</Start> "But I am trying to change, Jaboli."
<StartCheck>[Persuade]</Start> "You must fight the voice, Jaboli!"
"You coward! You stay with me or I'll end your life now!"
"Jaboli, I am your friend. Trust me, just one last time."
"Very well. I release you, Jaboli. Do as you must."
"I need your help. Just this one last mission, and then you can go where you want."
"I need you to cast a group of buffing spells."
"Yes, let's go."
Text: "그래, 가자."

TextEng: "No, just stay here for now."
Text: "아니, 지금은 여기 있어."

TextEng: "Never mind."
Text: "신경 쓰지 마."

TextEng: "What do you mean she's the smartest? I'm just as smart."
"You'll have to help yourself, Trip."
"Time to stop being such a coward, Trip."
"Cast all the buffing spells you have."
"Can you try to help him, Jaboli?"
"Cast all the buffing spells that last a long time."
"Cast all the short duration buffing spells."
"I've changed my mind."
Text: "마음이 바뀌었어."

TextEng: "I am standing right here, you know!"
"Cast on all the party members."
Text: "파티원 전원에게 시전해."

TextEng: "I'd like to interrupt here."
"Can I say something?"
<StartAction>[Remain silent.]</Start>
"Cast it on <CUSTOM77104>."
Text: "<CUSTOM77104>에게 시전해."

TextEng: "Will you two stop arguing?"
"Jaboli, leave her be."
"I think we need to part ways."
Text: "이제 헤어져야 할 것 같아."

TextEng: "Cast it on <CUSTOM77103>."
Text: "<CUSTOM77103>에게 시전해."

TextEng: "Jaboli has a point."
"Cast it on <CUSTOM77102>."
Text: "<CUSTOM77102>에게 시전해."

TextEng: "Who cares about this. We have work to do!"
"Of course it wasn't your fault, Calibast."
"Cast it on <CUSTOM77101>."
Text: "<CUSTOM77101>에게 시전해."

TextEng: "Just don't let it interfere with my plans."
"Suck it up, princess. We've got work to do."
"If you need help dealing with it, I'm here for you, Calibast."
"Maybe it was his fault."
"Cast it on my animal companion."
Text: "내 동물 동료에게 시전해."

TextEng: "I couldn't care less, as long as it doesn't interfere with our job."
"I think I'll be able to tame him."
"It disgusts me."
"I enjoy it."
"Cast it on my familiar."
Text: "내 사역마에게 시전해."

TextEng: "Cast it on me."
Text: "나에게 시전해."

TextEng: "Cast it on yourself."
Text: "네 자신에게 시전해."

TextEng: "I need you to cast a spell."
"Never mind."
Text: "신경 쓰지 마."

TextEng: "No, never mind."
Text: "아니, 신경 쓰지 마."

TextEng: "Wounding Whispers."
"Ultravision."
Text: "초시야."

TextEng: "True Seeing."
Text: "진실의 시야."

TextEng: "Summon Creature IX."
"Summon Creature VIII."
Summon Creature VII."
"Summon Creature VI."
"Summon Creature V."
"Summon Creature IV."
"Summon Creature III."
"Wait here until I return."
Text: "내가 돌아올 때까지 여기서 기다려."

TextEng: "Summon Creature II."
"Summon Creature I."
"Stoneskin."
Text: "돌 피부."

TextEng: "Spell Resistance."
Text: "주문 저항."

TextEng: "Spell Mantle."
Text: "주문 망토."

TextEng: "Shield of Faith."
Text: "믿음의 방패."

TextEng: "Shield."
Text: "방패."

TextEng: "Shadow Shield."
Text: "그림자 방패."

TextEng: "See Invisibility."
Text: "투명 간파."

TextEng: "Sanctuary."
"Restoration."
"Resistance."
Text: "저항."

TextEng: "Resist Elements."
"Remove Paralysis."
"Remove Fear."
"Remove Disease."
"Remove Curse."
"Remove Blindness/Deafness."
"Regenerate."
Text: "재생."

TextEng: "Protection From Spells."
"I need to go."
Text: "가야 해."

TextEng: "Protection From Elements."
"Premonition."
Text: "예감."

TextEng: "Prayer."
"Owl's Wisdom."
"Neutralize poison."
"Monstrous Regeneration."
"Minor Globe of Invulnerability."
"Mind Blank."
"Mass Haste."
"Magical Vestment."
"Life grows dull without you. I need your spark to help me feel that life might have some purpose. May I come with you again?"
Text: "당신이 없으면 삶이 너무 무료해요. 살 만한 가치가 있다는 걸 느끼게 해 줄 당신의 불꽃이 필요해요."

TextEng: "Being brought back to life leaves me feeling empty. Do as you will; abandon me if you must."
Text: "되살아나고 나니 공허한 느낌이 드네요. 원하시는 대로 하세요. 저를 버리든 데리고 가든. 아무래도 상관없어요."

TextEng: "Too bad these people don't spend as much time taking care of the world the gods made them as they do in this temple."
Text: "이 사람들이 신이 준 세상을 가꾸는 데 반만큼이라도 신경 썼다면 좋을 텐데요."

TextEng: She smiles hesitantly and touches your face with her soft hand. "Some say that love must be blind. I guess they must be right."
Text: 그녀가 망설이며 미소 짓더니, 부드러운 손으로 당신의 얼굴을 만집니다. "어떤 이들은 사랑이란 가장 확실할 때조차 위태롭다고 해요."

TextEng: "We should get going again. There is much to be done."
Text: "다시 출발해야 해요. 할 일이 많으니까요."

TextEng: "If you would really want to. I would certainly welcome you as a visitor, and should you choose to stay... but that is the future."
Text: "정말 그러고 싶으시다면요. 손님으로는 기꺼이 맞이할게요, 그리고 어쩌면 우리 사이에 자라날 수 있는 것도..."

TextEng: "It is not my home any longer. Everything I knew is now dead and gone. Even if new trees and creatures could return there, they would not remember me. I will find a true home, someday."
Text: "더 이상 제 고향이 아니에요. 제가 알던 모든 것이 죽고 사라졌어요. 돌아간다 해도요."

TextEng: "I will do what I can to help you, but if you win this election, I'm sure there will be plenty of other people to help you. I doubt you will need me anymore."
Text: "제가 할 수 있는 만큼 도울게요. 하지만 이 선거에서 이기시면, 분명 더 능력 있는 사람들이 주위에 있을 거예요."

TextEng: "That is not to say that I would refuse to help you. If you have real need, I will always be there for you."
Text: "도움을 거부하겠다는 말은 아니에요. 정말 필요하시다면 함께할게요."

TextEng: "You are so hard to understand. I don't know if I will ever really be able to know you. Not as I had once hoped."
Text: "당신은 정말 이해하기 어려운 사람이에요. 과연 당신을 진정으로 알 수 있을지 모르겠어요."

TextEng: "We should be going now. I do hope that you are able to reach your goals. Then maybe you will help me reach mine."
Text: "이제 가야 해요. 목표에 도달하실 수 있기를 바라요. 그러면 아마 우리 모두에게 좋은 날이 올 거예요."

TextEng: "Perhaps you have heard of the Gai Zan? They are a cult of zealots who believe that the emperor is the chosen of the gods and will someday become a god himself."
Text: "혹시 가이잔이라고 들어보셨나요? 그들은 세상에 위험이 될 만한 존재를 사냥하고 파괴하는 것을 삶의 목적으로 삼는 광신도 집단이에요."

TextEng: "Their one purpose in life is to hunt and destroy any who might become a danger to their ruler."
Text: "그들의 유일한 삶의 목적은 세상에 위험이 될 수 있는 존재를 사냥하고 파괴하는 것이에요."

TextEng: "They are destroying each other, as all perversions of nature eventually must."
Text: "그들은 서로를 파괴하고 있어요. 자연의 왜곡은 결국 그렇게 되기 마련이니까요."

TextEng: She shrugs. "It is hard to relive those moments." She sighs and turns away.
Text: 그녀가 어깨를 으쓱합니다. "그 순간을 다시 떠올리기가 힘들어요." 한숨을 쉬며 고개를 돌립니다.

TextEng: "The Gai Zan are led by a supposed prophet. This prophet claimed that there was one from my forest who would rise up and assist the evil one destroy the emperor."
Text: "가이잔은 자칭 예언자가 이끌어요. 이 예언자는 황제를 파괴할 악이 있다고 주장했어요."

TextEng: "It was nothing that I did. The Gai Zan are led by a supposed prophet. This prophet claimed that there was one from my forest who would rise up and assist the evil one to destroy the emperor."
Text: "제가 한 일이 아니에요. 가이잔은 자칭 예언자가 이끌어요. 이 예언자는 황제를 파괴할 악이 있다고 주장했죠."

TextEng: "I'm not sure who the evil one was supposed to be, but they take those sort of prophesies very seriously. They came to the village that lay close to my forest and began torturing the peasants."
Text: "그 악이 누구를 가리키는지는 모르겠지만, 그들은 그런 예언을 매우 심각하게 받아들여요."

TextEng: "Some of the peasants knew I lived in the woods, from past... encounters. They convinced the Gai Zan that I must be the one from the prophesy."
Text: "농민 중 일부가 제가 숲에 사는 걸 알고 있었어요. 예전에... 만난 적이 있었거든요. 그들이 가이잔에게 알린 거예요."

TextEng: "I should be mad at them, but they were trying to save their own lives, and the lives of their families. I don't blame them. I blame the perpetrators of the crime."
Text: "그들에게 화를 내야 하는데, 그들도 목숨을 구하려 한 것이었고, 가이잔의 보복이 두려웠을 테니까요."

TextEng: "That hardly seems likely. I would have no reason to cause the emperor harm."
Text: "그건 말이 안 돼요. 제가 황제에게 해를 끼칠 이유가 없잖아요."

TextEng: "One of the peasant girls that I had once helped ran to warn me. As soon as the zealots realized that I was a nymph and could possibly kill them or control them, they made their choice."
Text: "예전에 제가 도와준 농민 소녀 하나가 달려와서 경고해 주었어요. 가이잔이 도착하자마자요."

TextEng: "They must have used magic to enhance their fire, for I have never seen a blaze move so fast or with so much purpose towards a goal. But... but you know the rest."
Text: "불을 강화하는 마법을 쓴 게 틀림없어요. 그렇게 무시무시한 화염은 본 적이 없거든요."

TextEng: She begins to weep. "I cannot speak anymore of that night. It is too hard. Even now I feel the flames licking at my face and burning my hair."
Text: 그녀가 울기 시작합니다. "그 밤의 이야기를 더는 못 하겠어요. 너무 힘들어요. 이렇게 오랜 시간이 지났는데도요."

TextEng: "I understand why you bought this place, but I do hope you'll buy a few plants to liven it up."
Text: "왜 이 곳을 샀는지는 알겠지만, 거기에 맞게 식물도 좀 들여주시면 좋겠어요."

TextEng: "Yes, yes. That is for the best."
Text: "네, 네. 그게 가장 좋겠어요."

TextEng: "I am sorry. You must hate me for being so soft. I shall try to be strong for you. I know you do not need any more burdens."
Text: "미안해요. 이렇게 약한 모습이 싫으시겠죠. 당신을 위해 강해지려 노력할게요."

TextEng: "You make it sound so easy, yet I am sure there must be things in your past that haunt you. You wanted me to tell you; I did not bring it up."
Text: "말로 하면 쉬워 보이지만, 당신도 과거에 잊고 싶은 일이 있을 거예요."

TextEng: "We should be going now."
Text: "이제 가야 해요."

TextEng: "I thank you for that. I don't know that you could prevent it, though. Still, it helps having you around."
Text: "그 말에 감사해요. 막을 수 있을지는 모르겠지만, 그래도 그런 마음이 위로가 돼요."

TextEng: "We should be going now. Thanks for listening to me."
Text: "이제 가야 해요. 제 이야기를 들어줘서 고마워요."

TextEng: "Trip ran into the Gai Zan one time also. They didn't taste too bad, for zealots."
Text: "트립이 한번은 가이잔과 마주친 적이 있었대요. 광신도치고는 맛이 나쁘지 않았다고요."

TextEng: "Considering that as part of their lifestyle they refuse to bathe, I'm surprised you could get close enough to eat them."
Text: "그들의 생활 방식에 목욕을 거부하는 것도 포함되어 있으니, 그가 놀라지 않은 것도 신기하죠."

TextEng: "When you're hungry, you're hungry. What else can I say?"
Text: "배고프면 배고픈 거지. 뭐라 더 할 말이 있겠어요?"

TextEng: "A zealot does not think rationally. It is their trademark that they always overreact to a situation."
Text: "광신도는 이성적으로 생각하지 못해요. 언제나 과잉 반응하는 게 그들의 특징이죠."

TextEng: "I don't see what is so special about this woman. She lives in splendor and has nice hair. Who cares?"
Text: "이 여자가 뭐가 그리 특별한지 모르겠어요. 호화롭게 살면서 아직도 더 원하다니."

TextEng: "I don't know. Kaidala is quite a troublemaker. Imagine if she could kill you with a glance? I'm already frightened she might smother me with affection!"
Text: "모르겠는데요. 카이달라는 꽤 말썽쟁이잖아요. 눈빛 하나로 사람을 죽일 수 있다면 어떻게 될지 상상해 보세요."

TextEng: "And you had better stay afraid, Calibast. I have ample means of dousing your fire!"
Text: "겁이나 계속 먹고 있어, 캘리바스트. 네 불장난을 끌 방법은 얼마든지 있으니까."

TextEng: "That life seems so far removed from where we are today. I can't say that I truly miss it, though. Except my tree. I miss my tree with an ache that I cannot even begin to describe."
Text: "그때의 삶이 지금과는 너무 동떨어져 있어요. 그 삶을 그리워하는지도 잘 모르겠어요."

TextEng: "I never really had any friends. Not like I do now." She smiles at you as she says this.
Text: "진짜 친구라고 할 만한 존재가 없었어요. 지금처럼은요." 그녀가 그 말을 하며 당신에게 미소 짓습니다.

TextEng: "It was a different life, and I was a different person. I didn't really miss the fact that I had no friends, most of the time. I could always use my charms to ensnare a little company."
Text: "다른 삶이었고, 다른 사람이었어요. 물질적인 것은 별로 그립지 않았지만, 외로울 때도 있었어요."

TextEng: "If you are simply going to insult me, then don't ask me to share my past with you."
Text: "그냥 모욕하려고 물어본 거면, 제 과거를 공유해 달라고 하지 마세요."

TextEng: "None of the forest creatures could really be called my friends. Nymphs don't tend to live close to each other. Too much competition."
Text: "숲 생명체 중 진정한 친구라 부를 만한 존재는 없었어요. 님프는 친구가 되기엔 너무 제멋대로거든요."

TextEng: "Dryads are too flighty to be good friends, though we did share some time together. The animals were probably my closest friends, but they live at a different speed. It was hard to become close."
Text: "드라이어드는 너무 변덕스러워서 좋은 친구가 되긴 어렵지만, 함께 시간을 보내기도 했어요."

TextEng: "The closest I ever came to a friendship was with a druid. But I don't think you could even count him as a friend."
Text: "친구에 가장 가까웠던 건 한 드루이드였어요. 하지만 제 이야기를 들으시면 흥미로워하실지 모르겠네요."

TextEng: "It wasn't really much of a relationship. I suppose I had a strange sort of rapport with him, but it's actually kind of embarrassing."
Text: "사실 그렇게 대단한 관계는 아니었어요. 이상한 교감 같은 것이었죠."

TextEng: "Who has more right to live here, one landowner, or an entire tribe of goblins?"
Text: "땅 주인 한 명과 고블린 부족 전체, 여기 살 권리가 더 큰 쪽은 누구일까요?"

TextEng: "As a druid, he knew what my kind was like, and not wanting to expose himself to the dangers of being around a nymph, he cast a protective spell on his encampment against fey."
Text: "드루이드라서 제가 어떤 존재인지 알고 있었고, 위험에 노출되고 싶지 않아서요."

TextEng: "He also avoided any part of the forest that he thought I might occupy, and the animals took it as a game to try to help him."
Text: "그는 제가 있을 것 같은 숲 지역을 피했고, 제가 그의 보호 구역 안에 들어오지 못하도록 했어요."

TextEng: "I wouldn't call it hurting him... no. It was other things that he was trying to avoid."
Text: "해를 끼쳤다고 하긴 어렵고요... 아니요. 그가 피하려 한 건 다른 것이었어요."

TextEng: "At first I was merely curious about him, but when I realized that he was actively avoiding me, I began to try in earnest."
Text: "처음에는 그냥 호기심이었는데, 그가 적극적으로 저를 피한다는 걸 알게 되자 더 관심이 생겼어요."

TextEng: "Finally, after many attempts, I was able to trick him into inviting me into his encampment."
Text: "여러 번의 시도 끝에, 그를 속여서 자기 오두막으로 초대하게 만들었어요."

TextEng: "I figured that he would only speak to animals, and I wanted to appear as an animal he would be curious about, so I concentrated all of my magical energies and turned into a chicken."
Text: "그는 동물하고만 대화할 거라고 생각했거든요. 그래서 동물처럼 보이고 싶었어요."

TextEng: She giggles. "Why, thank you, <FirstName>. I bet you would make some quality poultry yourself. But do you understand my reasoning?"
Text: 그녀가 킥킥 웃습니다. "오, 고마워요, <FirstName>. 분명 근사한 가금류가 되었을 거예요."

TextEng: "How many chickens do you see in a forest setting? I figured that he would spot me and think I was lost. I was right."
Text: "숲에서 닭을 얼마나 자주 보겠어요? 제가 바로 들킬 거라 생각했는데, 실제로 그랬어요."

TextEng: "He took me back and invited me into his encampment, nullifying his protective spells. But when I got there, I found I was too frightened of revealing myself in my true form."
Text: "그가 저를 데리고 야영지로 돌아가 초대했어요. 그의 보호 주문이 무력화된 거죠."

TextEng: "Yes. I was afraid of his reaction. I didn't want to have to use my powers to capture his mind or worse, to kill him."
Text: "네. 그의 반응이 두려웠어요. 제 힘을 써서 그를 매혹시키고 싶지 않았거든요."

TextEng: "This place smells of death! Please, let us not tarry here long."
Text: "이곳은 죽음 냄새가 나요! 제발 오래 머물지 말아요."

TextEng: "Not of him hurting me. I was afraid of his reaction. I didn't want to have to use my powers to capture his mind or worse, to kill him."
Text: "그가 저를 해칠까 봐 두려운 게 아니었어요. 그의 반응이 두려웠어요. 제 힘을 써서 그를 매혹시키고 싶지 않았거든요."

TextEng: "He was chattering on about life in the forest and acting very protectively towards me. I just sat there and radiated pleasant thoughts. When he went to bed that night, I went back to my home."
Text: "그는 숲 생활에 대해 수다를 떨며 저를(닭인 줄 알고) 매우 보호적으로 대했어요."

TextEng: "I was determined to return the next day and reveal my true identity, but I didn't. I went back for almost two weeks, remaining disguised, fearing to be rejected by this strange human."
Text: "다음 날 진짜 모습을 보여주기로 했는데, 그러지 못했어요."

TextEng: "I don't know for sure. It might explain what happened. One day I came to his encampment and he was gone. I never saw him again."
Text: "잘 모르겠어요. 그럴 수도 있고요. 어느 날 야영지에 갔더니 그가 없었어요."

TextEng: "One day I came to his encampment and he was gone. I never saw him again."
Text: "어느 날 야영지에 갔더니 그가 없었어요. 다시는 보지 못했어요."

TextEng: "I suppose I did. It didn't matter in the end. One day I came to his encampment and he was gone. I never saw him again."
Text: "그랬던 것 같아요. 하지만 결국 소용없었어요. 어느 날 야영지에 갔더니 그가 없었고, 다시는 보지 못했어요."

TextEng: "Maybe he would have returned, but shortly after that, my forest was destroyed. I don't know what ever became of my druid. Probably I never will."
Text: "어쩌면 돌아왔을 수도 있지만, 그 직후에 제 숲이 파괴되었거든요."

TextEng: "But these are melancholy thoughts. Let's turn our attention back to more important things."
Text: "하지만 이건 우울한 이야기네요. 더 중요한 일에 집중해요."

TextEng: "That is just as well. It is a little embarrassing to tell the truth."
Text: "괜찮아요. 사실 말하기 좀 창피한 이야기거든요."

TextEng: "It wasn't really much of a relationship. I suppose I had a strange sort of rapport with him, but it's actually kind of embarrassing."
Text: "사실 그렇게 대단한 관계는 아니었어요. 이상한 교감 같은 것이었죠."

TextEng: "I wonder if we are doing the right thing, hunting this creature. I suppose it hunts other creatures, so maybe it's just the circle of life."
Text: "이 생물을 사냥하는 것이 옳은 일인지 모르겠어요. 그래도 많은 해를 끼쳤으니까요."

TextEng: "Life grows dull without you. I need your spark to help me feel that life might have some purpose. May I come with you again?"
Text: "당신이 없으면 삶이 너무 무료해요. 살 만한 가치가 있다는 걸 느끼게 해 줄 당신의 불꽃이 필요해요."

TextEng: "Life grows dull without you. I need your spark to help me feel that life might have some purpose. May I come with you again?"
Text: "당신이 없으면 삶이 너무 무료해요. 살 만한 가치가 있다는 걸 느끼게 해 줄 당신의 불꽃이 필요해요."

TextEng: "Then leave me to my melancholy contemplations. Seeing you only makes it hurt worse."
Text: "그럼 저를 우울한 사색에 남겨두세요. 당신을 보면 더 아프기만 해요."

TextEng: "Perhaps there are some pleasant times ahead of us again."
Text: "어쩌면 우리 앞에 다시 즐거운 시간이 있을지도 몰라요."

TextEng: "If you can spare me a moment, I should like to speak with you."
Text: "잠깐 시간을 내 주시겠어요? 드릴 말씀이 있어요."

TextEng: "If that is your desire, I will not intrude right now."
Text: "그게 당신의 뜻이라면, 지금은 방해하지 않을게요."

TextEng: "Were you beaten as a child or just born mean?"
Text: "어릴 때 맞고 자랐어요, 아니면 원래 그렇게 못되게 태어난 건가요?"

TextEng: "I can be insulting too. Uh... um... you're ugly and your mother dresses you funny... <StartAction>[sigh]</Start>."
Text: "나도 모욕할 수 있어요. 음... 어... 당신은 못생겼고 당신 어머니는 당신 옷을 우스꽝스럽게 입혀요!"

TextEng: "If I am so ugly and so hard to listen to, then why keep me around? Sadistic?"
Text: "제가 그렇게 못생기고 듣기 싫다면, 왜 곁에 두는 건가요? 가학적인 건가요?"

TextEng: "That depends on if you treat me like a tool or a friend."
Text: "그건 저를 도구로 대하느냐 친구로 대하느냐에 달렸어요."

TextEng: "I like that we are here to rescue some of nature's simple creatures. It makes me feel... happy."
Text: "자연의 소박한 생명체를 구하러 왔다니 기분이 좋아요."

TextEng: "I feel so cold and alone when you say such things to me."
Text: "당신이 그런 말을 하면 너무 춥고 외로워져요."

TextEng: "I didn't ask to be here, so you can just keep your cruel comments to yourself."
Text: "여기 와 달라고 한 건 제가 아니에요. 그러니 잔인한 말은 혼자 하세요."

TextEng: "It is time for healing, my dearest friend. We must go to my tree and rest beneath its sheltering branches."
Text: "치유의 시간이에요, 소중한 친구여. 제 나무에 가서 그 아래에서 쉬어야 해요."

TextEng: "I need this bonding time with my tree if I am to regain more of my powers. I know you are busy, but, please. Let's go soon."
Text: "힘을 더 되찾으려면 나무와의 유대가 필요해요. 바쁘신 건 알지만, 이건 정말 중요해요."

TextEng: "If that is your decision, I shall abide by it, though it brings me great sorrow."
Text: "그게 당신의 결정이라면 따르겠지만, 큰 슬픔이에요."

TextEng: "It must be soon, my dear one. It must be soon or my tree will become a stranger to me."
Text: "곧이어야 해요, 소중한 이여. 곧 가지 않으면 나무가 저를 낯선 존재로 여길 거예요."

TextEng: She laughs, merrily. "This is going to be great. I will impress you, I promise!"
Text: 그녀가 유쾌하게 웃습니다. "정말 근사할 거예요. 감동시켜 드릴게요, 약속해요!"

TextEng: She laughs, merrily. "This is going to be great. I will impress you, I promise!"
Text: 그녀가 유쾌하게 웃습니다. "정말 근사할 거예요. 감동시켜 드릴게요, 약속해요!"

TextEng: "I can feel my strength growing as my tree grows. Look closely at my face. I think my scars are beginning to heal!"
Text: "나무가 자라면서 제 힘도 커지는 게 느껴져요. 제 얼굴을 잘 보세요. 좀 달라진 것 같지 않아요?"

TextEng: "I know that I shouldn't, but there is nothing wrong with wanting to have back something that was stolen from you, is there? It is important to me. Do you really not see a difference?"
Text: "그러면 안 되는 거 알지만, 예전의 아름다움을 되찾고 싶은 마음은 잘못된 게 아니잖아요."

TextEng: "I hope we can spend more time outside these gates than in. Somehow I doubt it though."
Text: "이 성문 안보다 밖에서 더 많은 시간을 보냈으면 좋겠는데, 그럴 것 같지는 않네요."

TextEng: "I see. Very well. We should continue on."
Text: "그렇군요. 알겠어요. 계속 가요."

TextEng: Kaidala bursts into tears. "How could you speak such words to me? I never wish to see you again!"
Text: 카이달라가 울음을 터뜨립니다. "어떻게 그런 말을 할 수 있어요? 그런 말은 다시는 듣고 싶지 않아요!"

TextEng: "And I love you for that, <FirstName>. I think I have loved you for a long time. Maybe there is love at first sight, though it has taken me a year to realize it."
Text: "그래서 당신을 사랑해요, <FirstName>. 오랫동안 사랑해 온 것 같아요."

TextEng: "I thank you for planting my tree. With time, perhaps I shall regain my former beauty and confidence."
Text: "나무를 심어 주셔서 감사해요. 시간이 지나면 예전의 아름다움을 되찾을 수 있을지도 몰라요."

TextEng: "That is all I wished to say. We should continue on."
Text: "하고 싶은 말은 그게 전부예요. 계속 가요."

TextEng: "Blessed day that you planted my tree! Perhaps someday I shall regain all of my beauty! Oh, <FirstName>, I think I love you!"
Text: "나무를 심어 주신 날은 축복받은 날이에요! 언젠가 모든 힘을 되찾을 수 있을지도 몰라요."

TextEng: "You... you are not reacting as I had hoped. What is wrong, <FirstName>?"
Text: "당신... 제가 기대한 반응이 아니네요. 무슨 문제예요, <FirstName>?"

TextEng: "Oh, <FirstName>, I am so sorry. I... I misread your interest in me. Please forgive me. I shall never speak of this again."
Text: "아, <FirstName>, 정말 미안해요. 제가... 당신의 관심을 잘못 읽은 것 같아요. 용서해 주세요."

TextEng: "Too fast for you! I am a nymph, <FirstName>! We act on impulse and live for the moment. I have been waiting for this time to come for a year now. It has been like an eternity!"
Text: "너무 빠르다고요! 저는 님프예요, <FirstName>! 충동적으로 행동하고 순간을 사는 존재라고요!"

TextEng: "But if this is too fast for you, I shall try to contain myself. I cannot say for how long though. Soon you will have to make up your mind. Soon!"
Text: "하지만 너무 빠르시다면, 자제하도록 노력할게요. 얼마나 오래 버틸 수 있을지는 장담 못 하지만요."

TextEng: "Now perhaps we shall finally discover what this has all been about. That or we're going to have to fight again."
Text: "이제야 이 모든 일의 전말을 알 수 있겠네요. 아니면 또 곤경에 처하겠지만요."

TextEng: "But we can get back to your mission now. I know you have important things on your mind."
Text: "그런데 이제 당신의 임무로 돌아가요. 중요한 일이 있다는 거 알아요."

TextEng: "This is the most wonderful day of my life! I had never imagined a day so wonderful as this! Can it be real? Tell me it is real, <FirstName>!" She giggles then waits expectantly.
Text: "제 인생에서 가장 멋진 날이에요! 이렇게 멋진 날을 상상도 못 했어요!"

TextEng: "She blushes and stammers a little. "Th...thank... thank you!" She grins. "We should get back to solving your problems now. We'll talk, later."
Text: 그녀가 얼굴을 붉히며 더듬거립니다. "고... 고마... 고마워요!" 활짝 웃습니다. "이제 당신의 문제를 해결하러 가요."

TextEng: "It is, isn't it?" She grins. "We should get back to solving your problems now. We'll talk, later."
Text: "그렇죠?" 활짝 웃습니다. "이제 당신의 문제를 해결하러 가요. 먼저 일을 해야 하니까요."

TextEng: "I am afraid this might seem like a strange question, my friend, but are you going to win this election?"
Text: "좀 이상한 질문일 수 있는데요, 선거에 이기실 건가요?"

TextEng: "If that is how you truly feel, then I will make no long-range plans for staying here."
Text: "정말 그렇게 느끼신다면, 장기적인 계획은 세우지 않을게요."

TextEng: "With you, it is sometimes very difficult to decide what is a joke and what is serious."
Text: "당신은 정말 농담과 진담을 구분하기 어려운 사람이에요."

TextEng: "That is all I needed to know. Let's continue on."
Text: "그것만 알면 됐어요. 계속 가요."

TextEng: "And would you like me to continue to be your companion, even once you are the ruler here?"
Text: "그리고 통치자가 된 후에도 제가 동반자로 남기를 원하시나요?"

TextEng: "I know what I desire, but I need you to tell me how you feel. Just tell me, would you like me to stay or go, once you are the ruler of this keep."
Text: "제가 원하는 건 알고 있지만, 당신이 어떻게 느끼는지 말해 주셔야 해요. 그냥 말해 주세요."

TextEng: "I shall do my best to help you stay alive, though my own existence is a burden."
Text: "당신이 살아 있도록 최선을 다하겠지만, 제 존재 자체가 짐이라서요."

TextEng: "There is something about castles that I do not enjoy. Perhaps if we could get a few trees to grow here."
Text: "성에는 뭔가 즐겁지 않은 게 있어요. 식물이라도 좀 들여올 수 있다면 좋을 텐데."

TextEng: "That is unfortunate. I was hoping for something more encouraging than that. Very well, let us continue on."
Text: "아쉽네요. 그보다는 좀 더 격려가 되는 말을 기대했는데요. 알겠어요. 계속 가요."

TextEng: "Then would you do something for me? Before I fled the fire that destroyed my home and my face, I had determined to die with my tree."
Text: "그럼 한 가지 부탁을 들어주시겠어요? 집을 파괴한 불에서 도망칠 때, 한 가지를 가져왔어요."

TextEng: "You would be right, but my family was hunted and killed, and my mother left me with dryads before she was caught. The dryads taught me the magic of their trees, how to gain strength from them."
Text: "맞는 말이지만, 제 가족은 사냥당해 죽었고, 어머니가 한 가지를 남겨 주셨어요."

TextEng: "I became attached to a beautiful oak, tall and strong. The dryads said that the tree chose me because I had similar attributes to an oak. But that was long ago. I am no longer strong and proud like an oak."
Text: "아름답고 크고 강한 떡갈나무에 유대를 맺었어요. 드라이어드들은 그 나무가 수천 년은 살 거라고 했어요."

TextEng: "As the fires closed in, I felt a peculiar sensation... a rubbing of the bark beneath my hands. When I pulled my hand away, a single acorn fell from above, directly into my open palm."
Text: "불이 다가오자, 이상한 감각이... 껍질이 문질러지는 듯한 감각이 느껴졌어요."

TextEng: "I knew then that my tree was bidding me to flee the fires. It was saying goodbye."
Text: "그때 나무가 불을 피해 도망치라고 말하고 있다는 걸 알았어요. 작별 인사를 한 거죠."

TextEng: "Even a tree has the basic, natural urge to see something of its life continue through offspring. I could feel its love for me, more than ever before."
Text: "나무에게도 자기 생명의 일부가 이어지기를 바라는 기본적인 자연의 충동이 있어요."

TextEng: "I took the seed and protected it, but now I am ready to plant it. There is a grove of trees in the hills; I have heard them speaking to me."
Text: "씨앗을 가져와서 보호했지만, 이제 심을 준비가 됐어요. 근처에 아름다운 숲이 있어요."

TextEng: "Would you take this acorn and plant it in the center of the grove, that I might make this my new home?"
Text: "이 도토리를 숲 한가운데에 심어 주시겠어요? 새로운 유대를 맺을 수 있도록요."

TextEng: "There is no other time. It takes time for a tree to grow, even with my help. Please, it is now or never."
Text: "다른 때는 없어요. 나무가 자라려면 시간이 필요하고, 제 도움이 있더라도요. 부탁이에요."

TextEng: "This place makes me wonder if Sir Becket is truly evil, or just a fool with poor taste."
Text: "이곳에 있으니 베켓 경이 진짜 악인인지, 아니면 취향이 나쁜 바보인지 궁금해지네요."

TextEng: "If you cannot figure that out, then I have nothing further to say to you."
Text: "그것도 모르시겠다면, 더 할 말이 없어요."

TextEng: "All I ask is that you plant it. I will do the rest. Is that so much to ask of a friend?"
Text: "심어 달라는 것뿐이에요. 나머지는 제가 할게요. 친구에게 그 정도도 부탁할 수 없나요?"

TextEng: "Then perhaps I have made a mistake. Please forget I ever said anything about it. Let us continue our journey." Kaidala turns sadly away.
Text: "그럼 제가 실수한 거겠죠. 제가 한 말은 잊어 주세요."

TextEng: "Then take good care of my acorn. It is hardy, but, if out of my care for too long, it could become too damaged to grow."
Text: "그럼 도토리를 잘 보관해 주세요. 튼튼하긴 하지만, 제 곁을 너무 오래 떠나면 시들어 버릴 수 있어요."

TextEng: "I could never get a clear answer from the dryads. Their answers would change from time to time."
Text: "드라이어드에게 명확한 답을 얻을 수 없었어요. 물을 때마다 답이 달라지거든요."

TextEng: "Sometimes they said the hunters wanted them for food, then that the hunters wanted them stopped from protecting the forest, and even that they were needed for a magical experiment."
Text: "어쩔 때는 사냥꾼들이 식량으로 원했다고 하고, 또 어쩔 때는 다른 이유라고 했어요."

TextEng: "Dryads like telling stories and they don't seem to separate fantasy from reality too well."
Text: "드라이어드는 이야기하기를 좋아하고, 환상과 현실을 구분하지 못하는 것 같아요."

TextEng: "My friend, have you ever felt the basic stirrings of nature calling to you?"
Text: "친구여, 자연의 근본적인 부름을 느껴 본 적 있어요?"

TextEng: "What... oh, I get it. No, not that call of nature. I'm talking about something a little deeper."
Text: "뭐... 아, 알겠어요. 그 '자연의 부름'이 아니에요. 더 깊은 것을 말하는 거예요."

TextEng: "Those are some of the basic needs, yes. But I'm talking about stronger drives than those."
Text: "그것도 기본적인 욕구이긴 하죠. 하지만 저는 그보다 더 강한 충동에 대해 말하는 거예요."

TextEng: "Did you call? Is there something I can do for you, friend?"
Text: "부르셨어요? 제가 해 드릴 일이 있나요, 친구?"

TextEng: "Have you ever thought about settling down with someone you... liked? About desire? About love?"
Text: "좋아하는 사람과 정착하는 것에 대해 생각해 본 적 있어요? 아이를 갖고 싶다는 마음은요?"

TextEng: "Have you ever thought about the... the continuation of the species? About children? About love?"
Text: "종족의 계속에 대해 생각해 본 적 있어요? 아이에 대해서요?"

TextEng: "And what conclusions have you arrived at? Can you see yourself settling down in one place, or do you see yourself as the perpetual wanderer? Will you grow tired of this keep and want to move on?"
Text: "그래서 어떤 결론에 도달했어요? 미래에 어딘가에 정착하는 모습을 그려 볼 수 있어요?"

TextEng: "Do. It is important. Think about it right now. Would you consider that in the near future? Or do you see your destiny as a perpetual wanderer? Will you grow tired of this keep and want to move on?"
Text: "해 보세요. 중요한 거예요. 지금 바로 생각해 보세요. 가까운 미래에 그런 걸 고려하시겠어요?"

TextEng: Kaidala blushes, but then laughs. "Men! You're just about as bad as I used to be."
Text: 카이달라가 얼굴을 붉히더니 웃습니다. "남자들! 예전 제 못지않게 나쁘네요."

TextEng: "Let us be on our way then. Too much to do, in so little time."
Text: "그럼 길을 떠나요. 할 일은 많고 시간은 적으니까요."

TextEng: She blushes. "Oh, no. I was just trying to make a few decisions. Nothing to worry about... right now."
Text: 그녀가 얼굴을 붉힙니다. "아, 아니에요. 그냥 결정할 게 좀 있어서요. 걱정할 건 아니에요."

TextEng: "Then perhaps we can search together? Maybe we could even help each other capture a true love."
Text: "그럼 같이 찾아볼까요? 서로 꿈을 이루는 걸 도와줄 수 있을지도요."

TextEng: "Ladies! You need look no further! Trip is here with all the love you could ask for and then some!"
Text: "아가씨들! 더 찾을 필요 없소! 원하는 사랑은 다 여기에, 트립이 왔으니!"

TextEng: Kaidala laughs, which sends Trip into a pout. She then strokes his head and gives him a peck on the cheek, which brightens his outlook considerably.
Text: 카이달라가 웃음을 터뜨리자, 트립이 삐죽해집니다. 그녀가 트립의 머리를 쓰다듬으며 간식을 줍니다.

TextEng: "Please do not leave me behind. I really don't feel comfortable here, by myself."
Text: "저를 두고 가지 마세요. 혼자 여기 있으면 정말 불안해요."

TextEng: "That is... too bad. Still, things might change once you win this election."
Text: "그건... 아쉽네요. 그래도 선거에서 이기시면 상황이 달라질 수도 있어요."

TextEng: "I see what you mean. I shall have to think on that. If you do settle I will need to make my own plans."
Text: "무슨 말인지 알겠어요. 생각해 볼게요. 정착하시게 되면 방문할 곳이 필요하겠죠."

TextEng: "What qualities would you look for in such a person?"
Text: "그런 사람에게 어떤 자질을 원하세요?"

TextEng: Her eyes become slightly misty, but she smiles. "That is certainly nice to hear. Any other attributes?"
Text: 그녀의 눈이 살짝 촉촉해지지만, 미소를 짓습니다. "그건 정말 듣기 좋은 말이네요."

TextEng: She smiles and nods. "They all say that. Maybe it is even true. Anything else?"
Text: 그녀가 미소 지으며 고개를 끄덕입니다. "다들 그렇게 말하죠. 어쩌면 진심일 수도 있고요. 다른 건요?"

TextEng: She cocks a questioning eyebrow. "There are differing standards on intelligence. Are there other attributes you would look for?"
Text: 그녀가 의문 가득한 눈썹을 올립니다. "지성에도 여러 기준이 있어요."

TextEng: She nods and sighs, "I should have expected that. Is there anything else?"
Text: 그녀가 고개를 끄덕이며 한숨 쉽니다. "예상했어야 했는데. 다른 건요?"

TextEng: She smiles and her eyes dart up to yours, then glance quickly away. "That is good to hear. It gives me much to think about. Anything else?"
Text: 그녀가 미소 짓더니 눈길이 당신에게 향하다가 재빨리 시선을 피합니다. "그건 좋은 자질이에요."

TextEng: "No, I didn't mean with anyone in particular. I just meant the whole general concept of it."
Text: "아, 특정 누군가를 말한 게 아니에요. 그냥 일반적인 개념에 대해서요."

TextEng: "You have committed yourself to this place of violence. I can feel the deaths that have come here, yet, I do see a beauty, different from the settlements of the south."
Text: "당신은 이 폭력의 장소에 헌신하고 있어요. 이곳에서 일어난 죽음이 느껴져요."

TextEng: "I fear that death might find me before you do, but it shall be as you have said."
Text: "당신이 돌아오기 전에 죽음이 먼저 찾아올까 두렵지만, 그래도 당신 말대로 하겠어요."

TextEng: "That is sad, <FirstName>. Perhaps you are simply refusing to see it."
Text: "슬프네요, <FirstName>. 아마도 보지 않으려는 것일 수도 있어요."

TextEng: "Open your eyes and your heart, put away your preconceived notions and allow yourself to experience something without a jaded view, for once. Otherwise, you will always be disappointed."
Text: "눈과 마음을 열고, 선입견을 버리고, 스스로에게 기회를 줘 보세요."

TextEng: "I am sorry. That was a bit preachy, wasn't it? I just felt like it needed to be said. We should continue now."
Text: "미안해요. 좀 설교 같았죠? 그냥 꼭 말해야 할 것 같아서요."

TextEng: "I... I don't know what to say, <FirstName>. No one has ever said such kind words to me before. Even when I was beautiful."
Text: "뭐... 뭐라 해야 할지 모르겠어요, <FirstName>. 아무도 그런 말을 해 준 적 없어요."

TextEng: "When I first met you, I thought you must have been a messenger of the gods. I thought you would smite me down for becoming such an ugly creature."
Text: "처음 만났을 때, 신들의 전령이라 생각했어요."

TextEng: "But you are beautiful in so many ways and each time I become disheartened by my lack of beauty, you say something that lifts me and makes my spirits soar. I am so attracted... I mean, I..."
Text: "하지만 당신은 여러 면에서 아름답고, 낙담할 때마다 당신이 기운을 북돋아 줘요."

TextEng: "When I first met you, I thought you were just one of those ordinary people. You weren't frighteningly ugly, yet, you certainly didn't match up with my ideal of beauty either."
Text: "처음 만났을 때, 그저 평범한 사람이라 생각했어요."

TextEng: "When I first met you, I thought you were part of the nightmare that my life had become. Nymphs fear that which is not pleasing to the eye."
Text: "처음 만났을 때, 내 삶을 비참하게 만든 악몽의 일부라고 생각했어요."

TextEng: "Now I know that you are truly beautiful, no matter what you look like on the outside. Not that I find you unappealing. I... I mean... oh, now I feel like an imbecile."
Text: "이제 외모와 관계없이 당신이 진정으로 아름답다는 걸 알아요."

TextEng: "Fie! I am supposed to be quick and witty, yet I stumble over my tongue when I speak to you this way. Let's get back to what we were doing. Maybe I can organize my thoughts better."
Text: "이런! 재치 있고 빠른 말솜씨를 가진 제가, 당신 앞에서는 혀가 꼬이네요."

TextEng: "Then I shall go to the giant tree in the north keep. I would like to speak to it again."
Text: "그럼 북쪽 요새의 거대한 나무에 갈게요. 잠시 거기서 쉬고 싶어요."

TextEng: "Perhaps that is what it is. I look at these people, and where I expect to find fear and despair, I see hope and determination."
Text: "아마 그게 그 이유인 것 같아요. 이 사람들을 보면, 절망할 것 같은 곳에서 희망을 발견해요."

TextEng: "I find their attitudes to be... inspirational. Suddenly I don't feel so sad. I feel... hope. Something I have not felt in a long time."
Text: "그들의 태도에... 영감을 받았어요. 갑자기 그렇게 힘들지 않게 느껴져요."

TextEng: "We can continue now. I feel... better."
Text: "이제 계속 가요. 기분이... 나아졌어요."

TextEng: "This hermit lives all alone, just as I used to. His friends are animals and insects, not other people."
Text: "이 은둔자는 예전의 저처럼 혼자 살아요. 친구라곤 동물뿐이죠."

TextEng: "For a while, perhaps, but not for too long. I do not think I could go back to such an existence."
Text: "잠시 동안은 괜찮겠지만, 너무 오래는 안 돼요. 다시 그 외로움으로 돌아갈 수는 없을 것 같아요."

TextEng: "There are moments of peace in such a life, but there are also stretches of maddening loneliness. No one could accuse the hermit of being in a state of utter bliss."
Text: "그런 삶에는 평화로운 순간도 있지만, 끝없이 외로운 순간도 있어요."

TextEng: "I am not sure I could do so again. I am simply too used to being around friends.
Text: "다시는 못 할 것 같아요. 사람들 곁에 있는 것에 너무 익숙해져서요."

TextEng: "What a lonely existence. You could be surrounded by people who care for you, yet feel totally alone."
Text: "정말 외로운 삶이에요. 당신을 아끼는 사람들에 둘러싸일 수도 있는데요."

TextEng: "I am sorry you feel that way. I believe that friendship is the only coin worth saving. Other things in life can be traded away, but friendship should be protected."
Text: "그렇게 느끼신다니 유감이에요. 우정이야말로 진정 중요한 유일한 것이라 믿어요."

TextEng: "We had better get moving again."
Text: "다시 출발해야 해요."

TextEng: "What can I do to better please you?"
Text: "어떻게 하면 더 마음에 드시겠어요?"

TextEng: "Thank you, <FirstName>. I wouldn't be here if you hadn't been such a good friend to me."
Text: "고마워요, <FirstName>. 당신이 그렇게 좋은 친구가 아니었다면 여기 없었을 거예요."

TextEng: "We had better get moving again. Thank you for listening to me. Sometimes I just need a shoulder to lean on."
Text: "다시 출발해야 해요. 들어줘서 고마워요. 가끔은 그냥 이야기하는 것만으로도 도움이 돼요."

TextEng: "Poor, lonely nymph. And I suppose that if we ever have to leave you behind, you'll need to be put out of your misery."
Text: "불쌍하고 외로운 님프. 혹시 놓고 가게 되면 당연히 찾아보겠지요."

TextEng: "Jaboli, I know that somewhere, deep inside that rough exterior, you are also a friend to me."
Text: "자볼리, 그 거친 겉모습 어딘가 깊은 곳에 정이 있다는 거 알아요."

TextEng: "I don't think you are perceptive enough to claim to know what is deep inside me."
Text: "내 안에 뭐가 있는지 알 만큼 통찰력이 있다고 생각하지 마."

TextEng: "We could always open you up and have a look!"
Text: "열어서 들여다보면 되잖아요!"

TextEng: "Trip is your friend, Kaidala! I will stay close to you and keep you safe."
Text: "트립은 카이달라의 친구야! 가까이 있으면서 안전하게 지켜줄 거야!"

TextEng: "Um... thanks, Trip."
Text: "음... 고마워, 트립."

TextEng: "Unless there is great danger or peril nearby. Then Trip will run, yes! He will flee because danger is no friend to poor Trip!"
Text: "위험이나 위기가 가까이 있지만 않으면! 그러면 트립은 달릴 거야, 응!"

TextEng: "I am your friend, Kaidala, even if you fear my flamin' head."
Text: "난 네 친구야, 카이달라. 내 불타는 머리가 무섭더라도."

TextEng: "I guess I can just fight, but I should at least use my buff spells before attacking."
Text: "그냥 싸울 수도 있지만, 최소한 버프 주문은 먼저 써야겠죠."

TextEng: "Thank you, Calibast. I'm sure someday I will get over it. Just don't hug me.... please."
Text: "고마워, 캘리바스트. 언젠가 극복할 수 있을 거예요. 가까이서 불을 켜지만 마세요."

TextEng: "<StartAction>[Sigh]</Start> If I had a copper for every time I've heard that..."
Text: <StartAction>[한숨]</Start> 이런 소리를 들을 때마다 동전 한 닢을 받았다면..."

TextEng: "I certainly used to, but now... now I am not sure that I could ever go back to such an existence again."
Text: "예전에는 확실히 그랬지만, 지금은... 이제는 다시 그 외로운 삶으로 돌아갈 수 있을지 모르겠어요."

TextEng: "May the earth shelter and protect you. May the rains feed you and give you strength."
Text: "대지가 당신을 감싸고 보호하기를. 빗물이 당신에게 양분을 주기를."

TextEng: "Take of my tears and know that I care. Take of my blood and know that I am bonded to you. Now grow!"
Text: "내 눈물을 받고 내가 아끼는 줄 알아요. 내 피를 받고 내가 사랑하는 줄 알아요."

TextEng: "I can feel it in my blood! I am growing stronger. This is truly magnificent ground! Given time to grow, I think I might be healed. It would be good to regain my old powers."
Text: "핏속에서 느껴져요! 점점 강해지고 있어요. 정말 대단해요."

TextEng: "Oh, thank you, <FirstName>. You have been so good to me. So much more than just an old friend... But let us speak of this later. We need to get back to what you were doing."
Text: "감사해요, <FirstName>. 정말 잘 해 주셨어요. 제가 받을 자격보다 훨씬 더요."

TextEng: "Let us rest here. I will gain much strength, even with just a short rest."
Text: "여기서 쉬어요. 짧은 휴식만으로도 많은 힘을 얻을 거예요."

TextEng: "No! No! You stay away!"
Text: "안 돼! 안 돼! 가까이 오지 마!"

TextEng: "I cannot do that. You must burn nymph! You must burn!"
Text: "그건 안 돼. 님프야, 넌 불타야 해!"

TextEng: "I will do as you say. I like a mixture of spellcasting and melee."
Text: "말씀대로 하겠어요. 주문 시전과 근접 전투를 섞는 게 좋아요."

TextEng: "I will stop you! You shall not burn me again!"
Text: "막아 보이겠어! 다시는 나를 불태우지 못해!"

TextEng: "I am sorry about that creature. I believe that my bond with the powers of nature opened a door for my worst nightmare to become reality."
Text: "그 생명체에 대해 미안해요. 제 힘의 유대가 그런 기억의 잔재를 끌어낸 것 같아요."

TextEng: "But most of my powers have been recovered now, <FirstName>. I might never be able to kill people with a simple glance, but my connection to nature, as a druid, will allow me to turn into a treant again."
Text: "하지만 이제 대부분의 힘을 되찾았어요, <FirstName>. 더 이상 그런 외모가 아닐 수도 있어요."

TextEng: "Just tell me if you wish me to use that power. And, <FirstName>, thank you for staying with me and protecting me. I hope we have an entire lifetime to get to know each other better."
Text: "그 힘을 쓸지 말해 주세요. 그리고, <FirstName>, 고마워요."

TextEng: "Perhaps we shall even try out the quaint, mortal tradition of marriage. Even a nymph can settle down, I suppose."
Text: "어쩌면 인간의 소박한 결혼 전통도 시도해 볼까요."

TextEng: "I love you, <FirstName>. Now let's go kill our enemies and make a place that's safe for true love!"
Text: "사랑해요, <FirstName>. 이제 적을 무찌르고 평화로운 곳을 만들어요!"

TextEng: "I think I saw something watching me, with hunger and desire in its eyes. Suddenly death chills me more than I thought it would. I shall try to do better to help us survive."
Text: "뭔가 저를 지켜보는 게 보였어요. 굶주림과 욕망이 가득한 눈으로."

TextEng: "Do not be angry with me, please. I am sorry. I shall wait here."
Text: "화내지 마세요. 미안해요. 여기서 기다릴게요."

TextEng: "I guess I could use a little more rest, but don't leave me here long, please."
Text: "좀 더 쉬어야겠지만, 오래 두고 가지 마세요."

TextEng: "Of course. I shall do as you command."
Text: "물론이죠. 말씀대로 하겠어요."

TextEng: "I wasn't really doing any good."
Text: "별로 도움이 안 되고 있었어요."

TextEng: "I like to hear that... that you need me. It gives life a little more meaning."
Text: "그 말이 좋아요... 저를 필요로 한다니. 삶에 의미가 생기네요."

TextEng: "Someone else has asked for my help. I am sorry I cannot work with you right now."
Text: "다른 분이 도움을 요청하셨어요. 지금은 함께할 수 없어서 미안해요."

TextEng: Kaidala ignores you, whispering quietly to her tree and then giggling absent-mindedly.
Text: 카이달라는 당신을 무시하고, 나무에게 속삭이며 킥킥 웃습니다.

TextEng: "Nature thrives when we strive for harmony. We should always work towards that goal."
Text: "자연은 조화를 이룰 때 번성해요. 항상 그것을 위해 노력해야 해요."

TextEng: "Will you please stop drooling on me, Trip? Are you sure that your natural form wasn't a rat? You certainly didn't retain many of your human traits."
Text: "트립, 제발 침 좀 흘리지 마. 네 천성이 진짜 개인 거 맞아?"

TextEng: "Trip was a man, and most of my worst habits came from my time as a human. I think that is why Trip was so disliked by everyone back then."
Text: "트립은 원래 남자였어요. 제 나쁜 습관 대부분은 인간이었을 때 생긴 거예요."

TextEng: "Oh, I'm sorry. I shouldn't be so harsh I guess."
Text: "아, 미안해요. 그렇게 심하게 말하면 안 되는데."

TextEng: "It is all right. Trip is used to people not understanding him. Actually, Trip did spend a short time in his rat form, once."
Text: "괜찮아요. 트립은 사람들이 이해 못 하는 데 익숙해요. 사실 트립도 스스로를 이해 못 해요."

TextEng: "I always wondered about that. I've never seen you in that form."
Text: "항상 궁금했어요. 그 모습으로 변한 적은 없잖아요."

TextEng: "Trip is rather afraid of taking that shape again... in case the evil mage is still looking for me."
Text: "트립은 그 형태로 변하는 걸 아주 무서워해요... 혹시 사악한 마법사가 다시 찾아올까 봐."

TextEng: "Our enemy whispers in my head. How foolish. As if I would respond to such an unnatural creature."
Text: "적이 제 머릿속에 속삭여요. 어리석기도 하지. 마치 제가 응하기라도 할 것처럼."

TextEng: "I'm not sure what I can do."
Text: "제가 뭘 할 수 있을지 모르겠어요."

TextEng: "Evil mage? What do you mean?"
Text: "사악한 마법사? 무슨 말이에요?"

TextEng: "Trip was hungry once, yes, very hungry, and I found a tower, dark and scary. I thought I should transform into a rat, sneak in and find something to eat."
Text: "트립이 한번 정말 배가 고팠어요. 어두운 탑을 발견하고 먹을 걸 찾으러 들어갔죠."

TextEng: "Trip was captured by the owner of the tower, a powerful mage, who mistook me for a real rat. He thought I seemed very smart, for a rat, and decided to keep me as his familiar."
Text: "트립은 탑 주인인 강력한 마법사에게 잡혔어요. 마법사는 트립을 다른 생명체로 착각했어요."

TextEng: "Sorry <master/mistress>. Trip will try to ignore the constant badgering of the nymph!"
Text: "미안해요, <master/mistress>. 트립은 끊임없는 괴롭힘을 무시하려고 노력할게요."

TextEng: "The what? How is this my fault, you scrawny, mangy, flea-bitten rat? Oh, never mind."
Text: "뭐? 어떻게 이게 내 탓이야, 이 비쩍 마르고, 벼룩 잡는 쥐야?"

TextEng: "Yes. This story doesn't seem terribly plausible, Trip."
Text: "맞아요. 이 이야기는 별로 그럴듯하지 않네요, 트립."

TextEng: "Trip didn't know what it would do, but I knew I didn't want to stay with a mage, so I bit him on the finger and fled."
Text: "트립은 그게 뭘 하는 건지 몰랐지만, 그 마법사랑 같이 있고 싶지 않다는 건 알았어요."

TextEng: "But the mage didn't just let you go, did he?"
Text: "하지만 마법사가 그냥 보내줬을 리는 없지?"

TextEng: "No, he cast spells at Trip and tried to capture him. One spell was a ghostly cat following me really close, so I was terribly frightened."
Text: "아니, 주문을 쏘며 잡으려 했어요. 하나는 트립을... 트립을... 으으, 쥐로 만들었어요."

TextEng: "I didn't know what to do, so I turned into Trip's favorite form, this one. The spell cat went right past Trip and didn't recognize me."
Text: "어쩔 줄 몰라서, 트립이 가장 좋아하는 형태, 이 형태로 변했어요."

TextEng: "As you wish."
Text: "말씀대로 할게요."

TextEng: "And that is why, years later, you refuse to ever take your rat form?"
Text: "그래서 몇 년 후에도 쥐 형태로 변하길 거부하는 거야?"

TextEng: "You can never be too cautious with mages. They can be very tricksy!"
Text: "마법사에게는 아무리 조심해도 지나치지 않아요. 정말 교활할 수 있거든요!"

TextEng: "I don't understand this. They were here when I went to sleep last night. Where could they have gone?"
Text: "이해가 안 돼요. 어젯밤에 잘 때 여기 있었는데."

TextEng: "Did you lose something, Kaidala? Trip finds things really well. Maybe he could find something for you?"
Text: "뭘 잃어버렸어요, 카이달라? 트립은 물건 찾기를 정말 잘해요. 트립이 도와줄까요?"

TextEng: "I had a pair of stockings for when my feet got cold, but I can't find them."
Text: "발이 추울 때 신으려고 스타킹이 있었는데, 찾을 수가 없어요."

TextEng: "Oh... Trip doesn't know about that." Trip tries to hide one of his hands behind his back as surreptitiously as possible.
Text: "오... 트립은 그런 거 몰라요." 트립이 한쪽 손을 감추려 합니다.

TextEng: "Trip! Do you have my stockings? Your feet are covered in hair; what could you possibly need my stockings for?"
Text: "트립! 내 스타킹 가지고 있는 거야? 네 발은 털로 덮여 있잖아. 스타킹이 왜 필요해?"

TextEng: "Trip doesn't know what you are talking about! Do you know, Mister Rags?" Trip swiftly brings his hand out, which is covered in black cloth with small holes and decorations stuck to it.
Text: "트립은 무슨 말인지 모르겠어요! 미스터 래그스는 알아요?"

TextEng: "I don't know what she is ranting about, Mister Trip," Trip says in a low, gravelly voice.
Text: "무슨 소린지 모르겠어요, 미스터 트립." 트립이 높은 목소리로 말합니다.

TextEng: "What... is... that?"
"Like the wind through the trees."
Text: "나무 사이를 스치는 바람처럼요."

TextEng: "Hello, pretty lady! I'm Trip's new friend, Mr. Rags. Would you like to be my friend too?"
Text: "안녕, 예쁜 아가씨! 나는 트립의 새 친구, 미스터 래그스야! 쿠키 먹을래?"

TextEng: "No! I don't want to be your friend! Argh! Now I'm talking to my own stocking!"
Text: "싫어! 친구하고 싶지 않아! 으아! 이제 내 양말이랑 대화하고 있잖아!"

TextEng: "That's all right, Kaidala. Trip knows what it is like to have strange friends that others don't understand or appreciate."
Text: "괜찮아요, 카이달라. 트립은 머릿속에 이상한 친구가 있는 게 어떤 건지 알아요."

TextEng: "I don't have voices in my head or invisible friends. I am not like you!"
Text: "나는 머릿속에 목소리가 들리거나 보이지 않는 친구가 있는 게 아니에요. 너랑 같지 않아요."

TextEng: "Trip wasn't talking about the voices. Trip was talking about you and <FirstName>."
Text: "트립이 말한 건 목소리가 아니에요. 카이달라랑 나무에 대해 말한 거예요."

TextEng: "Where is my other stocking?" Kaidala gives Trip an evil look.
Text: "나머지 한 짝은 어디 있어?" 카이달라가 트립에게 무시무시한 눈빛을 보냅니다.

TextEng: "What would you need the other stocking for? One stocking would do you no good." Trip's head droops and he glances guiltily around.
Text: "나머지 한 짝이 왜 필요해? 손 인형 하나면 충분할 텐데."

TextEng: "Trip! Where is it?"
Text: "트립! 어디 있어?"

TextEng: "Trip is sorry, but I did not think Kaidala would be needing the other stocking... and Trip was soooo hungry!"
Text: "트립이 미안해요. 카이달라한테 나머지 한 짝이 필요할 줄 몰랐어요."

TextEng: "Never mind, Trip." Kaidala heaves a heavy sigh.
Text: "됐어, 트립." 카이달라가 깊은 한숨을 쉽니다.

TextEng: "I shall do as you say. I was not very good at it anyway."
Text: "말씀대로 하겠어요. 어차피 잘하지도 못했으니."

TextEng: "You can play with Mr. Rags any time you want to, Kaidala."
Text: "카이달라, 원하면 언제든지 미스터 래그스랑 놀아도 돼요."

TextEng: "Joy."
Text: "기쁘네."

TextEng: "Jaboli, do you think you will ever find love? Not that I'm saying you're difficult to love, but what would you look for in a life mate?"
Text: "자볼리, 사랑을 찾을 수 있을 것 같아? 매력이 없다는 뜻은 아니야."

TextEng: "I do not concern myself with things like that. If I do find love someday, then I suppose I shall be happy, but until then, I will live joyfully without such worries."
Text: "그런 걸 신경 쓰지 않아. 사랑을 찾으면 그때의 일이고."

TextEng: "But that seems so sad. A life without love... it just seems so empty."
Text: "그건 너무 슬프지 않아? 사랑 없는 삶이라니... 너무 공허해 보여."

TextEng: "I hope you are not going to suddenly burst into song here. I tire of the idea that life must be filled with romance or be horribly dull."
Text: "갑자기 노래를 터뜨리려는 건 아니겠지. 네 님프 철학은 지겨워."

TextEng: "But you are beautiful. There must be some who would find you attractive. I'm sure if you tried..."
Text: "하지만 넌 아름다워. 매력적이라 생각하는 이가 있을 거야."

TextEng: "You are not listening to me, Kaidala! It is not that I have not had any opportunities; it is that I am not interested!"
Text: "내 말을 안 듣고 있지, 카이달라! 기회가 없었던 게 아니야."

TextEng: "Well, you don't have to yell at me! I was just wondering and trying to show an interest in your life."
Text: "소리 지를 필요 없잖아! 궁금해서 물어본 건데, 친절하게 대하려 한 건데."

TextEng: "You were just trying to stick your nose in something that does not concern you, and I would thank you to mind your own business."
Text: "네가 상관할 일이 아닌 곳에 코를 들이밀고 있었을 뿐이야."

TextEng: "I will probably just end up beating on it with a stick, but if that's what you want."
Text: "결국 막대기로 두들기게 될 거지만, 원하시는 거라면요."

TextEng: "I will then! See if I ever send a handsome man your way again!"
Text: "그럼 그래! 다시는 잘생긴 남자를 소개해 주지 않을 거야!"

TextEng: "Send a... as if I would be interested in your cast-offs! Please, if he was interested in you, don't do me any favors. He would obviously have severely impaired judgement!"
Text: "네가 차버린 남자를 내가 관심 가질 것 같아? 제발, 관심이 있었다면 진작..."

TextEng: "How dare you?!? Why I ought to..."
Text: "감히 어떻게?!? 나는..."

TextEng: "No!"
Text: "안 돼!"

TextEng: "Sometimes you have to let us work out our differences."
Text: "가끔은 우리끼리 다툼을 해결하게 해 줘야 해요."

TextEng: "You have neither the brains to challenge me, nor the power. What are you going to do... deflect my magic with your impressive bosom?"
Text: "넌 나에게 도전할 머리도 힘도 없어. 뭘 어쩌겠다는 거지?"

TextEng: "I'm a lot tougher than you give me credit for! I could... wait, do you really think my bosom is impressive?"
Text: "네가 생각하는 것보다 훨씬 강해! 나는... 잠깐, 냄새 나는 거 아니야?"

TextEng: "Are you kidding? No, I can see that you aren't. I think we have exhausted the possibilities of this conversation!"
Text: "농담이야? 아, 아니구나. 이 화제는 충분히 다룬 것 같아."

TextEng: "What is this? Another hair? Jaboli, do you think you will ever stop shedding like this?"
Text: "이건 뭐야? 또 털? 자볼리, 언제쯤 털이 안 빠질 거야?"

TextEng: "What are you talking about, child? I take excellent care of myself. I do not shed!"
Text: "무슨 소리야? 난 자기 관리를 아주 잘 해. 규칙적으로 핥잖아."

TextEng: "As you wish. How far would you have me stand?"
Text: "알겠어요. 얼마나 멀리 서 있을까요?"

TextEng: "You do too. I find your hair in everything! It's been in the food, on my clothes, in the bed rolls... everywhere! I was brushing my hair yesterday and I found one of your hairs in my hair."
Text: "핥잖아! 네 털이 어디에나 있어! 음식에도, 침낭에도!"

TextEng: "You are just imagining it. Probably because you are jealous."
Text: "상상이야. 질투하니까 그런 거겠지."

TextEng: "And what exactly do I have to be jealous about? You think I want to have hair covering my entire body? I would be shaving constantly."
Text: "내가 뭘 질투한다는 거야? 네처럼 수염이 나고 싶다는 거야?"

TextEng: "I don't know... I think you might look cute with whiskers."
Text: "글쎄... 수염 있으면 귀여울 수도 있는데."

TextEng: "Trip had whiskers. Did you think he was cute?"
Text: "트립한테 수염이 있었어. 트립이 귀여웠어?"

TextEng: "An interesting point and one I find much amusement in. There are similarities between you and Trip. You both whine a lot and neither of you is as useful as one could hope."
Text: "흥미로운 지적이고, 아주 재미있군. 둘 사이에 유사점이 있어."

TextEng: "I will remember that next time you need healing."
Text: "다음에 치유가 필요할 때 기억해 둘게."

TextEng: "I can't believe you would say that! And how can you be so cruel to Trip when he's dead, Jaboli?"
Text: "어떻게 그런 말을 해! 그리고 트립에게 그렇게 잔인하게 굴 수 있어?"

TextEng: "Actually, I miss some of Trip's antics. Even though he could be a pest, at least he was funny."
Text: "사실 트립의 장난이 좀 그리워요. 성가시기도 했지만, 마음은 따뜻했으니까요."

TextEng: "I was only teasing her. Actually, I miss some of Trip's antics. Even though he could be a pest, at least he was funny."
Text: "놀린 거야. 사실 트립의 장난이 좀 그리워. 성가시기도 했지만요."

TextEng: "I will do so."
Text: "그렇게 하겠어요."

TextEng: "I miss him too. <StartAction>[sigh]</Start> I hope he found greater happiness in the afterlife. I hope he got rid of the voices in his head."
Text: "나도 그리워요. [한숨] 더 큰 행복을 찾았길 바라요."

TextEng: "He's probably stolen the pearls from Mistress Death's eyes and accidently swallowed them."
Text: "아마 죽음의 여신 눈에서 진주를 훔쳐서 실수로 황금 호수에 빠뜨렸을 거야."

TextEng: Kaidala grins. "Can you imagine if he got to go to Suhili's paradise? With pearly gates and streets of gold, he wouldn't know what to do. He'd end up lugging around a ton of pavement."
Text: 카이달라가 웃습니다. "트립이 수힐리의 낙원에 갔다면 어땠을지 상상이 돼요?"

TextEng: Jaboli stares off into nothing for a moment. "I am sorry for my harsh words, Kaidala. I wish I had said some nicer things to Trip, when he lived."
Text: 자볼리가 잠시 먼 곳을 응시합니다. "거친 말에 미안해. 친구들은 다투다가도 화해하는 거니까."

TextEng: "Me too. And you don't really shed so much. I shouldn't be so picky. I'll try to be more cheerful. We should get going now." They smile tentatively at one another, then look to you.
Text: "나도 미안해. 그리고 네 털이 그렇게 많이 빠지는 건 아니야. 내가 너무 까다로웠어."

TextEng: "Calibast, what has been your favorite adventure you've had with our group?"
Text: "캘리바스트, 우리 일행과 함께한 모험 중 가장 좋았던 건 뭐야?"

TextEng: "Do you remember the thief of hearts?"
Text: "하트의 도둑 기억나?"

TextEng: She grins. "Yes. That was great fun. Do you remember where that happened, <FirstName>?"
Text: 그녀가 웃습니다. "응. 정말 재미있었지. 어디였는지 기억나?"

TextEng: "Quite a friendly village, Littlefield, so long as you minded your business and didn't ask too many questions. The thief was doing them a favor, if you ask me."
Text: "상당히 친절한 마을이었지, 리틀필드. 자기 일만 신경 쓰면."

TextEng: "Now there is a city with corruption problems. I thought the thief almost brought a note of respectability to a city full of vice and distorted lives."
Text: "부패 문제가 심한 도시였지. 도둑이 거의 성공할 뻔했어."

TextEng: "If you say so. Just remember to back me up."
Text: "알겠어요. 지원은 해 주세요."

TextEng: "Ah, yes, the Grim Woods were dark and creepy. I thought the thief actually brought a little life to them. He wasn't any worse than the local lord."
Text: "아, 그래. 음울한 숲은 어둡고 오싹했지. 도둑이 실제로 그곳에서 꽤 잘 활동했어."

TextEng: "His thefts were daring, but he was still a thief. I don't feel too bad about bringing him to justice."
Text: "대담한 도둑질이었지만, 여전히 도둑이야. 우리가 잡은 건 잘한 거야."

TextEng: "We were paid well enough to bring him in. Still, sometimes I wonder if we did the right thing."
Text: "보수는 충분히 받았지. 그래도 가끔 우리가 맞는 편이었는지 궁금해."

TextEng: "Of course he was! He was using them to create magical elixirs to stop a plague. He only stole the organ of newly deceased people. I don't know what everyone was so upset about."
Text: "당연히 범죄자지! 장기를 이용해 노화를 막는 마법 비약을 만들고 있었어!"

TextEng: "Graverobbing is a serious offense in many places. People were horrified that when they would go to visit the grave site of a loved one, the bodies had been exhumed and desecrated."
Text: "무덤 도굴은 많은 곳에서 중범죄야. 사람들이 공포에 떨었어."

TextEng: "People are too sensitive. Much better to preserve the livin' than worry about a few corpses."
Text: "너무 민감해. 죽은 자보다 산 자를 보존하는 게 낫지."

TextEng: "From people who didn't need it! He kept quite a few peasants from starvin' to death, if I remember correctly!"
Text: "필요 없는 사람들한테서! 많은 농민을 굶주림에서 구했어."

TextEng: "I also notice he kept the greatest share of the treasure for himself."
Text: "가장 큰 몫의 보물은 자기가 챙긴 거 알잖아."

TextEng: "He was the one takin' all the risks, you cannae blame him for wantin' a fair reward. The very fact that he shared at all is more than can be said of most men."
Text: "모든 위험을 감수한 건 그 사람이잖아. 보상을 원하는 걸 탓할 수는 없지."

TextEng: "Women who wanted to be stolen! Many of them were slaves that he was freeing from horrible conditions. Some were young women who were being forced into unhappy marriages."
Text: "납치당하길 원한 여자들이야! 그가 자유를 되찾아 준 노예들이었어."

TextEng: "I dislike rushing to the attack anyway. Well, most of the time."
Text: "어차피 돌격하는 건 싫어요. 대부분은요."

TextEng: "I notice he only chose young, fairly good-looking women to *free* from their oppressors."
Text: "'해방'할 대상으로 젊고 예쁜 여자만 골랐다는 건 알고 있겠지."

TextEng: "You cannae blame the man for havin' decent taste. I mean, who wants to steal some ugly, old, crotchety grandmother? I did nae hear any of the young lasses complainin' about their treatment."
Text: "취향이 좋은 걸 탓할 수 없잖아. 누가 못생긴 노예를 해방하고 싶겠어?"

TextEng: "We did manage to capture him, but not until he'd caused us quite a few problems. You remember the dungeon he trapped us in?"
Text: "결국 잡긴 했지만, 꽤 문제를 일으킨 뒤에야. 특히 카이달라가 잡혀서."

TextEng: "Oh, nobody blamed you for what happened. You know better than to get so far ahead of the group that we can't watch each other's backs now. We survived, so no harm done."
Text: "아무도 네 탓이라고 안 했어. 님프한테 매혹당하지 말라는 건 상식이잖아."

TextEng: "Well, she couldn't be expected to understand proper adventurin' etiquette so soon. She didn't know she should wait for the thief to look for trip wires before headin' down that corridor."
Text: "올바른 모험 예절을 알 수는 없었을 거야. 처음이었으니까."

TextEng: "I felt like such a fool. I just realized something! I bet the reason why you liked that adventure so much was because of that room full of dryads!"
Text: "정말 바보 같았어. 방금 깨달은 게 있어! 카이달라가 잡힌 이유가..."

TextEng: "You had better be believin' it. I've never encountered such an appreciative group of young ladies before."
Text: "틀림없어. 그렇게 감사의 표현이 넘치는 사람을 본 적이 없어."

TextEng: "Well, they had been stuck down there with the thief for such a long time. I can't say I blame them, though they could have tried to control their enthusiasm."
Text: "그 여자들은 도둑과 오래 갇혀 있었으니까 그럴 만도 했지."

TextEng: "Well, we helped them escape and then they helped us trap the thief, so I can't say I regret a moment of it."
Text: "탈출을 도와줬더니, 그들이 도둑을 잡는 걸 도와줬지. 다 잘 끝났어."

TextEng: "Not that I know of, and brownies aren't anywhere near as fun. There are a few satyrs though. If you like that kind of thing."
Text: "내가 아는 한 아니야. 브라우니는 그만큼 재미없어. 수컷 드라이어드도 없고."

TextEng: "Do as you must."
Text: "하셔야 할 대로 하세요."

TextEng: Calibast gives you a glare, then begins to laugh.
Text: 캘리바스트가 당신을 노려보다가 웃기 시작합니다.

TextEng: "Men!" <StartAction>[Sigh.]</Start>
Text: "남자들!" <StartAction>[한숨.]</Start>

TextEng: "All right, enough reminiscing. Let's get some work done. I feel the need to kill something soon."
Text: "됐어, 추억은 그만. 일 좀 하자. 낮잠이 필요한 것 같아."

TextEng: "My fault? If our lousy thief had been lookin' for traps instead of treasure, I might not have caught my foot on that trip wire! My fault indeed."
Text: "내 탓이라고? 우리의 형편없는 도둑이 함정 찾는 대신 치마 뒤를 쫓아다녔잖아."

TextEng: "I bet the reason why you liked that adventure so much was because of that room full of dryads!"
Text: "네가 그 모험을 좋아한 이유가 해방된 여자들 때문인 거 맞지."

TextEng: "Calibast? I have always thought of fire as a natural destroyer, yet you come from a home that is created by fire, correct?"
Text: "캘리바스트? 불은 항상 자연의 파괴자라고 생각했는데, 넌 그것과 함께 살잖아."

TextEng: "True enough, darlin'. What's your point?"
Text: "맞아, 그래. 요점이 뭔데?"

TextEng: "I was just wondering what your world could possibly be like. Is it a giant ball of flames, or is there anything similar to nature here?"
Text: "네 세계가 어떤 곳인지 궁금해서. 불의 세계이면서도 아름다운 곳이야?"

TextEng: "Not like here, no. Our forests are giant crystalline structures that grow up from the obsidian earth. Our lakes are made of great pools of lava."
Text: "여기와는 달라. 우리 숲은 거대한 수정 구조물이야."

TextEng: "That sounds absolutely horrifying! Are there none of the gentle sounds of nature, like the babbling of a brook, the wind whistling through the boughs of a tree?"
Text: "정말 끔찍하게 들려! 부드러운 소리는 없어? 자연의 은은한 속삭임 같은?"

TextEng: "This is a beautiful grove of trees. I can hear them whispering to me, as if they are welcoming me home."
Text: "아름다운 나무 숲이에요. 나무들이 속삭이는 게 들려요. 당신한테도 들리면 좋겠는데."

TextEng: "I will do my best, though I make no promises."
Text: "최선을 다하겠지만, 장담은 못 해요."

TextEng: "Actually, the sound of the wind whistling through the crystalline forests is more beautiful than any sound I have heard on this plane. It is also the most dangerous."
Text: "사실 수정 숲을 스치는 바람 소리는 정말 아름다워."

TextEng: "Sorry, I didn't mean to slow us down. I'll try to be quiet."
Text: "미안, 속도를 늦추려는 건 아니었어요. 조용히 할게요."

TextEng: "Don't listen to <him/her>, Kaidala. If <he/she> could get rid of all conversation and make life just one big battle after another, none of us would ever speak again."
Text: "카이달라 말 듣지 마. 모두를 없앨 수 있다면, 진작 그랬을 거야."

TextEng: "Like ethereal music, played on hundreds of thousands of instruments. I have only heard it a few times. We don't venture close to the forests often, due to the dangers."
Text: "천상의 음악 같아, 수십만 개의 악기로 연주하는. 정말 놀라워."

TextEng: "To hear the music of the forest, one has to be standing near or in it. The wind will often cause numerous small crystals to break free and whip them at high speeds in any direction."
Text: "숲의 음악을 들으려면, 숲 안이나 근처에 서 있어야 해."

TextEng: "So the falling of leaves could literally kill you?"
Text: "그러면 나뭇잎이 떨어지는 것만으로도 목숨을 잃을 수 있다는 거야?"

TextEng: "It often does. And not only that, but sometimes an entire branch or tree will fall and fragment, sendin' a spray of crystals for miles."
Text: "자주 그래. 가끔은 가지 전체가 떨어지기도 해."

TextEng: "You may find this strange, but I actually think I like that. There is a certain beauty to creations of nature that are incredibly beautiful, yet wonderfully deadly."
Text: "이상하게 들릴 수 있지만, 사실 그게 마음에 들어요. 위험 속에 아름다움이 있어요."

TextEng: "Is that not what bein' a nymph is all about? I have heard tales of some nymphs that can kill just by lookin' at a fellow with her unearthly beauty."
Text: "그게 님프의 본질 아닌가? 아름다움으로 사람을 죽일 수 있다는 이야기를 들었는데."

TextEng: "All nymphs can do that to some degree, with myself as the single exception. It doesn't work against all creatures, nor all males either. Nice point though."
Text: "모든 님프가 어느 정도는 그럴 수 있어요. 단 하나의 예외인 저를 빼고요."

TextEng: "I see. What manner of buffing spells would you have me use?"
Text: "알겠어요. 어떤 종류의 버프 주문을 원하세요?"

TextEng: "I do what I can to keep things interestin'."
Text: "재미를 유지하기 위해 최선을 다하고 있어."

TextEng: "And what is my target?"
Text: "그래서 내 목표가 뭐야?"

TextEng: "So be it!"
Text: "좋아, 그렇게 하지!"

TextEng: "What shall I cast, then?"
Text: "그럼 뭘 시전할까요?"

TextEng: "I can do that. Are you certain?"
Text: "그렇게 할 수 있어요. 확실해요?"

TextEng: "And what is my target?"
Text: "그래서 내 목표가 뭐야?"

TextEng: "Was there anything else then, friend?"
Text: "그 외에 다른 건요, 친구?"

TextEng: "So be it!"
Text: "좋아, 그렇게 하지!"

TextEng: "It will be nice to return to my own form again."
Text: "제 원래 모습으로 돌아가니 좋네요."

TextEng: "The dwarves are going to be enraged when they find their hall has been flooded with magma."
Text: "드워프들이 자기 광산이 점령당한 걸 알면 분노할 거예요."

TextEng: "It is always pleasing to travel for a while in the form of a beast. Which creature would you have me be?"
Text: "잠시 동물 형태로 여행하는 것도 즐거워요. 뭘 원하세요?"

TextEng: "Now that I am at full power, love, we shall smash our enemies into dust!"
Text: "이제 완전한 힘을 되찾았으니, 자기야, 적들을 가루로 만들어요!"

TextEng: "Ha! You remembered. Very well, I shall do this."
Text: "하! 기억하고 있었군요. 좋아요, 하겠어요."

TextEng: "A sleek and dexterous form. It shall be so."
Text: "날렵하고 민첩한 형태네요. 그렇게 하죠."

TextEng: "What did you wish to speak about?"
Text: "무슨 이야기를 하고 싶으세요?"

TextEng: "Is there anything else you would ask of me?"
Text: "다른 부탁할 건 없어요?"

TextEng: "I'm alright. Does this armor make me look fat? Oh, never mind."
Text: "괜찮아요. 이 갑옷 입으면 뚱뚱해 보여요? 아, 됐어요."

TextEng: "Do you want anything else?"
Text: "다른 건요?"

TextEng: "I had a dream last night that I lay bare in the woods, covered in butterflies. It was... an unusual dream."
Text: "어젯밤에 꿈을 꿨는데, 숲에서 나비에 덮여 누워 있었어요. 아름다운 꿈이었어요."

TextEng: "I can sense that there are cats around, yet I have not seen any. I wonder where they are?"
Text: "근처에 고양이가 있는 게 느껴지는데, 아직 보지 못했어요. 궁금하네요."

TextEng: "I sense some restless spirits here, but this is a beautiful place to be laid to rest."
Text: "떠돌아다니는 영혼이 있지만, 명상하기엔 아름다운 곳이에요."

TextEng: "The wildlife around here is suffering. The invaders tax the land and hunt all creatures. Sad, really."
Text: "이 근처 야생 동물들이 고통받고 있어요. 침략자들이 땅에 짐을 주고 있어요."

TextEng: "One of the birds here keeps telling me I look pretty. I'm glad animals do not have the same outlook on life as we do."
Text: "여기 새 한 마리가 자꾸 예쁘다고 해요. 동물이 감사를 아는 건 기분 좋은 일이에요."

TextEng: "Every once in a while I catch you smiling. That lifts my spirits, a little."
Text: "가끔 당신이 미소 짓는 걸 보면 기운이 나요."

TextEng: "Things are not so terrible, though I could always use some encouragment."
Text: "그렇게 끔찍하진 않지만, 격려는 항상 필요하죠."

TextEng: "I do not like this darkness that blinds my eyes. If you could just direct me to a temple..."
Text: "눈을 가리는 이 어둠이 싫어요. 빛을 좀 찾아주시면 좋겠어요."

TextEng: "A few scratches and bruises, but nothing to be terribly concerned about."
Text: "약간의 긁힘과 멍이 있지만, 크게 걱정할 건 없어요."

TextEng: "My wounds are serious, but I still have life left in me."
Text: "부상이 심각하지만, 아직 살아 있어요."

TextEng: "There is little life left in me. Soon I shall go back to the embrace of the earth."
Text: "생명이 얼마 남지 않았어요. 곧 대지의 품으로 돌아갈 거예요."

TextEng: "A toxin is beginning to cripple me. Please, we must find an antidote."
Text: "독이 몸을 마비시키고 있어요. 제발 해독제를 찾아야 해요."

TextEng: "I have the shakes. I fear that my body has some kind of disease."
Text: "몸이 떨려요. 병에 걸린 것 같아요."

TextEng: "Oh, my! Look at that tree! How absolutely amazing. For this alone it is worth saving the keep!"
Text: "세상에! 저 나무 좀 봐요! 정말 놀라워요. 이것만으로도 여기 올 가치가 있었어요."

TextEng: "I have my home now. When my seed was planted, I accepted responsibility for that grove, for the entire area, actually."
Text: "이제 집이 생겼어요. 씨앗을 심었을 때, 이 땅에 대한 책임을 받아들였어요."

TextEng: "You will always have me, so long as you want me and treat me well. You know you have my bond in this."
Text: "저를 원하고 잘 대해주는 한, 항상 곁에 있을 거예요."

TextEng: "I would like you to work with me to set up an area around my grove, protected from the landowners, the hunters and the foresters."
Text: "제 숲 주변에 나무를 가꿀 수 있는 구역을 만들어 주셨으면 해요."

TextEng: "There is a good chance they would not like it, but with me there to protect it and you backing me up legally, we might be able to accomplish something lasting. What do you think?"
Text: "사람들이 좋아하지 않을 수도 있지만, 제가 나무를 보호하면 괜찮을 거예요."

TextEng: "I am glad you feel that way, because if you win this election I would like you to work with me to set up an area around my grove, protected from the landowners, the hunters and the foresters."
Text: "그렇게 생각해 주시니 기뻐요. 이 선거에서 이기시면 길드에 나무 심기를 요구하고 싶어요."

TextEng: "There is a good chance they would not like it, but with me there to protect it and you backing me up legally, we might be able to accomplish something lasting."
Text: "사람들이 좋아하지 않을 수도 있지만, 제가 나무를 보호하면 괜찮을 거예요."

TextEng: "I would love to know your mind on this. What do you think?"
Text: "당신의 생각을 알고 싶어요. 어떻게 생각하세요?"

TextEng: "Everything I knew is now dead and gone. Even if new trees and creatures could return there, they would not remember me. I will honor my old home by being a better protector of my new home."
Text: "제가 알던 모든 것이 죽고 사라졌어요. 새 나무와 생명체가 자란다 해도요."

TextEng: "For as long as you want me around. I can think of no better place to be than at your side."
Text: "원하시는 한 곁에 있을게요. 이보다 좋은 곳은 생각할 수 없어요."

TextEng: "I don't know for sure, but I doubt it. I think I will have to find a new home, perhaps near one of the beautiful northern lakes. I like the cold, rugged beauty of the nearby mountains."
Text: "확실하진 않지만, 아마 어려울 거예요. 새로운 숲을 찾아야 할 것 같아요."

TextEng: "The crowds of people in this place are enough to drive me mad. Let's not stay here long."
Text: "이곳의 인파는 미칠 것 같아요. 빨리 할 일을 끝내고 나가요."

TextEng: "I am glad you feel that way, because if you win this election I would like to work with you to set up an area protected from the landowners, the hunters and the foresters."
Text: "그렇게 생각해 주시니 기뻐요. 이 선거에서 이기시면 길드에 나무 심기를 요구하고 싶어요."

TextEng: "There is a good chance they would not like it, but with me there to protect it and you backing me up legally, we might be able to accomplish something lasting."
Text: "사람들이 좋아하지 않을 수도 있지만, 제가 나무를 보호하면 괜찮을 거예요."

TextEng: "I would love to know your mind on this matter."
Text: "이 문제에 대한 당신의 생각을 알고 싶어요."

TextEng: "You are probably right. You have enough on your mind right now. I shouldn't be pressing political issues on you when you're busy trying to get elected."
Text: "아마 맞을 거예요. 지금은 생각할 게 충분하시니까요. 선거 후에 이야기해야겠죠."

TextEng: "Well, come to think of it, that would seem to be the perfect time for issues. I think you're really becoming a proper politician, if you already know how to dodge a question like that."
Text: "생각해 보니, 그때가 그런 일을 의논하기에 딱 좋은 때가 될 것 같네요."

TextEng: "That is a choice you will have to make every day. A ruler makes rules for <his/her> people to follow. But I see now that it is not an important issue for you. I will let it alone then."
Text: "그건 매일 해야 할 선택이에요. 통치자는 규칙을 만들지만, 좋은 통치자는 고통을 만들지 않아요."

TextEng: "I guess you probably wouldn't, though I think the guilds will only have as much power as you allow them."
Text: "아마 그런 권한은 없겠지만, 길드는 당신이 공정하게 대하는 만큼만 힘을 가질 거예요."

TextEng: "So you would actually help me in this? Oh, <FirstName>, you are too kind to me. I don't know why you put up with me the way you do. No one else would care for this ugly monster."
Text: "정말 도와주시겠어요? 아, <FirstName>, 너무 친절하시네요."

TextEng: "Is there some bitter core to your personality that must lash out at everyone? One more foul word out of you and I might have to leave."
Text: "다른 모든 것에 독을 뿜어야만 하는 쓰라린 핵심이 있나요?"

TextEng: Kaidala stares at you with sad, pained eyes. "As you wish."
Text: 카이달라가 슬프고 아픈 눈으로 당신을 응시합니다. "말씀대로 하죠."

TextEng: "I know it's silly, but any tavern called the Mossy Tree will hold a special place in my heart."
Text: "바보 같은 소리지만, '이끼낀 나무'라는 이름의 술집이라면 제 마음속에 특별한 자리가 있을 거예요."

TextEng: "Let's go. I don't want to speak to you again for a while. If you do not wish to be left alone here, consider treating me better."
Text: "가요. 한동안 당신과 말하고 싶지 않아요. 원하지 않으면 어쩔 수 없지만요."

TextEng: Her eyes narrow dangerously. "And what exactly is worse than being an ugly monster?"
Text: 그녀의 눈이 위험하게 가늘어집니다. "추방된 님프보다 더 나쁜 게 뭔데요?"

TextEng: Her jaw drops open, then she starts to laugh. "I don't know whether to hate you or love you for a joke like that."
Text: 그녀의 턱이 벌어지더니, 웃기 시작합니다. "때려야 할지 웃어야 할지 모르겠어요."

TextEng: She smiles and gives a little giggle. "You're terrible. But I do like you for that."
Text: 그녀가 미소 짓더니 킥킥 웃습니다. "끔찍하시네요. 하지만 마음에 들어요."

TextEng: She nods. "I guess that's an answer."
Text: 그녀가 고개를 끄덕입니다. "대답이라고 봐야겠죠."

TextEng: She smiles and hesitantly touches your face with her soft hand. "I'll do my best."
Text: 그녀가 미소 짓더니 부드러운 손으로 망설이며 당신의 얼굴을 만집니다. "노력할게요."

TextEng: "But that is exactly what I fear. I have had a taste of what life can be like with friends. I fear death less than I fear being alone."
Text: "하지만 바로 그게 두려운 거예요. 삶이 어떤 것일 수 있는지 맛봤으니까요."

TextEng: "I don't know about that. I still haven't made up my mind."
Text: "잘 모르겠어요. 아직 마음을 정하지 못했어요."

TextEng: "But we should get going. There is still much to do before I can settle down again."
Text: "하지만 이제 가야 해요. 정착하기 전에 할 일이 아직 많으니까요."

TextEng: She smiles. "That is kind of you to say. Thank you so much."
Text: 그녀가 미소 짓습니다. "그렇게 말해 주셔서 고마워요."

TextEng: "Not yet. I will come back for you."
Text: "아직이야. 다시 올게."

Text: "마법학자 갑옷."

"Lesser Spell Mantle."
Text: "하급 주문 망토."

Text: "하급 회복."
