Text: "하급 정신 차단"

TextEng: "Lesser Dispel."
Text: "하급 주문해제."

TextEng: "Knock."
Text: "개방."

TextEng: "Invisibility Sphere."
Text: "투명화 구체."

TextEng: "Invisibility"
Text: "투명화"

TextEng: "Improved Invisibility."
Text: "우수한 투명화."

TextEng: "I want to change your tactics."
Text: "네 전술을 바꾸고 싶어."

TextEng: "Haste."
Text: "가속."

TextEng: "Greater Stoneskin."
Text: "상급 돌 피부."

TextEng: "Greater Spell Mantle."
Text: "상급 주문 망토."

TextEng: "Greater Sanctuary."
Text: "상급 성역."

TextEng: "Greater Restoration."
Text: "상급 회복."

TextEng: "Greater Magic Weapon."
Text: "상급 마법 무기."

TextEng: "Greater Dispelling."
Text: "상급 주문해제."

TextEng: "Globe of Invulnerability."
Text: "무적의 구체."

TextEng: "Ghostly Visage."
Text: "유령의 형상."

TextEng: "Freedom of Movement."
Text: "자유 이동."

TextEng: "I don't want to change anything else right now."
Text: "지금은 다른 걸 바꾸고 싶지 않아."

TextEng: "Fox's Cunning"
Text: "여우의 교활함"

TextEng: "Find Traps."
Text: "함정 발견."

TextEng: "Ethereal Visage."
Text: "에테르 형상."

TextEng: "Entropic Shield."
Text: "혼돈의 보호막."

TextEng: "Energy Buffer."
Text: "에너지 감쇄."

TextEng: "No, I've changed my mind."
Text: "아니, 마음이 바뀌었어."

TextEng: "Yes, go ahead."
Text: "그래, 시전해."

TextEng: "Endure Elements."
Text: "원소 견딤."

TextEng: "Endurance."
Text: "지구력."

TextEng: "Elemental Shield."
Text: "원소 방패."

TextEng: "I don't want you to cast any spells until I say otherwise."
Text: "내가 다시 말할 때까지 주문을 쓰지 마."

TextEng: "Eagle's Splendor."
Text: "독수리의 위엄."

TextEng: "Divine Power."
Text: "신성한 힘."

TextEng: "Dispel Magic."
Text: "주문해제."

TextEng: "Death Ward."
Text: "죽음 방비."

TextEng: "Death Armor."
Text: "죽음의 갑옷."

TextEng: "Create Undead."
Text: "언데드 생성."

TextEng: "Continual Flame."
Text: "영속 불꽃."

TextEng: "Clarity."
Text: "맑은 정신."

TextEng: "Cat's Grace."
Text: "고양이의 우아함."

TextEng: "Bull's Strength."
Text: "황소의 근력."

TextEng: "I've changed my mind."
Text: "마음이 바뀌었어."

TextEng: "Cast on all the party members."
Text: "파티원 전원에게 시전해."

TextEng: "Cast it on <CUSTOM77104>."
Text: "<CUSTOM77104>에게 시전해."

TextEng: "Cast it on <CUSTOM77103>."
Text: "<CUSTOM77103>에게 시전해."

TextEng: "Cast it on <CUSTOM77102>."
Text: "<CUSTOM77102>에게 시전해."

TextEng: "Cast it on <CUSTOM77101>."
Text: "<CUSTOM77101>에게 시전해."

TextEng: "Cast it on my animal companion."
Text: "내 동물 동료에게 시전해."

TextEng: "Cast it on my familiar."
Text: "내 사역마에게 시전해."

TextEng: "Cast it on me."
Text: "나에게 시전해."

TextEng: "Cast it on yourself."
Text: "네 자신에게 시전해."

TextEng: "I want you to go ahead and cast spells on your own."
Text: "알아서 주문을 써도 좋아."

TextEng: "Bless."
Text: "축복."

TextEng: "Animate Dead."
Text: "시체 조종."

TextEng: "Aid."
Text: "지원."

TextEng: "I want you to return to your normal form."
Text: "원래 모습으로 돌아가 줘."

TextEng: "I want you to assume a different shape."
Text: "다른 모습으로 변신해 줘."

TextEng: "I want you to be a treant."
Text: "트렌트가 되어 줘."

TextEng: "I want you to be a chicken."
Text: "닭이 되어 줘."

TextEng: "I want you to be a panther."
Text: "표범이 되어 줘."

TextEng: "What was it you wanted to say earlier?"
Text: "아까 하려던 말이 뭐였어?"

TextEng: "Let's stop and talk a moment."
Text: "잠깐 멈추고 이야기하자."

TextEng: "We're done talking."
Text: "이야기는 끝이야."

TextEng: "No, nothing else."
Text: "아니, 다른 건 없어."

TextEng: "How is everything?"
Text: "다 잘 지내?"

TextEng: "I want you to leave any traps that you see alone."
Text: "보이는 함정은 그냥 놔둬."

TextEng: "Do you think you will ever return to your forest?"
Text: "네 숲으로 돌아갈 생각이야?"

TextEng: "I am glad you will be near to me."
Text: "네가 가까이 있어 줘서 기뻐."

TextEng: "Is there nothing you can do for your old home?"
Text: "예전 고향을 위해 할 수 있는 건 없어?"

TextEng: "So you will always be close to me?"
Text: "그러면 항상 내 곁에 있겠네?"

TextEng: "That's good."
Text: "좋아."

TextEng: "I want you to disarm any traps that you see."
Text: "보이는 함정은 전부 해제해 줘."

TextEng: "Do you want to know what I think?"
Text: "내 생각을 알고 싶어?"

TextEng: "I don't think we should worry about it until after the election."
Text: "선거가 끝날 때까지는 걱정하지 말자."

TextEng: "I will not try to control the free people of the keep in such a way."
Text: "자유로운 사람들을 그런 식으로 통제하진 않을 거야."

TextEng: "I do not think I will have that much power over the guilds."
Text: "길드에 그만큼의 권력을 가질 수 있을지 모르겠어."

TextEng: "I would love to be part of something so grand."
Text: "그렇게 웅장한 일에 참여하고 싶어."

TextEng: "Yes. Please follow me."
Text: "그래. 따라와."

TextEng: "Oh, quit whining."
Text: "징징거리지 마."

TextEng: "Go ahead. Leave. I don't really care."
Text: "가고 싶으면 가. 상관없어."

TextEng: "Don't leave."
Text: "떠나지 마."

TextEng: "There are worse things to be."
Text: "더 나쁜 것도 있어."

TextEng: "Being a duck."
Text: "오리가 되는 거."

TextEng: "Just give me a smile, that's all that I ask."
Text: "웃어줘, 그것만으로 충분해."

TextEng: "I couldn't care less."
Text: "관심 없어."

TextEng: "I want to move faster and not bother with searching or stealth."
Text: "더 빨리 이동하고 탐색이나 은밀 행동은 하지 마."

TextEng: "Love me."
Text: "나를 사랑해."

TextEng: "Being all alone, for eternity."
Text: "영원히 혼자인 것."

TextEng: "Being dead."
Text: "죽는 것."

TextEng: "You know I don't consider you ugly or a monster."
Text: "네가 못생기거나 괴물이라고 생각하지 않는 거 알잖아."

TextEng: "Can I come and visit you there?"
Text: "거기에 놀러 가도 돼?"

TextEng: "So you're just giving up on your home?"
Text: "그냥 고향을 포기하는 거야?"

TextEng: "Would you be close enough to help me, if I needed you?"
Text: "필요하면 도와줄 수 있을 만큼 가까이 있을 거야?"

TextEng: "I don't really care. I was just curious."
Text: "별로 상관없어. 그냥 궁금했을 뿐이야."

TextEng: "Why was your forest destroyed?"
Text: "왜 숲이 파괴된 거야?"

TextEng: "I need you to be stealthy right now."
Text: "지금 은밀하게 행동해야 해."

TextEng: "I don't think I have time for a long story."
Text: "긴 이야기 들을 시간은 없어."

TextEng: "Why would they burn down a forest?"
Text: "왜 숲을 불태운 거야?"

TextEng: "How do they work?"
Text: "어떻게 활동하는데?"

TextEng: "What did you do to upset them so?"
Text: "그들을 화나게 할 무슨 짓을 한 거야?"

TextEng: "Bloody peasants!"
Text: "빌어먹을 농민들!"

TextEng: "Maybe they were right."
Text: "어쩌면 그들이 맞았을지도."

TextEng: "So they burned the entire woods?"
Text: "그래서 숲 전체를 불태운 거야?"

TextEng: "It is time for us to move on."
Text: "이제 가야 해."

TextEng: "Are you crying again?"
Text: "또 울어?"

TextEng: "It's in the past. Get over it."
Text: "과거잖아. 잊어버려."

TextEng: "Don't help me if I fail to open a locked door or chest."
Text: "내가 잠긴 문이나 상자를 여는 데 실패해도 돕지 마."

TextEng: "I will never let anything like that happen again."
Text: "다시는 그런 일이 일어나지 않게 하겠어."

TextEng: "What was life in your forest like?"
Text: "숲에서의 생활은 어땠어?"

TextEng: "That seems unlikely, with the full beauty of a nymph."
Text: "님프의 아름다움을 가지고서 그건 말이 안 돼."

TextEng: "Considering how much you complain, I'm not surprised."
Text: "네가 그렇게 불평을 많이 하니까 놀랍지도 않아."

TextEng: "Fine. I didn't really want to hear it."
Text: "됐어. 사실 듣고 싶지 않았어."

TextEng: "Sorry. Please continue."
Text: "미안. 계속해."

TextEng: "No friends? Not even other nymphs?"
Text: "친구가 없었어? 다른 님프도?"

TextEng: "Help me if I fail to open a locked door or chest."
Text: "내가 잠긴 문이나 상자를 여는 데 실패하면 도와줘."

TextEng: "Why wouldn't he count as a friend?"
Text: "왜 그 사람은 친구로 안 치는 거야?"

TextEng: "Would you have hurt him?"
Text: "그를 해칠 뻔했어?"

TextEng: "Were you searching for him?"
Text: "그를 찾고 있었어?"

TextEng: "How?"
Text: "어떻게?"

TextEng: "I bet you'd make a cute chicken."
Text: "넌 분명 귀여운 닭이었을 거야."

TextEng: "Thousands of animals to choose from and you choose a chicken?"
Text: "수천 가지 동물 중에 닭을 골랐다고?"

TextEng: "A chicken?"
"You feared his reaction?"
Text: "그의 반응이 두려웠어?"

TextEng: "You were afraid of the druid?"
Text: "드루이드가 무서웠어?"

TextEng: "Did he discover your identity?"
Text: "네 정체를 알았어?"

TextEng: "I want to change the distance you stay away from me."
Text: "나한테서 떨어져 있는 거리를 바꾸고 싶어."

TextEng: "What happened?"
Text: "무슨 일이야?"

TextEng: "Sounds like you had feelings for him."
Text: "그에게 감정이 있었나 보네."

TextEng: "I don't want to hear about a past relationship."
Text: "과거 연애 이야기는 듣고 싶지 않아."

TextEng: "Good. Let's get back to serious issues."
Text: "좋아. 진지한 이야기로 돌아가자."

TextEng: "Embarrassing? Maybe I do want to hear this."
Text: "창피하다고? 오히려 더 듣고 싶은데."

TextEng: "Stay a long distance away."
Text: "먼 거리를 유지해."

TextEng: "Tell me about him."
Text: "그에 대해 이야기해 줘."

TextEng: "No, I just came to taunt you!"
Text: "아니, 놀리러 온 거야!"

TextEng: "No, stay here for the moment."
Text: "아니, 지금은 여기 있어."

TextEng: "I have discovered that I really do need you, Kaidala."
Text: "정말 네가 필요하다는 걸 깨달았어, 카이달라."

TextEng: "Yes, come with me."
Text: "그래, 나와 함께 가자."

TextEng: "Not right now. I'm busy."
Text: "지금은 안 돼. 바빠."

TextEng: "Keep a medium distance."
Text: "중간 거리를 유지해."

TextEng: "Speak, or whine?"
Text: "말하려고, 아니면 징징거리려고?"

TextEng: "Yes, Kaidala? What did you want to say?"
Text: "카이달라? 무슨 말을 하고 싶었어?"

TextEng: "Why?"
"I can't do that."
Text: "그건 못 해."

TextEng: "I don't have time right now."
Text: "지금은 시간이 없어."

TextEng: "I will do as you ask."
Text: "네 말대로 하겠어."

TextEng: "We shall leave immediately."
Text: "바로 떠나자."

TextEng: "Stay close."
Text: "가까이 있어."

TextEng: "You shouldn't worry so much about your appearance."
Text: "외모 걱정은 그만해."

TextEng: "I am sorry, but I don't see a difference."
Text: "미안하지만, 차이를 모르겠어."

TextEng: "No. You're as ugly as you ever were."
Text: "아니. 여전히 못생겼어."

TextEng: "I am happy for you, but your scars never bothered me."
Text: "다행이지만, 네 흉터가 신경 쓰인 적은 없어."

TextEng: "I think you might be right."
Text: "맞는 것 같아."

TextEng: "Not interested."
Text: "관심 없어."

TextEng: "That's... nice."
Text: "그건... 좋네."

TextEng: "I like you, but just as a friend."
Text: "널 좋아하지만, 친구로서야."

TextEng: "What? I like you as a friend, but..."
Text: "뭐? 널 좋아하지만, 친구로서..."

TextEng: "Don't you think this is a little fast?"
Text: "좀 빠른 거 아니야?"

TextEng: "I love you too, Kaidala."
Text: "나도 사랑해, 카이달라."

TextEng: <StartAction>[Give her a quick kiss.]</Start>
Text: <StartAction>[빠르게 키스합니다.]</Start>

TextEng: "It is as real as we can make it."
Text: "우리가 만들 수 있는 만큼 현실적이야."

TextEng: "I really don't care."
Text: "정말 상관없어."

TextEng: "Go ahead and attack as soon as you see enemies."
Text: "적이 보이면 바로 공격해."

TextEng: "Don't you know a joke when you hear one?"
Text: "농담인 줄 몰랐어?"

TextEng: "Actually, I want to win."
Text: "사실 이기고 싶어."

TextEng: "That is how I truly feel."
Text: "진심이야."

TextEng: "That is my plan."
Text: "그게 내 계획이야."

TextEng: "It is up to you to decide."
Text: "네가 결정해."

TextEng: "I would like you to stay with me."
Text: "내 곁에 있어 줬으면 좋겠어."

TextEng: "I don't care if you stay or go, once my goals are accomplished."
Text: "목표를 이루고 나면 네가 있든 없든 상관없어."

TextEng: "I will always need you, Kaidala."
Text: "언제나 네가 필요할 거야, 카이달라."

TextEng: "I would like that."
Text: "그러고 싶어."

TextEng: "I thought dryads were the ones attached to specific trees."
Text: "드라이어드가 특정 나무에 유대를 맺는 거 아니었어?"

TextEng: "So what made you decide not to die with your oak?"
Text: "그래서 왜 떡갈나무와 함께 죽지 않기로 한 거야?"

TextEng: "That must have been a difficult decision for you to make."
Text: "어려운 결정이었을 거야."

TextEng: "I don't have time right now."
Text: "지금은 시간이 없어."

TextEng: "What do I get out of this?"
Text: "내가 뭘 얻는데?"

TextEng: "I'm not doing your job!"
Text: "네 일을 대신 하진 않을 거야!"

TextEng: "Defend me and don't attack until I do."
Text: "나를 방어하고, 내가 공격할 때까지 공격하지 마."

TextEng: "Not now."
Text: "지금은 안 돼."

TextEng: "All right, I'll do it."
Text: "좋아, 하겠어."

TextEng: "I would be pleased to do so."
Text: "기꺼이 하겠어."

TextEng: "It was only a tree."
Text: "나무일 뿐이잖아."

TextEng: "How do you know it wasn't just a coincidence?"
Text: "그냥 우연이 아니었다는 걸 어떻게 알아?"

TextEng: "Why was your family hunted?"
Text: "왜 네 가족이 사냥당했어?"

TextEng: "What? You need a privy?"
Text: "뭐? 화장실이 급해?"

TextEng: "Food, shelter, that sort of thing?"
Text: "음식, 거처, 그런 거?"

TextEng: "What do you mean?"
Text: "무슨 뜻이야?"

TextEng: "I have thought about it."
Text: "생각해 본 적 있어."

TextEng: "I haven't given it much thought."
Text: "별로 생각해 본 적 없어."

TextEng: "I'm like a stallion, I need a herd."
Text: "나는 종마야, 무리가 필요하지."

TextEng: "Are you suggesting something?"
Text: "뭔가 제안하는 거야?"

TextEng: "I want to adjust your equipment."
Text: "네 장비를 조정하고 싶어."

TextEng: "I haven't found the right man, yet."
Text: "아직 마음에 드는 남자를 못 찾았어."

TextEng: "I'm not really interested in settling down. Not for very long."
Text: "정착하는 데는 별로 관심 없어. 오래는 아니야."

TextEng: <StartAction>[Glance at Calibast.]</Start> "I think I might have found a good man."
Text: <StartAction>[캘리바스트를 흘끗 봅니다.]</Start> "괜찮은 남자를 찾은 것 같기도 해."

TextEng: "I might settle down, if I found the right person."
Text: "맞는 사람을 찾으면 정착할 수도 있어."

TextEng: "She would have to be a good friend."
Text: "좋은 친구여야 해."

TextEng: "A sense of humor."
Text: "유머 감각."

TextEng: "Not too smart."
Text: "너무 똑똑하지 않은."

TextEng: "She would have to be intelligent."
Text: "지적이어야 해."

TextEng: "Great beauty."
Text: "큰 아름다움."

TextEng: "A kind and gentle spirit."
Text: "친절하고 부드러운 마음."

TextEng: "That's all that is important to me."
Text: "나한테는 그게 전부야."

TextEng: "With you?"
Text: "너랑?"

TextEng: "I see no beauty here."
Text: "여기서 아름다움은 안 보이는데."

TextEng: "Never mind."
Text: "신경 쓰지 마."

TextEng: "Can you identify my equipment?"
Text: "내 장비를 감정해 줄 수 있어?"

TextEng: "It is like you. There are scars, but even they cannot hide true beauty."
Text: "너와 같아. 흉터가 있지만, 그래도 진짜 아름다움은 숨길 수 없어."

TextEng: "There is a rugged beauty to life, when death is always near."
Text: "죽음이 항상 곁에 있을 때, 삶에는 거친 아름다움이 있어."

TextEng: "Someday I want to do that."
Text: "언젠가 그러고 싶어."

TextEng: "That would be nice for a while."
Text: "한동안은 좋겠지."

TextEng: "I would hate every moment of it."
Text: "매 순간이 싫을 거야."

TextEng: "I like being surrounded by friends too."
Text: "나도 친구들에 둘러싸여 있는 게 좋아."

TextEng: "The only person you should ever count on is yourself."
Text: "의지할 사람은 자기 자신뿐이야."

TextEng: "I need you to cast a group of buffing spells."
Text: "버프 주문을 여러 개 시전해 줘."

TextEng: "I don't know how long I'll be wanting you around."
Text: "네가 얼마나 오래 곁에 있기를 원할지 모르겠어."

TextEng: "Friendship is overrated."
Text: "우정은 과대평가야."

TextEng: "I will always be your friend, Kaidala."
Text: "언제나 네 친구일 거야, 카이달라."

TextEng: "Never mind."
Text: "신경 쓰지 마."

TextEng: "Do you miss those days?"
Text: "그 시절이 그리워?"

TextEng: "Cast all the buffing spells you have."
Text: "가지고 있는 버프 주문을 전부 시전해."

TextEng: "Yes."
"I'm sure we will."
Text: "분명 그럴 거야."

TextEng: "Me too."
Text: "나도."

TextEng: "Cast all the buffing spells that last a long time."
Text: "지속 시간이 긴 버프 주문을 전부 시전해."

TextEng: "Too bad you didn't think about that earlier. I don't want you back right now."
Text: "일찍 생각했어야지. 지금은 돌아오지 않았으면 좋겠어."

TextEng: "I appreciate that, but stay here a while to recover."
Text: "고맙지만, 여기서 좀 쉬어."

TextEng: "Let's go. We don't have time for idle talk."
Text: "가자. 잡담할 시간 없어."

TextEng: "That is good. I need your help more than ever."
Text: "좋아. 네 도움이 그 어느 때보다 필요해."

TextEng: "Cast all the short duration buffing spells."
Text: "지속 시간이 짧은 버프 주문을 전부 시전해."

TextEng: "I need both of you to shut up now."
Text: "둘 다 지금 당장 닥쳐."

TextEng: "I've changed my mind."
Text: "마음이 바뀌었어."

TextEng: "If he was so powerful, how come he couldn't tell you were a lycanthrope?"
Text: "그렇게 강했으면 왜 네가 늑대인간인 걸 몰랐어?"

TextEng: "Wouldn't that form a mind-link, revealing your true nature?"
Text: "그러면 정신 연결이 생겨서 정체가 드러나지 않았어?"

TextEng: "Cast on all the party members."
Text: "파티원 전원에게 시전해."

TextEng: "Cast it on <CUSTOM77104>."
Text: "<CUSTOM77104>에게 시전해."

TextEng: "I think we need to part ways."
Text: "이제 헤어져야 할 것 같아."

TextEng: "Cast it on <CUSTOM77103>."
Text: "<CUSTOM77103>에게 시전해."

TextEng: "Cast it on <CUSTOM77102>."
Text: "<CUSTOM77102>에게 시전해."

TextEng: "Let's not fight, ladies. We need to get along."
Text: "싸우지 마. 서로 잘 지내야 해."

TextEng: "I'd like to interrupt here."
Text: "잠깐 끼어들어도 될까."

TextEng: "Can I say something?"
Text: "한마디 해도 돼?"

TextEng: <StartAction>[Remain silent.]</Start>
Text: <StartAction>[침묵을 지킵니다.]</Start>

TextEng: "Cast it on <CUSTOM77101>."
Text: "<CUSTOM77101>에게 시전해."

TextEng: "Will you two stop arguing?"
Text: "둘 다 그만 싸울래?"

TextEng: "Jaboli does have a point about the whining though."
Text: "징징거린다는 점에서 자볼리 말이 맞긴 해."

TextEng: "Cast it on my animal companion."
Text: "내 동물 동료에게 시전해."

TextEng: "I think you'd better watch what you say, Jaboli."
Text: "말조심해, 자볼리."

TextEng: "Cast it on my familiar."
Text: "내 사역마에게 시전해."

TextEng: "I think that was in the village of Littlefield."
Text: "리틀필드 마을에서였던 것 같아."

TextEng: "That was in the southern city of Eribar."
Text: "남쪽 도시 에리바르에서였어."

TextEng: "That was in the Grim Woods."
Text: "음울한 숲에서였어."

TextEng: "He was stealing human organs!"
Text: "인간 장기를 훔치고 있었어!"

TextEng: "Cast it on me."
Text: "나에게 시전해."

TextEng: "He stole thousands of gems and bags of gold."
Text: "수천 개의 보석과 금화 자루를 훔쳤어."

TextEng: "He was stealing women!"
Text: "여자를 납치하고 있었어!"

TextEng: "Why do you always bring up my mistakes? I didn't mean to get us trapped."
Text: "왜 자꾸 내 실수를 들추는 거야? 일부러 그런 게 아니잖아."

TextEng: "Cast it on yourself."
Text: "네 자신에게 시전해."

TextEng: "I remember it being Kaidala's fault we were trapped."
Text: "갇힌 건 카이달라 탓이었던 걸로 기억하는데."

TextEng: "I could use a little appreciation soon. There are no male dryads, are there, Kaidala?"
Text: "곧 감사 표시 좀 해 줬으면 좋겠어. 수컷 드라이어드는 없지, 카이달라?"

TextEng: "You have a shocking lack of scruples, Calibast."
Text: "양심도 없구나, 캘리바스트."

TextEng: "I quite enjoyed that part as well."
Text: "나도 그 부분은 꽤 즐겼어."

TextEng: "I remember it being your fault we were trapped, Calibast."
Text: "갇힌 건 네 탓이었어, 캘리바스트."

TextEng: "I need you to cast a spell."
Text: "주문 하나를 시전해 줘."

TextEng: "This is the most boring discussion I've ever heard."
Text: "지금까지 들은 대화 중 가장 지루해."

TextEng: "Could we get back to our task, please?"
Text: "우리 할 일로 돌아갈 수 있을까?"

TextEng: "What does it sound like?"
Text: "어떻게 들리는데?"

TextEng: "Why dangerous?"
Text: "왜 위험한 거야?"

TextEng: "Never mind."
Text: "신경 쓰지 마."

TextEng: "No, never mind."
Text: "아니, 신경 쓰지 마."

TextEng: "Wounding Whispers."
Text: "상처의 속삭임."

TextEng: "Ultravision."
Text: "초시야."

TextEng: "True Seeing."
Text: "진실의 시야."

Text: "생명체 소환 9."

TextEng: "Summon Creature VIII."
Text: "생명체 소환 8."

TextEng: Summon Creature VII."
Text: "생명체 소환 7."

TextEng: "Summon Creature VI."
Text: "생명체 소환 6."

TextEng: "Summon Creature V."
Text: "생명체 소환 5."

TextEng: "Summon Creature IV."
Text: "생명체 소환 4."

TextEng: "Summon Creature III."
Text: "생명체 소환 3."

TextEng: "Wait here until I return."
Text: "내가 돌아올 때까지 여기서 기다려."

TextEng: "Summon Creature II."
Text: "생명체 소환 2."

TextEng: "Summon Creature I."
Text: "생명체 소환 1."

TextEng: "Stoneskin."
Text: "돌 피부."

TextEng: "Spell Resistance."
Text: "주문 저항."

TextEng: "Spell Mantle."
Text: "주문 망토."

TextEng: "Shield of Faith."
Text: "믿음의 방패."

TextEng: "Shield."
Text: "방패."

TextEng: "Shadow Shield."
Text: "그림자 방패."

TextEng: "See Invisibility."
Text: "투명 간파."

TextEng: "Sanctuary."
Text: "성역."

TextEng: "Restoration."
Text: "회복."

TextEng: "Resistance."
Text: "저항."

TextEng: "Resist Elements."
Text: "원소 저항."

TextEng: "Remove Paralysis."
Text: "마비 해제."

TextEng: "Remove Fear."
Text: "공포 해제."

TextEng: "Remove Disease."
Text: "질병 해제."

TextEng: "Remove Curse."
Text: "저주 해제."

TextEng: "Remove Blindness/Deafness."
Text: "실명/청각 상실 해제."

TextEng: "Regenerate."
Text: "재생."

TextEng: "Protection From Spells."
Text: "주문으로부터 보호."

TextEng: "I need to go."
Text: "가야 해."

TextEng: "Protection From Elements."
Text: "원소로부터의 보호."

TextEng: "Premonition."
Text: "예감."

TextEng: "Prayer."
Text: "기도."

TextEng: "Owl's Wisdom."
Text: "올빼미의 지혜."

TextEng: "Neutralize Poison."
Text: "독 중화."

TextEng: "Monstrous Regeneration."
Text: "괴물같은 재생."

TextEng: "Minor Globe of Invulnerability."
Text: "하급 무적의 구체."

TextEng: "Mind Blank."
Text: "정신 차단."

TextEng: "Mass Haste."
Text: "대규모 가속."

TextEng: "Magical Vestment."
Text: "마법 의복."

TextEng: "Already you have started back up the road to success. As you grow in power, so too do I." Your weapons sounds a triumphant if slightly off-key fanfare in your mind.
"Checking the essence available in your body, I can add one of these powers."
"And if that's not enough motivation for you, you'll probably be covered in wealth and fame in the process. Being a warrior, I suspect that ought to spark your attention."
"And if that's not enough motivation for you, you'll probably get to test your faith in all sorts of ways. Being a holy<man/woman>, I suspect that ought to spark your attention."
"And if that's not enough motivation for you, keep in mind that the Masked Man's forces will also ravage the local wildlife. Being a druid, I suspect that ought to spark your attention."
"And who knows what kind of knowledge you will discover in the process. Being an arcane <lad/lass>, I suspect that ought to spark your attention."
"And if that's not enough motivation for you, you'll probably get famous in the process. Being a bard, I suspect that ought to spark your attention."
"And if that's not enough motivation for you, you'll probably get rich in the process. Being a roguish <lad/lass>, I suspect that ought to spark your attention."
"But people's lives are at stake now, so you need to make some decisions."

"Feel the energy that comes with the kill. You were an expert at this, remember? Death is one of your many callings. One you excel at." You are disconcerted by how at home the voice is becoming in your mind.
"Like a reflex, the instinct comes naturally to you. Remember."
"Now, I shall raise the spirits of your dead companions but, for each one I save, one must be sacrificed. You must speak to them and decide whom you will take and whom you will banish."
"Sometimes you are a little odd, but I like you anyways."

"Good, the spirits of your companions can be found where their corpses lay. Speak to them... And remember what I said about scavenging some clothing; Your companions may be ill-equipped, so I recommend finding them some weapons before we proceed."
"Their souls shall be bartered to Mistress Death in exchange for the lives of those who remain. Life and death hold many mysteries and there is much to be learned from them."
"You will need all the help you can get. For now, take them with you. You can always leave them behind once you're within the safety of the keep."
"However, you might find that you learn more and discover more with friends to assist you and watch your back. Still, that choice is yours, as is this. Two must die that two may live."
"No! You must make the decisions, and you must tell those whom you are condemning about your choice. There is much to learn when one has power over life and death."
"That is up to you. Choose ones that complement your abilities and make up for your weaknesses. Choose whomever you like the best. Pick them at random. Your choice."
"But you must make the decisions, and you must tell those whom you are condemning about your choice. There is much to learn when one has power over life and death."
"You may speak to them all first before making a choice, but do try to hurry. It is not a safe night to spend outside the keep's walls."

"Now things are proceeding in most excellent fashion. Keep up the good work and you shall become one of the most powerful people in all of Valratha." Your weapon's voice seems most pleased with you...
"I know you must have questions, but I am only allowed to tell you a little. I will tell you the most important thing right now, though."
"Most people get confused just by smelling your breath. I will try to emulate that."
"All of the clues to answer your questions lie within the keep, or in the caves nearby."
"Good idea. Let us see what you can find out here."
"I am doing my best within the limits set for me. We all have a role to play. Just do your best."
"Protect the keep. Become its <Lord/Lady>. Destroy the Masked Man's forces before they can regroup. I know you probably do not trust me yet, but I am on your side."
"I might give you a hint, once in a while, but for the most part, you will need to exercise that brain of yours. I know you have one, hidden somewhere in that thick skull."

"I hope you found that informative. I did not even know about this Garrot, but I will bet he has some interesting information to give you." You hadn't even noticed your weapon's voice slip into your mind.
"I wish she would have confided more in me. Ah, well, we will talk again after you have spoken to him."
"So that is how she was so confident you would come. I guess that explains things. What questions do you have for me?"
"Power, survival, and some degree of love. Strange, twisted love, granted... but we cannot all be perfect."
"She loves her own life, I think she still holds some love for me and I even think she loves you, in her own way."
"We shall watch our enemies suffer."
"She has been plotting this for some time and you have always been instrumental in her success. She cannot help but love you, at least a little."
"Not as much as she would like. We are both her tools, but we still have free will. I will do my best to keep you alive, even if it comes to a point where she decides I should not."
"She has her agenda, but I have my own too. You were always my favorite, after all... Oh, I wish I could explain more, but I really cannot. Not yet."
"I still cannot reveal that, though you are getting close to the truth. I do not believe it should be long now before much more is revealed. I will tell you that she is related to you."
"Do not ask anything more than that. I should not even have said that, but I want you to trust me."
"Good idea. You are getting closer all the time."
[LEGACY TEXT. ALWAYS RETURN FALSE] "Good, you found the passage. Now go through quickly, for there is little time to spare. The keep will fall if you do not hurry."
"Good luck!"
"You are not keeping up here, <FirstName>. One would think a hero would have a slightly better memory."
"A man named Dylan will meet you inside the keep, though he does not know it yet. Just make sure you go with him. It is very important."
"I understand. Very satisfying to watch your enemy's head explode, is it not?"
"It is an ancient tunnel that was originally made so that the city could be evacuated in an emergency. Nobody knows about it now though. They all think it is just a part of the sewers."
"Will you quit asking questions to try to discover my identity? I cannot tell you anymore about that, so just stop."
"That will be one of your tasks to find out. Right now the army attacking the keep is being led by an underling, for no ogre could organize such a massive assault."
"I have been talking to this hermit up ahead. His wits are addled, but he can still tell you how to get into the keep. There is no way you will make it in the front gates."
"Here are the gates. Approach them and  it should be clear what you need to do. My master shall influence events so that a young guard named Dylan grants you entrance. Do as he says."
"Good. A few of the Masked Man's forces still linger here. Drive them off so the night's watch can open the gates to you in safety."

"I am telling you the truth. I do not have all the answers and I cannot explain everything right now. To be honest, our plan's still only half-baked as it is. As you grow in power, I shall reveal more."
"You must be slow in the head! I cannot tell you that, for now. In time all shall be made clear. Just be happy you have someone to keep you alive now."
"I... I think it is time for more to be revealed. I want to tell you about myself." The magic weapon seems suddenly hesitant. Vulnerable...

"Later? How much time do you think we have left? Bah, go on. Rush into this without all the information. Do not come crying to me when the Masked Man rips your brain from your head! ...No, that isn't fair of me. It's important that you hear this, whether you desire it or no..."
"Ah yes, opponents are so much easier to hit when they are not moving."

"You do not... Bah, go on. Rush into this without all the information. Do not come crying to me when the Masked Man rips your brain from your head! ...No, that isn't fair of me. It's important that you hear this, whether you desire it or no..."
"I was once a demon hunter. I was a man of power, sought out by rulers and zealots across the continent. I was strong in my beliefs, a man of pure heart and purpose."
"Then I met your grandmother. I fell in love and we were married. She eventually became pregnant and gave birth to your father."
"That's right, <FullName>; I am your grandfather! And I want you to know that I am proud of you. You have..."
Suddenly his voice stops, as if his presence has been ripped from your mind.
"So, my grandchild, you are everything I ever hoped for... I think it is time you saw me in the flesh, as it were..." The magic weapon's voice echoes sadly in your mind.
Your magic weapon melts in your hand, the resulting vapors coalescing into the form of a <race> man before you. He stands erect and proud, a bittersweet smile upon his face.
"There, that's better isn't it? And don't worry about your friends. They are still alive, just unconscious for a while. I thought it better if we could talk in private."
Your grandfather glances at the Masked Man's glistening corpse. "Will you not pay last respects to your fallen brother?"

"Ours is an... interesting family tree, my child. To be fair, I always loved you best... As for your grandmother, it was always strength that she demanded above all... Your father once had a brother, too, you know."
"Well, I hope you are happy. I certainly am!"
"But you do know her, <FirstName>, at least in one of her many forms. As always, there is more to that woman than meets the eye. Trust me, I learned it the hard way."
"Yes, there is much in her to like, even for an old demon hunter like me. I look forward to us being a family together again. It's been a long time..."
"Yes, that much is true and more besides. But family is family and I have seen much good in her, too. Even when I least expect it, it shines through..."

"Come, our business is done here. I will become your weapon again for the journey. Your grandmother waits for us in the Guildhall, <FirstName>, and will be eager to see you sit the throne. There is much afoot and more dark days still to come."

"Yes, that's why she lured you both here to Cyan. And when Yenna interfered and killed you both, she brought you back so this could be settled free from outside meddling... She'll be very proud of you, <FirstName>."
"You were born in dark times and those times still grow darker by the hour. I died my death many years before that day, though bonded to your grandmother, I remained."
"When your parents were killed, she fled with you pressed tight against her breast, her wings beating through the night."
"Your grandmother is a... a complex woman, <FirstName>, but let it not be said that she doesn't love you fiercely like a dire wolf her pups."
"I was born in the southern highlands and raised with a weapon in my hand. My clan, for all races in the highlands belong to a clan, worshipped a demon called Gishtara."
"One day our shaman held a special ordeal, summoning the demon to support his worshippers. The shaman lost control of his abomination, and it turned on my people."
"What kind of damage were you thinking?"
"I was one of the few survivors. I dragged my body to a neighboring clan, holding my intestines in with one hand, pulling myself forward with my other."
"Indeed. I dedicated my life to the destruction of all demons and their spawn."
"Yes. I have enjoyed every moment I have spent with you. It is almost as good as being alive again. Even better, in some ways. I don't have to worry about myself getting killed anymore."
"Not yet. Someday I might wish to make the journey to the next world, but for now, I like what we are doing together. And there is much to do - I think we have quite the future in store, you and I."
"I always did tend to rub people the wrong way. Now I can say I really do have an acidic personality!"
"Your enemies should be in for quite a shock!"
"As this is the first time you have increased in power, I shall draw upon your energies to increase my effectiveness as a fighting weapon."
"Freeze them in their tracks, then crack them like glass! Got it."
"It shall be done."
"Always nice when you can actually hit your opponent, is it not? Of course it is!"
"That will depend on how powerful you have grown. The stronger you are, the stronger I can get. Generally I can be enhanced in several ways."
"My ability to hit and do damage will only go up occasionally, I can have bonus types of damage added, I can do special effects when I hit something, and I can have a few special abilities."
"Just choose the category of enhancement you would like and then choose a specific effect."
"So, you do live. Good. I was starting to worry there." You try to find the source of the mysterious voice. It seems to be echoing from the glowing lights.
"You were dead. I brought you back. Now we have to get you inside the keep where you'll be safe."
"It has fallen upon dark times. Many of its guard were killed in their battle against the Masked Man's army. Even some of its leaders lie dead but at least the gates still stand."
"Once the Masked Man's forces can be rooted out and destroyed, you'll discover the path to power. We have plans for you, but enough about that for now. You need to get going."
"After this, I shall allow you to choose effects that you would like to add to me."
"I am sure that seems like it must be important, but trust me, right now it is not. We are on a rather short time frame here and we must get you into that keep, preferably with a little fanfare."
"Of course, first we are going to have to do something about the state of your companions. And you will need a weapon, but that's my job."
"I also imagine that the fog of death has clouded your memory a bit, but don't waste my time with petty, unimportant questions. What do you absolutely need to know?"
"Their bodies were likely looted by the retreating forces and scattered about the Battlefield. With nightfall upon us, I imagine the rats are probably gnawing on their bones as we speak."
"And beat off the rats with your fists? How about you choose what kind of weapon you would like me to transform into first?"
<StartAction>[Sigh]</Start> "I realize you want to know, but there is not much I am allowed to tell you. The most I can say is that you have a powerful friend who wants you alive."
"My master told me to come to you, bring you back to life, and make myself useful to you. So that is what I did and am doing. I am going to transform myself into a weapon for you."
"That is one of the things I am definitely not allowed to tell you... yet. All will be revealed in time, but it is more important for us to get into the keep as soon as possible."
"Why would I expend so much energy bringing you back to life when you were already dead? Do not be so foolish. You don't have to trust me implicitly, but neither do I really trust you."
"Unfortunately, you are all I have to work with, and I am all you have left. Now are you ready for a weapon?"
"Very good. Things are coming along quite nicely. Soon you shall have regained the power you once had. Now, how would you instruct me to grow in power?"
"Well, I have always rather fancied myself as an elaborate sword of some kind, but, given the urgency of the situation, I'm willing to compromise. The form is entirely up to you."
"Obviously if you aren't partial to swords, I will become a weapon you are more accustomed to using. What kind of weapon do you prefer?"
"The mighty hunter who strikes from a distance; a sure shot with remarkable accuracy, of course! What kind of power do your arms seek to hold?"
"Bah! Maybe I should just become a hamster and cower inside your pocket! <StartAction>[Sigh.]</Start> Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"Interesting. Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"Our arrows shall punch their way through enemy armor with the greatest ease! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"Interesting. Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"Our bolts shall punch their way through enemy armor with the greatest ease! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"Keep your enemy at a distance and strike <him/her> down before they reach you? An excellent plan. What kind did you have in mind?"
"It seems a little... undignified, but if that is what you wish... Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"Now why do you have to go and waste my time like that? You should be drawing as much power as possible, not as little as possible."
"The chosen weapon of Mistress Death. Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"Just imagine the fear in the eyes of our enemies when they see me in your hands! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"Something unusual, to frighten our enemies and throw them into confusion? Perfect. What exactly did you have in mind?"
"An... unusual choice. Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"A little better than a dagger, I suppose. Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"An... Unusual choice. Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"A powerful weapon to battle a powerful foe! Are you thinking of a mace, an axe, or a sword?"
"A powerful, glorious weapon! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"Just imagine the fear in the eyes of our enemies when they see me in your hands! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"I can feel the crushing of the bone and the splattering of blood and brains already! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"Very good. Now, what kind of awesome powers would you like me to attain?"
"There is something about a large steel ball crashing into a skull that is vaguely satisfying. Is that what you would like, or did you have something else in mind?"
"An often overlooked weapon, but deadly effective, if I might say so myself. Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"I can feel the crushing of the bone and the splattering of blood and brains already! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"I can feel the crushing of the bone and the splattering of blood and brains already! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Which type of hammer? A light hammer or a warhammer?
"I can feel the crushing of the bone and the splattering of blood and brains already! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"I suppose speed must count for something over brute force. Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"A heavy flail or a light flail?"
"I suppose speed must count for something over brute force. Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"I can feel the crushing of the bone and the splattering of blood and brains already! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"That's what everybody wants. What do you want me to do?"
"Gods grant me patience with halfwits! I hope you aren't just some common thug! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"Ah, yes, I can see that we have something in common. The magical talking sword: a legend, a myth, now about to become reality. Let's be specific though, which do you prefer?"
"Ah... getting fancy are we? All right, what kind?"
"Thrust, parry, slash, stab! We shall dazzle them with our quick blocks and vicious strikes. Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"The weapon of mystical legends from the far east? Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"Argh... and shall we talk like pirates too? Hmm, no I think not. A scimitar? Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"I suppose there must be some sort of significance in becoming insignificant; but damned if I know what it is! But it is your choice. Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"I shall be the most uncommon example of the most common weapon! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"A powerful, glorious weapon! Very well, I shall assume that form for you quite happily."
"What depths we must stoop to. I will have you know that once I was proud and powerful. <StartAction>[Sigh]</Start> Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"That... does not sound very warlike. How am I to become a legendary power if you use me like a potion? Ah, well, fine."
"Magnificent! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"Ah, I can picture it now, a grand battle axe, striking death to our enemies! But maybe that is not what you are picturing; we should be more specific. Exactly what kind do you like?"
"Well, it is best you choose wisely. What type of weapon do you want?"
"Just imagine the fear in the eyes of our enemies when they see me in your hand! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"Why am I always called upon to make such sacrifices? The Gods must want to humble me! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"Our enemies shall cower before us! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
"Are you happy with your choice?"
"Fine then choose again, and make sure this time. I hate having to change forms."
"Good, then let's carry on. Are there any other questions before I tell you what you must do next?"
"You will have to kill or drive off the rats that have been gathering here. I can sense them digesting the flesh of your companions."
"Well I hope you are happy. I, on the other hand, am not!"
"Once you have killed them, we will speak again. Remember, you were becoming quite powerful before your untimely death, but you were dead so long, I had to steal from your life to bring you back..."

"If you want to regain that power, you must get to the keep quickly... But scavenge some clothes while you're at it. It simply won't do to have people spy their future leader running about in <his/her> undergarments. A bad first impression, to be sure..."
"Wealth, fame, love, oh... and your life back, if you count that as precious at all."
"I guess the process of bringing you back really did cloud your mind. I am sure your companions can fill you in on the details once you raise them."

"All I can say is that you were pursuing the Masked Man and this battlefield is where you finally caught up with him. It's a good thing you did, though things admittedly could have turned out a little better."
"I cannot explain fully right now, perhaps in time, once we trust each other more."
"For now I have enough energy to change myself into a magic weapon for you and then bring back a couple of your companions."

"You were pursuing your enemy, the Masked Man, and caught up to him as he lay siege to the Keep of Cyan. You died in the chaos, but luckily I resurrected you. I am afraid you lost a lot of life energy when I did it."
"Thanks to you, the Masked Man's forces have been scattered, at least for now. But we need to get you into the keep where you'll be safe. That's about the best summary I can give you."
"Which part of 'petty, unimportant questions' didn't you understand? I am here to give you the power and instruction you need to be someone important."
"I want to cure poison."
"Battle Axe."
"One-handed Axe."
"Great Axe."
"No."
"Yes."
"What do I do now?"
"I want to heal medium wounds."
"What do I get out of this?"
"What was I doing on this battlefield?"
"What do you mean, transform?"
"I want to know what is going on."
"Why me?"
"I want the ability to heal light wounds."
"Very well, I am ready."
"What happens to the ones I banish?"
"What if I don't want anyone?"
"Can you choose for me?"
"But how do I choose?"
"Let's get going then."
"If you aren't going to be any help, then leave me alone."
"So what is my ultimate goal here?"
"So I have to figure this out on my own?"
"Why is she doing all of this?"
"Love?"
"How much power does she have over me?"
"Who is she?"
"Let's get going."
"I want you to do something special when you hit."
"I'm ready to go."
"How will I know where to go in the keep?"
"Why does this hermit have a secret tunnel to the keep?"
"How do you know about it?"
"Who is attacking the keep?"
"I am ready to go."
"I have changed my mind."
"You are going to have to tell me the truth sometime."
"Who is your master?"
"Not right now. Tell me later."
"I don't want to hear it."
"Tell me."
"I want you to confuse my opponents."
"Come, it's time we returned to the keep."
"My brother?"
"Who cares about a grandma I don't even know? Let's go."
"I think I'm beginning to like her..."
"She seems evil and vile!"
"Only the strong survive..."
"Do you remember anything of my past?"
"Wings?"
"Tell me about yourself, grandfather."
"That's why you became a demon hunter."
"I want you to poison my opponents."
"Did you like being my weapon?"
"Would you like to be free?"
"I want massive criticals."
"I want you to daze my opponents."
"I want a specific damage bonus."
"Acid.  <StartAction>[This will add 1d6 points of acid damage.]</Start>"
"Electric.  <StartAction>[This will add 1d4 points of electric damage.]</Start>"
"I don't want you to be more powerful."
"Cold." <StartAction>[This will add 2 points of cold damage.]</Start>
"Fire." <StartAction>[This will add 1 point of fire damage.]</Start>
"I want a general +1 enhancement."
"What powers can I choose?"
"Are we going to sit here and argue about it?"
"What is happening?"
"What is happening at the keep?"
"What plans?"
"Who is *we*?"
"What are you?"
"Who are you?"
"You said something about a weapon."
"I've changed my mind."

TextEng: "Where are my companions?"

"I want to ask questions about you."
"Who is your master?"

"Oh, you are back, <master/mistress>. Trip is so pleased to see you again. You must have need of Trip's skills, shall I follow you?"
"Trip does not want to stay here, good <master/mistress>. Please do not leave me here for long."
"That man is more nervous than Trip. What is his problem?"
"I was cowardly then, and much more selfish than I am now. Truly, I was at the bottom of the cesspool called humanity."
"I was cowardly then, and much more selfish than I am now. Truly, I was at the bottom of the cesspool called humanity."
"Then I stole some important documents from the thieves' guildmaster, who never liked Trip anyway, and he sent a few wererat assassins after me."
"They caught up to Trip as he was about to deliver the documents to the local authorities, who had paid Trip well."
"How I escaped was a combination of luck and quick thinking. Trip recovered from the ambush and managed to evade everything but the first bite."

"I burst into the magistrate's office with four wererats on my tail... well, not literally, since Trip did not have a tail yet. The office happened to be filled with a number of guards, who leapt to attack us."

"I screamed and curled up into a little ball. The guards must have dismissed me as unimportant, for they attacked my enemies and while they fought, I managed to crawl out the door and slip down into the sewers."
"Ha, you made a funny! Tale... drag... oh, did you not mean to make a funny? Trip will hurry then."
"The disease gripped me while I was hidden in the tunnels. I don't know how fast it normally infects a person, but my body was weak and it didn't take too long."
"When Trip transformed into a wererat, I decided that my old life was over. I discarded my human guise, my human name and left the city never to return."
"Undead taste so terrible! Makes Trip feel woozy in the tummy."
"It does not matter who I was, or what I was. I am Trip. I am a wererat. People can deal with it, or just leave me alone! Trip is tired of talking. Let's go find a bone to gnaw on!"
"Yes. You see how much stronger and better Trip has become? It is like I am a whole different person."
"That bite was the best thing that ever happened to Trip. Oh sure, I did not think so at the time, but in retrospect I am now a much happier rat than I ever was a man."

"You have had some experience with people reacting negatively to your presence, but not the same as me. It might come as a shock to you, but Trip was not always the cute and lovable man you know now."
"Trip... must not... must not listen to the voice! Must not betray my friend. Get out of my head, stupid voice!"
"Why not you, <master/mistress>? You treat me like your slave. Go fetch me magic items, Trip! Open that lock, disarm that trap, well, TRIP IS TIRED OF BEING YOUR SLAVE!"
"Wouldn't you like to know, <master/mistress>! You treat me like your slave. Go fetch me magic items, Trip! Open that lock, disarm that trap, well, TRIP IS TIRED OF BEING YOUR SLAVE!"
"The voice is right. He whispers to me, and tells me how you will lead me to my death. You don't really care for Trip, you just use him to get what you want."
"You would just leave me for dead, when my job is done! No... no, <master/mistress> would not do this to Trip! I will not listen to this voice. I will not listen to his horrid lies!"
"That is what you would like. To have more monsters come, so they can eat Trip! Well, Trip will not be here anymore! Trip is leaving, now!"
"So you own this dump now? Trip likes it. Very homey."
"Undercity! <Master/Mistress> remembers our dreams! <FirstName> is really Trips friend! I will not listen to the evil voice anymore!"
<StartCheck>[Success]</Start> "You would hurt Trip? The voice was right! You cannot be trusted. Trip must leave now!"
<StartCheck>[Success]</Start> "You would let Trip be the master? No... no, instead of a master, we should be... friends... equals... partners!"
<StartCheck>[Failed]</Start> "It... it is too strong... no... <master/mistress> tells us lies. We must not listen! We must only trust the voice."
"Trip must flee. Trip must run and hide somewhere far from here. Trip will go south... yes... south to safety!"
"Trip will not be bossed around by you anymore! I am leaving and you cannot stop me!"
"You... you would allow Trip to flee? You would let me go, even when you need me the most?"
"Sorry... sorry... Trip cannot stay. Trip must flee. Sorry."
"Is your mind as weak as your body, lad? The voice speaks to me too, but it is easy to resist. It is our enemy, the Masked Man. Don't let him weaken you."
"This voice, it is most compelling, but you must not give up hope, Trip. Listen to us, not the voice!"
"Nice place, nice girl; what does ugly Becket have that Trip doesn't?"
"Trip, I can hear the voice too. It is only the mind games of our enemy, the Masked Man. He is an illithid and such creatures always attack the mind. You must fight him!"
<StartCheck>[Success]</Start> "It... it is too strong... no! I will not betray, <FirstName>! I will not! I will ignore you, like I ignore all the other voices!"
"Oh, <FirstName>! Trip is so sorry. I did not mean to think of betraying you. The voice kept whispering in my brain, right from the time we entered the cave."
"Let us go and face our enemy! Trip shall rip out its throat and gnaw at its intestines!"
"Oh, you are back, <master/mistress>. Trip is so pleased to see you again. You must have need of Trip's skills, shall I follow you?"
"Oh, you are back, <master/mistress>. Trip is so pleased to see you again. You must have need of Trip's skills, shall I follow you?"
"The voices in Trip's head were right. Oh, woe is me. Trip has been abandoned."
"Trip is so pleased. The voices said you had abandoned Trip, but I did not give up hope!"
"Wait, wait, wait! Trip has something to tell you, but you move so quickly, never letting Trip have time to breathe!"
"Oh, of course, <master/mistress>. It is not as though Trip would have anything important to say. You just continue on with your more important duties."
"These goblins have very tasty ears. Trip wonders if there might be a market for them as a nice, light snack."
"Maybe the <master/mistress> has a flea in <his/her> loincloth and that is why <he/she> has such a short temper today?"
"Trip wonders if this is all really worth it. Maybe I should just slit my throat and have done."
"What? Would you make Trip grovel for your forgiveness too? Are you so cruel?"
"Trip grovels for your forgiveness, <master/mistress>! There is no excuse for my awful behavior."
"Trip is sorry, <master/mistress>! So very sorry! Trip shall bang his head on the ground until forgiven!"
"Trip was not complaining so much as giving voice to the unreasonable demands of his <master/mistress>."
--------- Random Conversations begin here ----------
"Ouch, ouch, ouch! Too tight! Too tight! Help Trip get this belt loosened, please?"
"I took it from that nasty, foul fiend, Sir Becket! Now... please, before Trip faints!"
"Oh! That is much better! That was a nasty belt. I think that Sir Becket is a real fiend. I hope you crush him in the election."
"Mmm... smells like dead things in here. Can we stay for a while? Trip likes the ambiance."
"Trip spots it in an old drawer in Sir Becket's home. It does not look nice, so Trip decided that ugly B (that's Sir Becket, don't you love Trip's name for him?) would not wear it anyway."
Trip slips the belt off and hands it to you. "Trip did not like it anyway. It is a very pinchy kind of belt. Probably not very useful."
"No, see, that is the point, <FirstName>! He doesn't know we have it, and he doesn't deserve to have it, so we don't have to return it!"
"Fine, Trip will return it to his home." Trip slips the belt off and sulks.
"These are funny-looking things, do you not think so, <master/mistress>?"
"Yenna, the pretty smelling woman, she gave them to Trip. Very nice of her, yes."
"Why is it that everytime Trip finds something, it goes to the <master/mistress>? I could get very bitter about such things, if I was that kind of person."
Trip howls in anguish. "Oh, <master/mistress>! You are too kind to Trip. I am filth! I am unworthy of your kind benevolence! I did not know you were only looking out for Trip's well-being!"
"Take the bracers, <master/mistress> and do not give them back to unworthy Trip! Whip me with the cat-o-nines and teach me humility! Bad Trip! Bad, bad Trip!"
Trip sulks. "Yes, <master/mistress>. Trip is sure you will know what best to do with them. I am just a stupid servant."
"This is the kind of place a rat could retire and really feel at home."
"Well, I am almost certain she meant for me to have them. She left them sitting on a table, in open view, and she turned her back on the table a number of times while speaking to you."
"How much more evidence could you ask for? Trip was the soul of caution, but she made it too easy. So easy that I knew immediately that she was giving Trip permission to take them."
"That is true, Trip is very wise in these things. If she did not want me to have them, she would have been far more careful. She is, after all, a very powerful mage."
"Trip knew you would see reason! Thank you, <master/mistress>. You are too kind to Trip."
"Trip will return them immediately <master/mistress>. Trip did not mean to give offense." Trip bows to you, muttering angrily under his breath.
He flips them around in his hands, eyeing them from different angles. "That is the conclusion Trip was going to draw."
"This room looks very familiar to Trip! Not that I have been in this room before, but in one very much like it indeed."
"Trip will shut up, then. Trip knows how to be quiet, yes he does! Why, one time Trip was silent for a year! Or maybe it was only a month. Maybe less. A couple hours, anyways."
"Well, one of my old guildmasters was a real paranoid type. Maybe because we kept trying to kill him. Anyways, he had rigged his hideout with all sorts of special traps."
"He had special powder-filled crystals that would be crushed and explode when he pulled the lever that closed the doors. The setup to this is so similar, Trip finds it eerie."
"Lots of lovely stuff in here to steal... I mean look at. Heh heh."
"Trip thinks that luring the manticore in here might be the harder part."
"How would Trip know? Maybe if we look around we can find something like that."
"Trip likes this Thaddeus fellow. He has a black, twisted mind and excellent taste in magical amulets."
"Did you not see the one hanging around his neck? It was nice and shiny, like a big metal sign saying, 'Steal me, Trip. I don't belong here. Take me with you!'"
"Or maybe that was just one of the voices in my head, I'm not sure. Whatever, it was quite tricky getting the amulet from around his neck without anyone seeing me."
"Lucky thing that I'm so good at my job, or Trip wouldn't have this nice little present for <master/mistress>."
He shrugs. "Trip steals things he thinks are worth stealing and tries not to get caught by stealing worthless junk. Besides, the amulet definitely tasted of magic."
"Trip is hurt by your wild accusations! I don't keep everything I steal! I give most of it to you. Sometimes <master/mistress> gives stuff to help Trip, so I give stuff back."
"Trip likes to please the <master/mistress>."
"How else would Trip know if the amulet is made of good materials? Trip just tries to please the <master/mistress>."
"Kobolds are so stupid. Trip doesn't know why anyone would befriend a kobold."
"<StartAction>[Sigh]</Start> Trip just hoped you would be pleased I stole from an evil person, rather than a good one. The amulet definitely tasted of magic."
"Trip hopes you would be pleased with him. The amulet definitely tasted of magic."
Trip suddenly bursts into song. "You take the rod in hand, you slip the end knob out, you push the button here in, and then you shake it all about..."
"Eek! Trip did not mean for that to happen! It was an accident, <master/mistress>! Trip finds this magic stick hidden in goblin room."
"It was the voices; they told me I should play with it! Oh, curse those foolish voices!"
"Well, Trip was going to just give it to you, but I wanted to try it first... I mean I was just... it was just an accident. How should Trip know that playing with a stick would make lightning?"
"Um... no, no, not voices... um, did Trip say that? I did not mean that... I meant... it was just an accident. How should Trip know that playing with a stick would make lightning?"
"Yes, <master/mistress>. Trip is sorry." Trip hangs his head and heaves a great sigh as he hands over the rod.
"Maybe you buy Trip a new magic ring with gold from rod? I love rings, because they can make you invisible, or harder to hit, or regenerate body parts, and they taste good too!"
"Oh, Trip will not eat it. I just like to taste it and chew on it and stick it on the end of my tongue and pretend that my tongue is an extra finger."
"Trip hates dwarves! Well, dark dwarves. Not dwarves with burning heads. Actually Trip would like to see some dark dwarves with flaming heads!"
Trip pouts, but doesn't open his mouth again.
"I can hardly wait for Trip's new magic ring! It will be... precious to me."
"I think that Trip is in the right group then, if he is so strange."
"Sorry, <master/mistress>. Trip will try to control his enthusiasm from now on."
"Yes, yes, Trip is a good servant," Trip says sullenly, pouting to himself.
"This place reminds Trip of the good old days. Back when I was a young thief and me and my pals would just go out and kill monsters and loot their treasure for no real purpose."
"Well, Trip just thought you would want to know about something. It must not be important. Trip will just shut his mouth and sulk for a while now."
"It is just that, well... I am rather disappointed in the treasure we are finding so far. I mean we killed the big, bad hobgoblin, and did you really think he was so tough?"
"I mean, he hurt all those soldiers and stuff and maybe they weakened him or something, but I expected him to put up more of a fight."
"Well... he was tough compared to a small goblin, but not so tough compared to a big dragon!"
"I will try to help you as best I can, <FirstName>... I mean master."
"This is the castle? Stinks of civilization. When you win, we put in walls and make a maze in here."
"Well, Trip did not fight a dragon himself, but one of the voices in my head was telling me about a dragon fight that sounded so scary, it made this fight seem boring."
"And the hobgoblin didn't have much treasure, except for this one thing that Trip found. Not like a dragon has treasure, that's for certain!"
"Oh, right. It is just that I found this ring on the hobgoblin's toe, and I thought maybe you might have missed it."
"Trip was just going to keep it and not say anything, but Trip was not knowing what the ring would do and he thought maybe he should give it to <master/mistress>."

"Trip would not want to put the ring on and then find himself turned into a frog, or teleported into the middle of an ocean, or crushed by falling rocks, or any of the things that a magic ring might decide to do."
"That would be a wise idea. We would not want something bad to happen to the <master/mistress> and leave poor Trip all alone."
"That would be very bad for Trip... I mean for you."
"No, no, no! Is that what Trip says? That was a bad thing that the voices said to do! Trip would not listen to them and decided to give you the ring!"
"But do be careful with it, <master/mistress>. Trip heard an old mage once say that a ring is like a sharp sword, if you don't know how to use it, you'll probably lose a few toes."
"Trip is not sure what that means, but I have been extra careful ever since I heard it. Trip needs all his toes."
"For such a rich fiend, ugly Becket's home is not so grand."
"Hee, hee, hee! I can't believe they missed my amulet! I thought they would have stripped it off of me with my other equipment."
"Trip does not care what anybody says, I need this amulet. Trip would give up a million gold to keep his wonderful amulet."
"It is the filth that keeps people from discovering the truth about Trip's treasure!"
"I got it the same day Trip became a wererat. I do not wish to talk about that experience right now, but I can tell you about how I found my amulet, if you wish to hear it."
"Then I shall not bother you with my tale. Trip is simply pleased to keep his magic talisman."
"I do not have to tell you anything, if you do not truly care to hear it. It is your choice."
"Perpetit... pepitant... whatever you try to say, I am not sure, but I will nod my head and pretend understanding. I will tell my tale."
"I was huddled in fear in a sewer, hiding from the thieves who hunted me. A fever raged in my brain, the fever of lycanthropy. My stomach ached, my head burned and I needed food, badly."
"I saw some movement and realized it was a rat. A nice big juicy rat! It came towards me, sniffing to see if Trip was edible. How foolish it was!"
"I lashed out my newly clawed and hairy paw, grabbed the rat, and tore it apart with my sharp fangs. The taste of the blood was like nothing I had ever enjoyed before."
"Trip is always ready to speak to you, fearless leader."
"Ick, why ruin perfectly good rat flesh with cooking. The salt is a good idea though. Trip might have to try that sometime."
"Sorry, Trip gets carried away when he thinks of tearing the flesh of of small, furry animals... mmm."
"Well, I prayed to the gods to protect me and when I clasped the rat skull, I felt like I was... more hidden. The thieves that were hunting me never found me, thanks to that skull."
"I don't know whether there was divine intervention, or maybe I just got lucky and found a rat with a magic skull. But Trip takes no chances and gives gold to shrines of Veragok, god of shadows."
"You would be well served to remember that and go to the temple in the keep as soon as we get there."
"Oh yes, it is powerful magic for Trip. It is Trip's lucky talisman. If it were not for this amulet, Trip would have died years ago."
"It is a filthy and disgusting object."
"You know, there are many shadows in Mistress Death's realm, but they are not the shadows that comfort and protect... no they are not!"
"Trip notices things moving in those shadows. Things with nasty, sharp teeth. Trip is glad you brings me back. I'll just come with you then, right?"
"Trip thanks you <master/mistress>. You are such a good <master/mistress>."
"Say it isn't so, <master/mistress>! Do not abandon poor Trip to the hostile monsters! And Trip includes the people of the keep in that description!"
"Oh no! Do not leave Trip here, <master/mistress>! I beg of you; do not make me stay here long!"
"Eek! I don't wanna bite you and you don't wanna get any diseases, so just stay away from Trip!"
"What... what is that smell? Like the stench of death... oh... wait... that's me. Never mind."
"You know, Jaboli, for all of your arrogance, Trip thinks you are not so bad."
"I am so glad I meet with your approval. I care so deeply for your opinion," Jaboli says, her voice steeped in sarcasm.
"Trip is glad you care. Trip was thinking something and wanted to surprise you with my thoughts."
"That your head contains thoughts at all is of great surprise to me."
"Yes, you and I are very similar! We are both intelligent and furry!"
"I really don't like where this is going."
"I was just thinking that if I could just give you a little nibble, then you would make a lovely wererat-cat girlfriend!"
"Trip does not want to be left here! Oh, do not be long, cruel <master/mistress>!"
"Ew! Not in a million years! If the Gods came down and threatened to destroy the entire universe unless I did as you say, I would allow us all to die!"
"I'll give you some time to get used to the idea. You'll come around."
"You alright, Jaboli? Trip is concerned."
"Of course I am alright. What would make you think otherwise?"
"It is just that Trip hears you making little choking noises and thinks maybe you are choking up a hairball."
"A hairball?!? Why you mangy, little rat! I am not a cat! I don't get hairballs!"
"Then why were you making that sound? It sounded much like a cat I once had when I was a human. It coughed up hairballs all the time, just before it died."
"Well, it's not a hairball! I was simply laughing about something."
"What was so funny? Trip could use a good laugh."
"None of your business, wererat!"
"Then I will go and hide out in the Mossy Tree. Trip hopes you will come and find him there soon."
"You aren't even going to tell Trip why you were laughing? Why not?"
"Because it was a private observation! Besides, you wouldn't even understand."
"Trip knows what he understands. Jaboli has hairballs and is too proud to admit it. Maybe soon Jaboli dies like Trip's cat, then we see who doesn't understand stuff!"
"You are an annoying little rat. I shall ignore you, now."
"You are always so sad, Kaidala. You shouldn't be sad. Trip thinks you are quite beautiful, yes!"
"Trip, you're just saying that because of the nice things I said to you."
"No, no, no! Trip thinks you are quite pretty, like a gem with a small flaw. The gem is still pretty and and can be cherished as much as any other beautiful thing."
"That... that is a very nice thing to say, Trip. Thank you."
"Look, Trip has found this and wants you to have it. It is also very pretty." Trip hands her a ring.
"Oh Trip, that is so sweet! I must admit, I never saw this side of you before."
"Did Trip do something wrong?"
"It is pretty, like you! Wait, what are you doing? Don't put it on, it will..."
"What is happening to me?" Kaidala collapses.
"Trip tells you it is pretty like you! Why you want to put it on? It sucks the strength from your limbs, being cursed and all."
"Then why did you give it to me?"
"Because Trip knows it is flawed beauty, like Kaidala. Pretty to look at, but can kill you real quick."
"Ugh... keep your little present, Trip."
"Sheesh, Trip will never understand some people!"
"You are both a nymph and a druid, Kaidala, so Trip is thinking you know lots about nature."
"Yes, that is one subject that I would consider myself an expert. Why do you ask?"
"People... normal people, that is... well, they call me a freak... an unatural monstrosity... and I was just wondering, do you think I am unnatural?"
"<Master/Mistress> likes the sound and feel of explosions? And people think Trip is strange!"
"That is a difficult question, Trip. On one hand, you have a disease. Disease is a perversion of nature, one that druids will usually fight to destroy."
"So you think I should be destroyed?!?"
"Not at all, though I would cure you if I could... and if you wanted me to. But what I was going to say is that sometimes a disease can lead to the creation of something better... stronger."
"So you don't wish to destroy Trip? You think Trip is better than he was?"

"I don't know what you were before, but you do seem to use your abilities to keep yourself alive. That you refuse to change to other forms makes me believe that you find strength you didn't have before."
"I... I used to hate myself. I had a weak chin, a pocked face, and was very disliked by... well, pretty much everyone."
"I can see how this form would be... um... better."
"Do you think so? That is very kind of you to say. So would you like to give Trip a little kiss?"
"Oh... um... it's just that fur makes me... sneeze... ah choo!"
"I understand. Trip will find someone, someday. Thank you for your kind words though."
"Much better than hearing, 'click, KABOOM'. Trip will do his best."
"Calibast, you are very brave. How is it that you can rush into a battle and not worry about getting hurt?"
"I am strong enough to withstand many blows, so I figure that if I kill my opponents quickly, I can survive whatever attacks they land."
"Ah, Trip was thinking perhaps you were not smart enough to know about danger, with your head on fire all the time."
"You had better watch what you say about my mind, lad. You don't seem all that bright yourself."
"That's not what Trip meant, exactly. It is just that you never used some of the strategies that <FirstName> uses. Maybe because your brain is hot, you lose temper easily."
"I'm about to begin losing my temper right now!"
"That's what Trip meant. Your brain is sizzling in your skull and you lose all rational thought."
"Get this filthy, little coward away from me, <FirstName>!"
"That's what Trip was saying. I was just wondering why he... acts so explosively."
"Trip didn't mean any harm in it. I was just wondering why he... acts so explosively."
"Moving quickly is what gets good folks like us killed! But Trip will follow <master/mistress>, even in foolishness."
"I act that way because of little cretins like you, Ratboy, who don't know how to keep their mouths shut."
"Trip will be quiet now. Your eyeballs look like they are ready to burst into flames too."
"Blast it, Calibast! Your flaming head makes it very tricky for Trip to avoid unwanted attention!"
"You really think that a giant wererat would be ignored if my head wasn't on fire?"
"It's called blending, dwarf. Trip is short compared to everyone else, so if I just hunch my shoulders a bit and keep my head down, people overlook me in a crowd."
"An azer is not the same as a dwarf! Boy, whatever pity I ever felt for you is shortly being used up. Why don't you go gnaw on a bone?"
"Where is this bone? Does it have flesh on it? Wait... you... you are tricking Trip! The bone I should gnaw on is your leg!"
"Sorry, <master/mistress>. Trip only tries to keep you safe."
"You'd better look to your own skin and leave the protection up to me."
"Maybe if he soaks his head in a bucket of water it puts out the flames. Then he could be like a normal dwarf."
"Elf twins... yummy!"
"Trip always wants to stay in the shadows, so this is an easy thing!"
"What?!? I'll soak your head in a bucket of water for about an hour and see how many fleas float to the surface!"
"See? Trip makes a perfectly innocent suggestion and the dwarf explodes like a fireball!"
"I AM NOT A DWARF! I'M A FLAMING AZER; LEARN THE DIFFERENCE!"
"Oh... sorry, <master/mistress>."
"Just stay out of my reach, ratman."
"That has yet to be proven. There a world of difference."
"Not much if you'd take a nice long bath."
"That little carrion-eater had better stay away from my legs. I don't need any filthy diseases!"
"Trip would chew on your head, but the meat would be too cooked for my tastes!"
"Just keep the filthy creature away from me."
"That is just silly. That is what Trip does best!"
"Sorry, master. Trip will try to do better for you."
"Unlocking locksies and chewing on rings, these are a few of Trip's favorite things!"
"Trip did not mean to smell bad, if this is what brings you to change my pace."
"Trip will do as kind <master/mistress> suggests."
"Trip is not meant for making such bold melee! I will do my best, but I make no promises!"
"Trip does not like to attack. Always better to run or hide."
"Trip is always happy to take advice from <master/mistress> on how to dress."
"Trip will sniff at it and gnaw at it and see if I can discover what it is!"
"I shall do my best to remain hidden. That is where Trip prefers to be, always."
"This part of the city makes Trip feel uncomfortable. Too clean. Too rich."
"Talk? What do you want Trip to talk about?"
"Is there anything else humble Trip can do for you, <master/mistress>?"
"Trip could not do that, no. After all, if Trip was not beholden to <master/mistress>, Trip would not be here in these gods-forsaken lands of the north."
"Trip owes <master/mistress> his life, and so I will follow you, even into such danger. Trip is pleased to serve you, <master/mistress>."
"I am not dead yet, so Trip figures that is a good sign. Always good not to be dead yet."
"You want anything else from Trip?"
"Trip would like to rest soon. Not that I am tired, but sleep is always good."
"Now why you have to go and interrupt Trip's daydream with such nonsense? I was chewing on a nice, ripe, bloated carcass... yummy, yummy."
"What? You're talking about the voices in Trip's head, aren't you? Well, there are no voices... so stop talking to me... all of you!"
"Trip has a headache, probably from too much sun. Maybe we should travel only at night and sleep all day."
"Graves and tombs; one of the very best places for a hungry rat to hide!"
"There is a thorn in Trip's paw, and it really hurts. Wait... ah... that's better!"
"Trip is fine. I am not hurt, or mangled, or chewed on, or digested, or anything!"
"Darkness! Darkness all around! The shadows have come for Trip and soon he will be dead!"
"Almost dying... <master/mistress>! Trip... needs... healer!"
"Close to dying... <master/mistress>! Trip... needs... healer!"
"Dying... <master/mistress>! Trip... needs... healer!"
"Trip thinks he might have eaten a bit of rotting meat. I do not feel so good."
"Trip feels sick. I know I am always diseased, but now I feel more so than before."
Trip blinks rapidly at your question. "Trip has high aspirations. I would like to make a big dungeon and fill it with monsters and traps and spells and treasures and make people pay to go into it."
"When you are the adventurer, the monsters try to kill you. When you are the monster, adventurers try to kill you. Trip is tired of being both."
"What dark, secrets might this hidden passage hold? Trip is curious."
"If Trip ran a famous adventure place that both monsters and adventurers wanted to be, nobody would want to be killing him!"
Trip shrugs, "Maybe Trip can find some crazy wizard to help me. Or profit sharing."
"Yes, Trip will offer monsters a split of loot from people they kill and Trip keeps the rest, plus the entrance fee."
"To attract the most attention, Trip thinks it would be best to have it underneath a large city. I will call it something simple and easy to remember... maybe, Undercity!"
"If you are an adventurer, you have to go and search around and find monsters to battle and sometimes those monsters have no treasure."
"If monsters and treasure were all in one challenging place, Trip thinks people would pay lots of gold to go there, in hopes of proving themselves and finding a big treasure trove."
"Trip always wants to know what good <master/mistress> thinks."
"Trip has no idea what you are talking about, <master/mistress>. I think you mean you would not like such a place, but that is alright. I think there are many out there who would like it."
"Trip cannot please everyone, but he hopes to please enough to make me lots of gold."
"We should get going again. Staying in one spot for very long makes Trip nervous."
"That merchant over there is selling dead rats! Trip should scare him and say I come in revenge for my kin!"
"Trip is pleased that you like his idea, and I think such a big undertaking would need more than just Trip's efforts."
"When that day comes, perhaps Trip and <FirstName> will work together in equality. Then Trip can stop calling you <master/mistress>."
"Trip has heard that before. Trip is not surprised that <master/mistress> would not like his idea much, but I think there are many out there who would like it."
"Which part: the fleas, the overwhelming desire to chew on dead things, the voices in my head, or the way everybody always stares at me? "
He shrugs. "Trip loves being a wererat." Scratching furriously, he turns away.
"Life was so lonely before the voices. Trip likes being a wererat, for the voices more than anything. Of course the voices didn't start until I met you."

"Not really. I suppose Trip had the fleas before I became a wererat. People often stared at me as a human, since I was so ugly. Chewing on dead things is new, though. And the voices started when I met you."
"Yes. Trip was enjoying his travels through the countryside, frightening the locals and eating their chi... I mean livestock."
"Then you and the flaming dwarf and cathead caught me. I don't know how well you remember it, but the image is burned into Trip's memory."
"Apparently you had been paid to find me, though I doubt it could have been much, coming from farmers."
"This tavern is too clean. There must be a proper dive in this city for Trip to drink at."
"And then you took Trip's treasure, which is why you allowed Trip to live, was it not?"
"You did find Trip with treasure. That was why Trip was allowed to live, was it not?"
"Yes, you have love for strange creatures, which causes some problems for Trip, though I was happy for it when you allowed me to live."
"Yes, you seem to enjoy these heroic moments more than Trip would like. But I was glad for your heroic nature when you let me live."

"And Trip is very useful, isn't he, <master/mistress>? You chose me over others in the group, and I am thankful. I shall continue to be useful to you. Trip shall find you more things and make you rich and powerful."
"Oh, <master/mistress>, Trip has changed his ways. Trip is the soul of kindness and love when it comes to doing your will. I will feed the hungry and clothe the poor, if that is your wish."
"And that is why Trip has such deep care for you, <master/mistress>! Trip has the same love for pretty things as you do, so we work well together."
"Oh, and kind <master/mistress>, Trip will grovel at your feet for as long as you wish. Trip is humbled by your mighty presence and simply wishes to bask in your noble glow."
"You should not be worried about Trip's loyalty. You are such a good <master/mistress>. Trip hardly feels the yoke and whip as you lead me into places too dangerous to imagine!"
"You... you call Trip a friend? You are such a good <master/mistress>. Trip hardly feels the yoke and whip as you lead me into places too dangerous to imagine!"
"Trip should make an offering at Veragok's shrine. Or maybe just a prayer. Cheaper that way."
He sniffles. "Trip thinks we should get going now. You have many important things for Trip to help you with. We should go do them now."
"And you are such a good <master/mistress>. Trip hardly feels the yoke and whip as you lead me into places too dangerous to imagine!"
"Like this place. Why, Trip would never have come here in a thousand years... would never even have dreamed of chasing after a beholder, and yet here I am."
"Watch what names you call me, Trip, or we shall play a game of cat and mouse."
"I wanted to kill you then just about as bad as I've ever wanted to kill anyone."
"What do you mean, I do not like it? Trip loves it! Life is much more interesting now, especially around you. Of course, the voices didn't start talking to me until I met you."
"You do not know what it is like to be ugly and shunned by people, <FirstName>. It might come as a shock to you, but Trip was not always the cute and lovable man you know now."
"Trip was once an ugly, selfish man. Small, pockmarked and hated by all, I became bitter and self-absorbed. I was a petty thief, with few friends to call my own."
