"I was cowardly then, and much more selfish than I am now. Truly, I was at the bottom of the cesspool called humanity."
"That is because you did not know the old, horrible Trip. I am much better than I once was. I was at the bottom of the cesspool called humanity."
"Not yet. I will come back for you."
Text: "아직이야. 다시 올게."

TextEng: "You aren't too bad a companion, Trip."
"So you don't like being a wererat?"
"Me?"
"Why don't you ever assume your human form?"
"I want to change your tactics."
Text: "네 전술을 바꾸고 싶어."

TextEng: "Now you are just a cowardly, ugly, selfish rat."
"I'm not seeing much of a change here."
"I am glad you have... improved."
"So you were worse than you are now?"
"How did you survive that meeting?"
"I don't want to change anything else right now."
Text: "지금은 다른 걸 바꾸고 싶지 않아."

TextEng: "Hurry up, this tale is starting to drag."
"What happened next?"
"You betrayed your master?"
"That's how you became a wererat?"
"I want you to leave any traps that you see alone."
Text: "보이는 함정은 그냥 놔둬."

TextEng: "What is the voice saying, Trip?"
"Betray who? Better not be me!"
"Trip, what's happening?"
"Trip, why are you getting so excited?"
"You had better stop yelling, Trip, before you draw more monsters to us."
"Trip, remember your dream! Remember the dungeon!"
<StartCheck>[Intimidate]</Start> "Back down, Trip! I don't want to have to hurt you!"
<StartCheck>[Bluff]</Start> "Would you like to be the master now, Trip?"
<StartCheck>[Persuade]</Start> "Fight the voice, Trip!"
"You coward! You stay with me or I'll end your life now!"
"Trip, I am your friend. Trust me, just one last time."
"Very well. I release you, Trip. Do as you must."
"I want you to disarm any traps that you see."
Text: "보이는 함정은 전부 해제해 줘."

TextEng: "I need your help. Just this one last mission, and then you can go where you want."
"No, stay here for the moment."
Text: "아니, 지금은 여기 있어."

TextEng: "Yes, come with me."
Text: "그래, 나와 함께 가자."

TextEng: "Not right now. I'm busy."
Text: "지금은 안 돼. 바빠."

TextEng: "Quit complaining, Trip."
"What do you want, Trip?"
"Trip, did you steal that from someone in the keep?"
"First tell me where you got that new belt."
"Here." <StartAction>[Help Trip loosen his *new* belt.]</Start>
"I want to move faster and not bother with searching or stealth."
Text: "더 빨리 이동하고 탐색이나 은밀 행동은 하지 마."

TextEng: "Where did you find the belt?"
"I will. So what is the belt?"
"I would like to see the belt, please."
"You have to return this, Trip."
"Now, Trip!"
"Where did you get those bracers?"
"Give them to me."
"I just want to figure out what they do. If you can use them, I'll give them back."
"I don't like your attitude, ratman! Give them to me, now!"
"Just give me the bracers."
"You stole them from her, you mean?"
"She gave them to you?"
"You could justify any action with that kind of logic."
"Fine, you can keep them."
"Give them back to her, now!"
"Those are bracers."
"I need you to be stealthy right now."
Text: "지금 은밀하게 행동해야 해."

TextEng: "I really don't care."
Text: "정말 상관없어."

TextEng: "How is it familiar?"
"Tell me what you know, then."
"Crystals. Got it. An easy trap."
"Do you think there might be crystals here?"
"Well, I think he could prove to be quite useful."
"I can't stand him."
"Yes. Please follow me."
Text: "그래. 따라와."

TextEng: "What do you mean? What amulets?"
"Is that all you managed to steal?"
"I'm surprised you didn't keep it for yourself."
"A magic amulet... very good."
"Oh, ick, that's why it's wet!"
"Trip, you shouldn't steal from people in the keep!"
"Ha, ha! I like having you around, Trip."
"Don't help me if I fail to open a locked door or chest."
Text: "내가 잠긴 문이나 상자를 여는 데 실패해도 돕지 마."

TextEng: "What are you doing, Trip?!?"
"Why would you be so careless with a magic rod?"
"Why didn't you show it to me right away?"
"Which voices told you to play with it?"
"Give me the rod... now!"
"You are going to give that to me right now, yes?"
"You could have killed somebody with that."
"You should always be careful with magic items."
"I should be able to get some gold for this."
"I have the rod, so shut up until you have something useful to say!"
"You can't eat a ring, if I buy it for you."
"Maybe I can buy a ring to make you shut up."
"Whatever."
"You are very strange."
"We'll see."
"I'm not buying you a ring!"
"Well, I'm glad you found it. It should be useful."
"I don't want to hear about this right now."
Text: "지금은 그 이야기 듣고 싶지 않아."

TextEng: "Help me if I fail to open a locked door or chest."
Text: "내가 잠긴 문이나 상자를 여는 데 실패하면 도와줘."

TextEng: "Do you have a point?"
"Yeah, he did seem rather easy."
"He was really tough! He nearly killed us!"
"I don't need this. You're just wasting my time."
"Whatever. Why was it so important for you to speak to me?"
"When did you ever fight a dragon?"
"Do you think your mind could hold to a single subject for a minute?"
"Right. I'll be careful with it."
"You were planning on keeping it and not telling me?"
"That might be fun to watch, but I'll take the ring."
"Good. Give me the ring."
"I want to change the distance you stay away from me."
Text: "나한테서 떨어져 있는 거리를 바꾸고 싶어."

TextEng: "You were talking about treasure?"
"We have a purpose here."
"I don't really care, Trip."
"Give that to me!"
"Isn't that mold growing on the skull?"
"I wouldn't really want the filthy thing."
"What are you talking about?"
"What is so special about it?"
"I really don't want to hear about it."
"If you absolutely must tell me."
"Stay a long distance away."
Text: "먼 거리를 유지해."

TextEng: "Go ahead."
"If you think it might be pertinent to what we are doing now."
"I would like to hear that."
"I really prefer my rat cooked with a pinch of salt."
"Ugh, I don't need those kind of details."
"Keep a medium distance."
Text: "중간 거리를 유지해."

TextEng: "When does the magic come into this gruesome tale?"
"You mean that rat skull you are always chewing on?"
"Yes, let's go."
Text: "그래, 가자."

TextEng: "Stay close."
Text: "가까이 있어."

TextEng: "No, just stay here for now."
Text: "아니, 지금은 여기 있어."

TextEng: "Go ahead and attack as soon as you see enemies."
Text: "적이 보이면 바로 공격해."

TextEng: "Defend me and don't attack until I do."
Text: "나를 방어하고, 내가 공격할 때까지 공격하지 마."

TextEng: "I'm not getting in the middle of this."
"You're a big boy, Calibast. Learn to deal with criticism."
"Trip, leave him alone."
"I want to adjust your equipment."
Text: "네 장비를 조정하고 싶어."

TextEng: "Leave him alone, Trip."
"What is Calibast supposed to do, Trip?"
"Don't taunt him, Trip."
"I think azers are related to dwarves though."
"Stop it, both of you!"
"Can you identify my equipment?"
Text: "내 장비를 감정해 줄 수 있어?"

TextEng: "Enough!"
"I need you to blend into the shadows."
"Never mind."
Text: "신경 쓰지 마."

TextEng: "What was it you wanted to say earlier?"
Text: "아까 하려던 말이 뭐였어?"

TextEng: "Let's stop and talk a moment."
Text: "잠깐 멈추고 이야기하자."

TextEng: "We're done talking."
Text: "이야기는 끝이야."

TextEng: "No, nothing else."
Text: "아니, 다른 건 없어."

TextEng: "I want you to stop calling me <master/mistress>."
"How is everything?"
Text: "다 잘 지내?"

TextEng: "I think we need to part ways."
Text: "이제 헤어져야 할 것 같아."

TextEng: "No, never mind."
Text: "아니, 신경 쓰지 마."

TextEng: "Do you have plans for what you're going to do after all this?"
Text: "이 모든 게 끝나면 뭘 할 계획이 있어?"

TextEng: "Why would you want to do that?"
"How would you get all the monsters in there?"
"Profit sharing?"
"What would you call your dungeon?"
"Why would people pay to go into such a place?"
"Do you want my opinion on your idea?"
"It wouldn't be much fun. Far too linear and combat-oriented."
"Wait here until I return."
Text: "내가 돌아올 때까지 여기서 기다려."

TextEng: "Good plan. If you need any help getting started, just ask."
"I'd love to help you with that. I think it would be quite successful."
"You're doomed to failure."
"What is it like being a wererat?"
"Suddenly I don't want to know..."
"Let's talk about the voices."
"Me?"
"Are you sure that's from being a wererat?"
"Me?"
"We got every gold piece the farmers had. It was barely enough."
"We were hoping to find you with a bunch of treasure."
"I need to go."
Text: "가야 해."

TextEng: "We were more interested in finding out about you."
"They spoke of your atrocities, so we thought it was worth doing."
"Your *treasure* was a horde of refuse. I just figured you might be useful."
"An enemy deserves mercy, if they change their ways, which you promised to do."
"You lived because you paid us off."
"I let you live because you groveled so pathetically."
"Sometimes I wonder about your loyalty, Trip."
"You are a good friend, Trip."
The Masked Man seems to sense your presence amidst all the chaos of battle. He turns to you, his eyes glinting like dark pools of liquid from behind his visor.
Text: 가면 쓴 자가 전투의 혼란 속에서 당신의 존재를 감지한 것 같습니다. 가면 뒤의 검은 웅덩이 같은 눈을 빛내며 당신에게 돌아섭니다.

TextEng: "Too late, <FirstName>, too late. The keep shall be mine and the destiny that comes with it. History will remember you as nothing but another corpse upon the battlefield."
Text: "너무 늦었다, <이름>, 너무 늦었어. 이 성채는 내 것이 될 것이고 그와 함께 운명도. 역사는 너를 그저 성벽 아래의 시체 중 하나로 기억할 것이다."

TextEng: "No, we not want to see! We not want to know!"
Text: "아냐, 우리 보기 싫어! 알고 싶지 않아!"

TextEng: "On the contrary. It is you who dies today..."
Text: "그 반대다. 오늘 죽는 것은 바로 너다..."

TextEng: Dark and ominous, the Masked Man's laughter echoes inside your mind.
Text: 어둡고 불길한 가면 쓴 자의 웃음이 당신의 마음속에 울려 퍼집니다.

TextEng: "Yes, you heard us correctly. Surrender or face your death!"
Text: "그래, 제대로 들은 거야. 항복하든가 죽음을 맞이하든가!"

TextEng: "Right now this keep is nothing! But under me it shall become the seat of a new empire. Destiny has called me here, <FirstName>, just as it called you to follow in my wake and now grovel here before me."
Text: "지금 이 성채는 아무것도 아니야! 하지만 나 아래서 새 제국의 중심이 될 것이다. 운명이 나를 여기로 불렀어, <이름>, 너를 부른 것처럼."

TextEng: "Do not burn it. Please... anything but flames."
Text: "불태우지 마. 제발... 불만은 안 돼."

TextEng: "I know all about you. I know about all of you. I know you better than you know yourselves. Every thought, every doubt, every fear. And I know that today is the day you are meant to die."
Text: "나는 너에 대해 다 알아. 너희 모두에 대해. 너희 자신보다 더 잘 알아. 모든 생각, 모든 의심, 모든 두려움. 그리고 알아..."

TextEng: "Enough of this talk and trickery! Drive a blade into his gullet and let's be done with it."
Text: "이 수다와 속임수는 그만! 칼날을 목구멍에 꽂고 끝내자."

TextEng: "And give you the dignity of seeing your better's face? Never! I am better than you, <FirstName>. Better than all your kind!"
Text: "네 상전의 얼굴을 볼 품위를 주겠다고? 절대로! 나는 너보다 뛰어나, <이름>. 너희 종족 모두보다!"

TextEng: "Enough talk. It's time I killed you."
Text: "수다는 그만. 이제 널 죽일 시간이다."

TextEng: "Lay down your arms and surrender immediately!"
Text: "무기를 내려놓고 즉시 항복해라!"

TextEng: "What's so important about this keep?"
Text: "이 성채가 뭐가 그리 중요하지?"

TextEng: "How do you know my name?"
Text: "내 이름을 어떻게 알지?"

TextEng: "Unmask yourself, coward."
Text: "가면을 벗어라, 겁쟁이."

TextEng: "What are you doing you fool! I brought you back for the one and *only* purpose of becoming lord of this keep."

"No, there is no excuse for this.  A simple thug like yourself could never become a lord. You've wasted my time, betrayed my hope, and broken my heart. There is nothing more I can do for you... I'm sorry, <FirstName>, but this has to end..."
"You see..."
"I was just..."
The bird is too busy hunting for food that might scurry or hop across the ground to really pay much attention to you.
Text: 새는 땅 위를 지나가는 먹이를 찾느라 바빠서 당신에게 별 관심을 두지 않습니다.

TextEng: "Oxen are such stupid beasts."
Text: "황소란 참 멍청한 짐승이야."

TextEng: "My feet were getting sore. I need to find a horse."
Text: "발이 아파 죽겠어. 말을 구해야겠어."

TextEng: "I'm glad we were able to avoid the army. I love working for the mistresses."
Text: "군대를 피할 수 있어서 다행이야. 아가씨들 밑에서 일하는 게 좋아."

TextEng: "The route up here has grown very dangerous in the last few years."
Text: "이쪽으로 올라오는 길이 최근 몇 년 사이에 아주 위험해졌어."

TextEng: "I just work here. I don't know nothing."
Text: "난 그냥 여기서 일하는 사람이야. 아무것도 몰라."

TextEng: "Talk to the ladies if you want to buy something."
Text: "뭘 사고 싶으면 아가씨들한테 말해."

TextEng: "Oh look, it is our friend, come back..."
Text: "어머, 보세요, 우리 친구가 다시..."

TextEng: "... to visit us. How can we help you..."
Text: "... 왔네요. 뭘 도와 드릴까요..."

TextEng: "We are always happy..."
Text: "저희는 항상 기꺼이..."

TextEng: "... to answer any questions a customer might have."
Text: "... 손님의 질문에 답해 드려요."

TextEng: "Would you like to purchase some..."
Text: "저희 물건을 좀..."

TextEng: "... of our goods, kind <sir/madam>?"
Text: "... 사시겠어요, 손님?"

TextEng: "I think we should be all right, as long as..."
Text: "저희는 괜찮을 거예요. 그 괴물들만..."

TextEng: "... those monsters don't come back. Thank you for..."
Text: "... 다시 오지 않으면요. 걱정해 주셔서..."

TextEng: "... asking, though."
Text: "... 감사해요."

TextEng: "Our goods are always welcome here..."
Text: "저희 물건은 여기서 항상 환영받아요..."

TextEng: "... since many people in the north think of the south as the only place to get real *civilized* goods. We have done a brisk trade..."
Text: "... 북쪽 사람들은 남쪽만이 진정한 *문명화된* 물건을 구할 수 있는 곳이라고 생각하거든요. 염료와 이국적인 재료로 장사가 잘 됐는데..."

TextEng: "... with our dyes and exotic materials. But I think now we will have to wait..."
Text: "... 하지만 이제는 침략자들이 막힐 때까지 기다려야..."

TextEng: "... today, kind <sir/madam>?"
Text: "... 오늘은, 손님?"

TextEng: "... until the invaders are stopped, before continuing on to the keep."
Text: "... 성채로 계속 갈 수 있을 것 같아요."

TextEng: They both giggle. "It's just something we started when we were..."
Text: 둘 다 킥킥 웃습니다. "그냥 어렸을 때부터 시작한 건데요..."

TextEng: "... just children. Our parents hated it, but after doing it for years..."
Text: "... 그때는 아이였으니까요. 부모님은 싫어하셨지만, 몇 년이나 하다 보니..."

TextEng: "... they got used to it and so did we."
Text: "... 부모님도 익숙해지셨고 저희도 그렇게 됐어요."

TextEng: "I am well versed in the magical arts, and we were able to make our entire caravan invisible when..."
Text: "저는 마법에 능통해서, 대상 전체를 투명하게 만들 수 있었어요..."

TextEng: "...I was scouting and saw the routed army fleeing the keep."
Text: "...제가 정찰하다가 패주하는 군대가 성채에서 도망치는 걸 봤거든요."

TextEng: "Oh, we have never heard that one before..."
Text: "어머, 그런 말은 처음 들어보네요..."

TextEng: "... you are a witty one."
Text: "... 재치 있으시네요."

TextEng: "We are not that powerful and without solid walls to retreat behind..."
Text: "저희는 그렇게 강하지 않고 뒤로 물러날 튼튼한 벽도 없으니까..."

TextEng: "... we would have been easy prey. Better to just be invisible."
Text: "... 쉬운 먹잇감이 됐을 거예요. 그냥 투명해지는 게 나아요."

TextEng: Two identical female elves stand here amidst a caravan that seems to have escaped the invading army's notice. One begins, "Good day to you..."
Text: 똑같이 생긴 엘프 여성 둘이 침략군의 눈을 피한 대상 가운데 서 있습니다. 한 명이 말을 꺼냅니다. "안녕하세요..."

TextEng: "Did you have other questions..."
Text: "다른 질문이..."

TextEng: "... for us, kind <sir/madam>?"
Text: "... 있으신가요, 손님?"

TextEng: "Yes, there would be little else these sweet elves could have done. Now which of you lasses was Alexis again?"
Text: "그래, 이 귀여운 엘프 아가씨들이 달리 뭘 할 수 있었겠어. 그런데 둘 중 알렉시스가 어느 쪽이더라?"

TextEng: "I'm Alexis, and you certainly are..."
Text: "제가 알렉시스예요, 정말..."

TextEng: "... the most handsome dwarf we've ever met. Besides, I am Alexis."
Text: "... 이렇게 잘생긴 드워프는 처음 봐요. 게다가 알렉시스는 저예요."

TextEng: "I don't suppose it matters. You both be fine looking lasses."
Text: "뭐 상관없지. 둘 다 예쁜 아가씨들이야."

TextEng: "Too bad we are both promised to be married..."
Text: "안타깝게도 저희 둘 다 약혼한 사이라서요..."

TextEng: "... to very wealthy elven lords, alas."
Text: "... 아주 부유한 엘프 영주들이랍니다, 유감이네요."

TextEng: "No, I just keep a number of scrolls around with globe of invisibilty spells on them..."
Text: "아뇨, 저는 투명화 구체 주문이 적힌 두루마리를 여러 개 갖고 다녀요..."

TextEng: "... for just such an occassion."
Text: "... 바로 이런 상황을 대비해서요."

TextEng: Then the other finishes, "stranger. Would you be interested in purchasing some of our goods? Most are in perfect condition..."
Text: 그러자 다른 한 명이 마무리합니다. "낯선 분이시군요. 저희 물건에 관심 있으신가요? 대부분 완벽한 상태인데..."

TextEng: "I am Alenor Kinthalis, merchant wizard, and this is my sister..."
Text: "저는 상인 마법사 알레노르 킨탈리스이고, 이쪽은 제 동생..."

TextEng: "Alexis Kinthalis, merchant and scout. We own this modest enterprise you see here."
Text: "알렉시스 킨탈리스, 상인 겸 정찰꾼이에요. 여기 보이는 이 소박한 사업체가 저희 거예요."

TextEng: "...though there might be some smoke damage. What do you say?"
Text: "...연기 냄새가 좀 밸 수도 있어요. 어떠세요?"

TextEng: "Be careful, good <sir/madam>. There are many dangerous creatures..."
Text: "조심하세요, 손님. 이 언덕 지대에는 위험한 생물이..."

TextEng: "... in this hilly land."
Text: "... 많거든요."

TextEng: "We have a variety of goods brought..."
Text: "남쪽의 문명화된 도시에서 가져온..."

TextEng: "...all the way from the civilized southern cities. Have a look."
Text: "...다양한 물건이 있어요. 한번 보세요."

TextEng: "I have some questions for you."
Text: "질문이 좀 있어요."

TextEng: "That's all my questions."
Text: "질문은 다 했어요."

TextEng: "Do you need any help?"
Text: "도움이 필요하신가요?"

TextEng: "What brought you this far north?"
Text: "이렇게 먼 북쪽까지 뭐 때문에 왔나요?"

TextEng: "Why do you finish each other's sentences?"
Text: "왜 서로 말을 이어서 끝내시죠?"

TextEng: "How did you avoid the monsters that attacked the keep?"
Text: "성채를 공격한 괴물들을 어떻게 피했어요?"

TextEng: "I guess two heads are better than one."
Text: "머리 둘이 하나보다 낫다더니."

TextEng: "So why didn't you help, instead of just hiding?"
Text: "그럼 숨기만 하지 않고 왜 도와주지 않았어요?"

TextEng: "That's a powerful spell."
Text: "그건 강력한 주문이네요."

TextEng: "Goodbye."
Text: "안녕히."

TextEng: "Back to my other questions."
Text: "다른 질문으로 돌아갈게요."

TextEng: "Who are you?"
Text: "누구세요?"

TextEng: "What do you have for sale?"
Text: "무엇을 파나요?"

TextEng: The chicken eyes you cautiously, then resumes pecking the ground.
Text: 닭이 조심스럽게 당신을 살피더니 다시 땅을 쪼기 시작합니다.

TextEng: The chicken looks you up and down, searching for signs of a bushy tail or pointed, hairy ears. It then begins to ask you a series of tricky questions about your culinary habits.
Text: 닭이 당신을 위아래로 훑어보며 덥수룩한 꼬리나 뾰족한 털 귀가 있는지 살핍니다. 그러더니 당신의 식습관에 대해 까다로운 질문을 퍼붓기 시작합니다.

TextEng: It tells you to eat lots of grass seeds and get plenty of rest.
Text: 풀씨를 많이 먹고 푹 쉬라고 충고합니다.

TextEng: The chicken impatiently pecks at your toes, as is it pretty sure you are standing on a seed it was eyeing. As you move back a step it keeps telling you to back up more.
Text: 닭이 조급하게 당신의 발가락을 쪼며, 당신이 노리고 있던 씨앗 위에 서 있다고 확신합니다. 한 걸음 물러서자 더 뒤로 가라고 계속 재촉합니다.

TextEng: It is entirely possible that the chicken was lying about the seed and merely wants you to go away.
Text: 씨앗 이야기는 거짓말이었고, 그저 당신이 가 버리기를 바라는 것일 가능성이 높습니다.

TextEng: Finally it decides that you probably aren't a fox and it goes back to pecking at the ground. Seconds later it seems to have forgotten who you are and resumes looking for a bushy tail.
Text: 마침내 당신이 여우는 아닐 거라고 판단하고 다시 땅을 쪼기 시작합니다. 몇 초 후 당신이 누군지 잊어버리고 다시 덥수룩한 꼬리를 찾기 시작합니다.

TextEng: The chicken quietly informs you that it believes one of the other chickens is actually a spy for a criminal egg-theft ring.
Text: 닭이 조용히 알려주기를, 다른 닭 중 하나가 사실은 알 도둑 조직의 첩자라고 합니다.

TextEng: Before it resumes eating, it warns you to be careful around the chicken with the wandering eye.
Text: 다시 먹이를 쪼기 전에, 눈이 빙글빙글 도는 닭을 조심하라고 경고합니다.

TextEng: The chicken chokes on a grass seed as you speak to it. It then glares at you, angry at the interruption to its meal and lets out a churlish squawk.
Text: 당신이 말을 걸자 닭이 풀씨에 걸려 사레들립니다. 그러더니 식사를 방해한 당신을 노려보며 심술궂게 꼬꼬댁 소리를 지릅니다.

TextEng: Raising its beak in the air, it turns and struts arrogantly away, feeling it has made its point.
Text: 부리를 치켜세우고 뒤돌아서 거드름을 피우며 걸어갑니다. 자기 주장이 통했다고 생각하는 모양입니다.

TextEng: The chicken sits down and begins to describe in detail how it believes that the world was made by a giant chicken, and one day the world will end in what it calls, "The Great Hatching".
Text: 닭이 앉더니 세상이 거대한 닭에 의해 만들어졌으며, 언젠가 "위대한 부화"라 불리는 것으로 세상이 끝날 것이라는 이야기를 장황하게 늘어놓기 시작합니다.

TextEng: When that day comes the giant chicken god will be reborn and lay a new egg and the cycle will begin again.
Text: 그날이 오면 거대한 닭 신이 다시 태어나 새 알을 낳고, 순환이 다시 시작될 것이라고 합니다.

TextEng: The chicken is quickly confused and seems to decide you are just another chicken. It feels much pity for you, as you seem to have molted and lost all your feathers.
Text: 닭은 금세 혼란에 빠져 당신을 그냥 다른 닭이라고 판단합니다. 깃털이 다 빠진 것 같다며 당신을 몹시 불쌍해합니다.

TextEng: "Hello, chicken."
Text: "안녕, 닭아."

TextEng: Your warrior friend, the flaming azer Calibast, turns to you. He breathes heavily from all of the running and fighting in the last few hours. He eyes the rest of the group, trying to gauge their condition.
Text: 전사 동료인 불꽃의 아저 캘리바스트가 당신에게 돌아섭니다. 지난 몇 시간 동안의 달리기와 전투로 거친 숨을 몰아쉽니다. 당신을 바라보며 침착하게 입을 엽니다.

TextEng: Trip, your wererat companion, sniffs the air and licks the blood from a superficial cut on his arm. He does not seem as winded as the others, but his craven ways have kept him from most of the fighting.
Text: 웨어랫 동료 트립이 공기의 냄새를 맡으며 팔의 가벼운 상처에서 피를 핥습니다. 다른 이들만큼 숨이 차 보이지는 않지만, 머리 속의 목소리들이 점점 거슬리는 듯합니다.

TextEng: "Trip's gained us some time through the woods but not enough. They'll set fire to the keep."
Text: "트립이 숲을 통해 시간을 벌어 줬지만 충분하지 않았어. 놈들이 성채에 불을 지를 거야."

TextEng: "Stupid! Trip said we could not fight the big masked man. Not strong enough are we, so now we shall die! We run, we hide and maybe we live!"
Text: "바보들! 트립이 큰 가면 쓴 남자와 싸울 수 없다고 했잖아. 우리는 충분히 강하지 않으니, 이제 죽을 거야! 도망치고, 숨어야 살 수 있어!"

TextEng: "I'll not flee from this or any other foe! We are not cowards; we march for the keep's gates and make our stand against them there. What do you say <FirstName>?"
Text: "이 적이든 다른 적이든 도망치지 않겠다! 우리는 겁쟁이가 아니다. 성채 문으로 진군해서 거기서 맞서 싸우자. 어떻게 생각하나, <이름>?"

TextEng: "If this is our destiny, I would hate to have it said that we did not face it bravely. I will face the storm and weather it or die."
Text: "이것이 우리의 운명이라면, 용감하게 맞서지 않았다는 말은 듣기 싫다. 폭풍에 맞서 이겨내겠다. 아니면 죽겠다."

TextEng: "Then the majority says we stand and fight. That has always been enough for us."
Text: "그렇다면 다수결로 싸운다. 그것이 항상 우리의 방식이었다."

TextEng: "I... I am sorry... I cannot agree with you, <FirstName>. I say we stand and face our fate."
Text: "나는... 미안하지만... 당신에게 동의할 수 없어, <이름>. 나는 맞서 싸우겠다."

TextEng: "Three say stand, two say flee. It is good that we are not all cowards. The vote is cast and the majority says we stand and fight. That has always been enough for us."
Text: "셋은 싸우자, 둘은 도망치자. 우리 모두가 겁쟁이는 아니니 다행이다. 다수결로 싸운다. 그것이 항상 우리의 방식이었다."

TextEng: "I too will face our foes. Perhaps today we will finally rest."
Text: "나도 적과 맞서겠다. 어쩌면 오늘 드디어 쉴 수 있겠지."

TextEng: "You all willing to die? My voices, they tell me to run. Trip wishes to leave here. Why do we not all leave?"
Text: "다들 죽을 각오야? 내 목소리들은 도망치라고 하는데. 트립은 떠나고 싶어. 왜 다 같이 떠나지 않는 거야?"

TextEng: "Bollocks! Shut your cowardly mouth, Trip! We march from this place and face our foes. We must slay the Masked Man at any cost."
Text: "엉터리 소리! 비겁한 입 닫아, 트립! 여기서 나아가 적과 맞서자. 무슨 수를 써서라도 가면 쓴 자를 죽여야 해."

TextEng: Jaboli, a rakshasa wizard, mumbles to herself, obviously trying to recall some of the spells she has already used. It is doubtful she has many more left.
Text: 락샤사 마법사 자볼리가 혼잣말로 중얼거리며, 이미 사용한 주문 몇 가지를 떠올리려 애씁니다. 남은 주문이 많지 않을 것 같습니다.

TextEng: "Oh yes, that is a splendid idea! Trip will run far and wide, warning everyone of impending doom!"
Text: "오, 그래, 좋은 생각이야! 트립이 멀리 뛰어다니며 다가오는 재앙을 모두에게 알릴게!"

TextEng: "It would take weeks for forces to be mustered. By that time, the keep will have fallen and the Masked One will have moved on, leaving nothing but a smoking ruin. If we're to stop him, it must be now."
Text: "군대를 모으려면 몇 주가 걸릴 거야. 그때쯤이면 성채는 함락되고 가면 쓴 자는 떠난 뒤일 텐데, 남는 건 재와 폐허뿐이지."

TextEng: "No! Trip does not wish to die. Will no one flee with him?"
Text: "싫어! 트립은 죽기 싫어. 아무도 트립이랑 도망치지 않을 거야?"

TextEng: "We face them together and with honor!"
Text: "함께 명예롭게 맞서자!"

TextEng: "We welcome you, Mistress Death!"
Text: "죽음의 여신이여, 어서 오소서!"

TextEng: "Hundreds! Trip smells them, yes! Kobolds, orcs, goblins, and ogres. Too many for us I tell you!"
Text: "수백 마리야! 트립이 냄새 맡았어, 맞아! 코볼트, 오크, 고블린, 오우거. 우리한테는 너무 많다니까!"

TextEng: "He usually exaggerates, but I fear Trip is right this time. What do you wish to do?"
Text: "트립은 항상 과장하지만, 이번에는 맞는 것 같다. 어떻게 하겠나?"

TextEng: Kaidala's chest heaves as she tries to catch her breath. Her hand absently rubs against the horrible scarring on her face, which she has carried since before you ever met her.
Text: 카이달라가 숨을 고르려 가슴이 들썩입니다. 그녀가 어린 시절부터 지니고 있는 얼굴의 끔찍한 흉터를 무심코 문지릅니다.

TextEng: "The enemy lies just ahead. We have to intervene before they seize the keep."
Text: "적이 바로 앞에 있다. 그들이 성채를 점령하기 전에 개입해야 해."

TextEng: "No, no! We flee! Let them have the keep! We're too late."
Text: "안 돼, 안 돼! 도망쳐야 해! 성채는 그들에게 내줘! 우리는 이미 늦었어."

TextEng: "You've led us this far, Trip, only to turn tail on us now?"
Text: "여기까지 우리를 이끌어 놓고 이제 와서 꼬리를 빼려고, 트립?"

TextEng: "It's the woods! They twist and turn, Jaboli! Trip hoped we get through in time but it's too late. Come, Trip will lead us back to safety."
Text: "숲 때문이야! 구불구불 돌아가잖아, 자볼리! 트립은 제시간에 도착하길 바랐지만 너무 늦었어. 자, 트립이 안전한 곳으로 데려다줄게."

TextEng: "No one's going back, Trip, especially not you. We're late but we're not too late. Now, did anyone spy a glimpse of their leader?"
Text: "아무도 돌아가지 않아, 트립, 특히 넌. 늦긴 했지만 너무 늦지는 않았어. 그래, 누가 그들의 지도자를 봤나?"

TextEng: "No. They've led us on a merry chase north, but always stayed a step ahead."
Text: "아뇨. 북쪽으로 우리를 실컷 쫓아다니게 했지만, 항상 한 발 앞서 있었어요."

TextEng: "You haven't said much, Kaidala. What do you think?"
Text: "카이달라, 넌 별 말이 없었는데. 어떻게 생각하지?"

TextEng: "Perhaps we should run."
Text: "도망치는 게 나을지도 모르겠다."

TextEng: "We stay and fight."
Text: "남아서 싸우자."

TextEng: "Trip, you are such a cowardly fool. I ought to end your miserable life right now!"
Text: "트립, 넌 정말 비겁한 바보야. 지금 당장 네 비참한 목숨을 끝내 주겠어!"

TextEng: "Perhaps Trip should run and gather reinforcements?"
Text: "트립이 달려가서 지원군을 불러오는 건 어때?"

TextEng: "Yes, Trip, be brave!"
Text: "그래, 트립, 용기를 내!"

TextEng: "Do you have a plan?"
Text: "계획이 있나?"

TextEng: "How many do we face, best guess?"
Text: "적이 몇이나 되지?"

TextEng: "Are we just stopping then?"
Text: "그냥 멈추는 건가?"

TextEng: "What do you think, everyone?"
Text: "모두 어떻게 생각해?"

TextEng: "So you've come back to your dear friend, Calibast. Just say the word, bring me back, and we'll be off on our merry way." Calibast tosses you a cavalier wink.
Text: "친한 친구 캘리바스트에게 다시 왔군. 한마디만 해. 날 되살려 주면 바로 떠나자." 캘리바스트가 태평하게 미소를 보내 온다.

TextEng: You see the ghostly visage of your warrior companion, Calibast, rise above his shattered corpse. The azer stares off into eternity, listening to an inaudible voice, then looks straight into your eyes and grimaces.
Text: 전사 동료 캘리바스트의 유령 같은 모습이 산산이 부서진 시체 위로 떠오릅니다. 아저가 영원 속을 응시하며, 들리지 않는 목소리에 귀를 기울입니다.

TextEng: "Fear not, my friend, you shall have no regrets!"
Text: "걱정 마, 친구, 후회 없을 거야!"

TextEng: "I would be proud to do so! You shall not regret your choice!"
Text: "기꺼이! 네 선택을 후회하지 않을 거야!"

TextEng: "Well, of course you do, <lad/lass>. Always important to know all the facts, I always say."
Text: "물론이지. 항상 사실을 다 아는 게 중요하다고 말하잖아."

TextEng: "So, fine friend, how are we to proceed?" He wags his fiery eyebrows at you and flashes you his finest, carefree grin.
Text: "그래, 좋은 친구여, 어떻게 할 거지?" 불꽃 눈썹을 흔들며 가장 태평한 미소를 짓는다.

TextEng: "Not that I don't feel sorry for the poor lad, but you hardly need Trip's assistance. I can smash my way through most locked doors or containers. And he is such a coward, he's not much good in a fight."
Text: "불쌍하긴 하지만 트립의 도움은 별로 필요 없어. 잠긴 문이나 상자는 내가 부숴 버릴 수 있거든. 게다가 그 녀석은 겁쟁이라 전투에서 쓸모가 없지."

TextEng: "Not that I don't feel sorry for the poor lad, but with your thief abilities, you hardly need Trip's assistance. And he is such a coward, he's not much good in a fight."
Text: "불쌍하긴 하지만 네 도둑 능력이면 트립의 도움은 별로 필요 없어. 게다가 그 녀석은 겁쟁이라 전투에서 쓸모가 없지."

TextEng: "Of the ladies, Jaboli is rough and easy to get along with. Kaidala is shy, but fearless in a fight. I suspect she still courts death."
Text: "여자들 중에서, 자볼리는 거칠지만 함께하기 편해. 카이달라는 수줍지만 전투에서는 두려움이 없어. 아직도 죽음을 갈망하는 것 같아서 걱정이지."

TextEng: "I owe you nothing less. You can trust me to always tell you the truth."
Text: "당연히 그래야지. 항상 진실만 말할 거라고 믿어도 돼."

TextEng: "I fear you must have lost some memories when you were brought back. Let us hope you have not lost too much else! When we met Kaidala she begged us to kill her."
Text: "되살아나면서 기억을 좀 잃은 것 같군. 너무 많이 잃지 않았길! 카이달라를 처음 만났을 때 그녀는 우리에게 빨리 죽여 달라고 애원했지."

TextEng: "Her face was a burning scar, like the forest that had been her home. When she saw us coming towards her, she collapsed in tears, begging for a quick, painless end."
Text: "그녀의 얼굴은 그녀의 고향이었던 숲처럼 타버린 흉터투성이였어. 우리가 다가가자 눈물을 흘리며 쓰러져서, 빠르고 자비로운 죽음을 구걸했지."

TextEng: "Ach! They finally got me, <FirstName>. Glad I am to have toasted to Mistress Death last night, since I see that you live. I have some inkling of the choice you face, your 'friend' having explained it to me."
Text: "으악! 결국 당했구나, <이름>. 어젯밤에 죽음의 여신에게 건배한 게 다행이야, 네가 살아 있으니. 이 이상한 목소리가 뭔지 짐작은 가지만, 네 선택에 맡기겠어."

TextEng: "Instead we brought her into our little group of outcasts and helped her rebuild her life, weak as a nymph, but strong in the forces of nature. She made a powerful druid."
Text: "대신 우리는 그녀를 우리 작은 아웃캐스트 무리에 받아들여 삶을 다시 세우도록 도왔어. 님프로서는 약하지만 자연의 힘에는 강하지. 그녀가 많은 도움이 되었어."

TextEng: "The power of my attacks is formidable, whether it be against a foe or a locked door, an advantage no one should do without."
Text: "내 공격력은 대단해. 적이든 잠긴 문이든 말이야. 없으면 아쉬울 걸."

TextEng: "Besides my winning personality, I am also resistant to fire and these charming flames are good for something more than just making me pretty, if you know what I mean."
Text: "매력적인 성격 외에도, 나는 불에 저항력이 있고 이 멋진 불꽃은 나를 잘생기게 만드는 것 말고도 쓸모가 있다고."

TextEng: "I am an azer, a dwarf from the plane of fire. I may be surrounded by flames, but I can control them when I want to touch something without burning it."
Text: "나는 아저야, 불의 차원에서 온 드워프지. 불꽃에 둘러싸여 있지만 원하면 뭔가를 태우지 않고 만질 수도 있어."

TextEng: "Of course, it means I am largely immune to fire based attacks - which can be quite handy. Did you have other questions?"
Text: "물론 그건 불 기반 공격에 거의 면역이라는 뜻이야 - 꽤 편리하지. 다른 질문 있나?"

TextEng: "Bless my soul and drink to oblivion! We have been together longer than any of the others, <FirstName>! Think of all the fun we have shared."
Text: "내 영혼을 축복하고 망각에 건배를! 다른 누구보다 오래 함께했잖아, <이름>! 우리가 나눈 즐거운 시간들을 생각해 봐."

TextEng: "We must take life by the hand and let her lead us down the path of her pleasures! Say you'll not forget the joy of our journeys."
Text: "인생의 손을 잡고 그녀의 즐거움의 길을 따라가야 해! 우리 여정의 기쁨을 잊지 않겠다고 약속해."

TextEng: "We must grab life by her hips and taste the blessed union of all her pleasures! Say you'll not forget the joy of our journeys."
Text: "인생의 허리를 잡고 모든 즐거움의 축복된 합일을 맛봐야 해! 우리 여정의 기쁨을 잊지 않겠다고 약속해."

TextEng: Calibast's face darkens in anger. "That is cruel of you to say, though I should have expected it. I always thought better of you than you deserved."
Text: 캘리바스트의 얼굴이 분노로 어두워집니다. "그건 잔인한 말이군, 예상했어야 했지만. 항상 네가 받을 만한 것보다 더 좋게 생각했는데."

TextEng: "Ha! That is what I love about you, <FirstName>, you're always one step ahead in the fun. Couple that with my prowess in battle and how can you go wrong?"
Text: "하하! 그게 네가 좋은 거야, <이름>, 항상 재미에서 한 발 앞서가지. 거기에 전투에서의 내 무용을 더하면 어떻게 실패할 수 있겠어?"

TextEng: "I am sure you would not want to lose my brawn and my cheerful disposition, now would you?"
Text: "내 든든한 팔과 유쾌한 성격을 잃고 싶지는 않겠지?"

TextEng: "Indeed we have, <lad/lass>. Couple that with my prowess in battle and how can you go wrong?"
Text: "그렇고말고. 거기에 전투에서의 내 무용을 더하면 어떻게 실패할 수 있겠어?"

TextEng: Calibast's spirit slumps a little. "Ach, I should have tried a different tack with you, my stoic friend. Such is my fierce love of life that I hoped to draw you into it."
Text: 캘리바스트의 영혼이 조금 풀이 죽습니다. "으, 다른 방법으로 접근했어야 했는데, 과묵한 친구여. 삶에 대한 내 뜨거운 사랑이 너에게도 전해지길 바랐건만."

TextEng: "If all the fun and flirtation are not enough to hold us together, then think of the strength of my arms and my ferocity in battle. We have seen much, my friend; let us see more together."
Text: "재미와 유혹이 우리를 묶기에 부족하다면, 내 팔의 힘과 전투의 맹렬함을 생각해 줘. 많은 것을 함께 겪었잖아, 친구여."

TextEng: "If the wine, women and song don't bond us together, then think of the strength of my arms and my ferocity in battle. We have been through much, my friend; let us do more together."
Text: "술과 여자와 노래가 우리를 묶기에 부족하다면, 내 팔의 힘과 전투의 맹렬함을 생각해 줘. 많은 것을 함께 겪었잖아, 친구여."

TextEng: If a spirit could possibly become paler, Calibast suddenly does. "I understand, <FirstName>, but remember all of the good times we had, when it comes time to choose."
Text: 영혼이 더 창백해질 수 있다면, 캘리바스트가 갑자기 그렇게 됩니다. "이해하네, <이름>, 하지만 우리의 좋은 시절을 기억해 줘, 판단할 때."

TextEng: "I should like to think that being friends for so long should mean something. Well, go speak to the others."
Text: "오랜 친구라는 게 뭔가 의미가 있어야 한다고 생각했는데. 그래, 다른 사람들에게 가서 이야기해 봐."

TextEng: "Good to hear it, <lad/lass>. What would your choice be then?"
Text: "좋은 소식이군. 선택은 뭐지?"

TextEng: "I suppose you have a right to take your time choosing. Is there anything else old Calibast can do for you?"
Text: "시간을 들일 권리는 있지. 다른 것 도와줄 게 있나?"

TextEng: Calibast's soul lets out a deafening screech as it is drawn away from its body and off into eternity.
Text: 캘리바스트의 영혼이 귀를 찢는 비명을 지르며 몸에서 떨어져 영원 속으로 끌려갑니다.

TextEng: He nods, showing that he understands, and then fades away into oblivion. You hear a whisper as he goes. "Drink a toast to my soul, in remembrance." Then he is gone.
Text: 그가 고개를 끄덕여 이해했음을 보이더니 망각 속으로 사라집니다. 사라지며 속삭임이 들립니다. "내 영혼을 위해 한잔 들어 줘, 기억으로."

TextEng: "Against my better judgment, I think I will need your skills."
Text: "판단에는 어긋나지만, 네 능력이 필요할 것 같아."

TextEng: "I would like you to return and assist me."
Text: "돌아와서 나를 도와줬으면 해."

TextEng: "I have a few questions for you first."
Text: "먼저 몇 가지 물어볼 게 있어."

TextEng: "That is all my questions."
Text: "질문은 다 했어."

TextEng: "Tell me what you think about the others?"
Text: "다른 동료들에 대해 어떻게 생각해?"

TextEng: "I have other questions."
Text: "다른 질문이 있어."

TextEng: "Thanks for your candor."
Text: "솔직하게 말해 줘서 고마워."

TextEng: "What do you mean she still courts death?"
Text: "카이달라가 아직도 죽음을 갈망한다니 무슨 뜻이야?"

TextEng: "I need to speak to the others before I decide."
Text: "결정하기 전에 다른 사람들과 이야기해야겠어."

TextEng: "What skills can you offer me, exactly?"
Text: "정확히 어떤 능력을 제공할 수 있지?"

TextEng: "Why are you on fire?"
Text: "왜 불이 붙어 있는 거야?"

TextEng: "Tell me why I should choose you."
Text: "왜 널 선택해야 하는지 말해 봐."

TextEng: "I might enjoy watching your smug charm wither in death more."
Text: "네 건방진 매력이 죽음 속에서 시들어 가는 걸 보는 게 더 재미있을 수도 있어."

TextEng: "Promise me the next three... conquests, and I'll think about it."
Text: "앞으로 세 번의... 정복을 약속하면 생각해 볼게."

TextEng: "We have had some good times together, Calibast."
Text: "우리 함께 좋은 시간을 보내긴 했지, 캘리바스트."

TextEng: "You are a lush and a letch, Calibast. Don't lump me into your failings."
Text: "넌 술주정뱅이에 바람둥이야, 캘리바스트. 네 결점에 나를 끌어들이지 마."

TextEng: "I have made a choice."
Text: "선택했어."

TextEng: "I've changed my mind; I'm not ready to choose."
Text: "마음이 바뀌었어. 아직 선택할 준비가 안 됐어."

TextEng: "Enjoy your time in the underworld; you'll not be leaving it soon!"
Text: "저승에서 즐거운 시간 보내. 금방 나오지는 못할 거야!"

TextEng: "I cannot choose you, old friend."
Text: "널 선택할 수 없어, 오랜 친구."

TextEng: "Are we ready then?" Jaboli's spirit purrs quietly, waiting patiently to find out her ultimate fate.
Text: "준비가 됐나?" 자볼리의 영혼이 조용히 가르랑거리며, 자신의 최종 운명을 참을성 있게 기다린다.

TextEng: Jaboli's spirit rises up, trembling with either fear or rage. She appears to listen to an inaudible voice, and then looks at you carefully.
Text: 자볼리의 영혼이 두려움이든 분노든 떨리며 떠오릅니다. 들리지 않는 목소리에 귀 기울이다 당신을 주의 깊게 바라봅니다.

TextEng: "You have made a good choice; one I will give you no reason to regret."
Text: "좋은 선택이야. 후회할 이유를 주지 않겠어."

TextEng: "We know much about each other, yet we have often kept secrets too. I will answer as best as I can."
Text: "우리는 서로에 대해 많이 알지만 비밀도 간직해 왔지. 최선을 다해 답하겠어."

TextEng: "Then perhaps you are ready to choose, unless you wish to seek answers from the others first? Either way, I am not going anywhere until you are ready."
Text: "그럼 선택할 준비가 됐겠네. 다른 사람들에게 먼저 물어보고 싶지 않다면? 어느 쪽이든 네가 준비될 때까지 기다리겠어."

TextEng: "While I feel for the difficulties she has faced, I do not care for Kaidala overmuch. She is too insecure, which goes against my own confident nature."
Text: "그녀가 겪은 어려움은 안됐지만, 카이달라를 그다지 좋아하지는 않아. 너무 불안해하는데, 내 자신감 넘치는 성격과 맞지 않거든."

TextEng: "Calibast is strong, and a good companion, so I would recommend him on those counts. Trip is rather pathetic in a fight, but he is an excellent thief."
Text: "캘리바스트는 강하고 좋은 동료야, 그 점에서는 추천하겠어. 트립은 전투에서는 한심하지만 뛰어난 도둑이야."

TextEng: "You know your strengths and weaknesses better than I, and the decision is yours. If you desperately need a healer, then you might need the insecure nymph. I just hope you will choose me."
Text: "네 장단점은 네가 가장 잘 알고, 결정은 네 몫이야. 치유사가 절실히 필요하다면 그 불안한 님프가 필요할 수도 있어."

TextEng: "I can only ever offer an opinion, but I will always tell you the truth. I will not hide behind a false mask just to say pleasing things."
Text: "의견만 줄 수 있을 뿐이지만, 항상 진실을 말하겠어. 듣기 좋은 말을 하려고 거짓 가면 뒤에 숨지 않을 거야."

TextEng: "The damage to her physical body was bad enough, but her spirit was far worse off. She will do as you ask, but she will accept death better than any."
Text: "육체의 손상도 심했지만, 정신은 훨씬 더 심했어. 시키는 대로 하겠지만, 누구보다 죽음을 쉽게 받아들일 거야."

TextEng: "The rest of us will fight to hold on to life, but I worry that Kaidala will suddenly give in one day and let herself die when she is really needed."
Text: "나머지는 살기 위해 싸우겠지만, 카이달라가 어느 날 갑자기 포기하고 정말 필요할 때 죽게 놔둘까 봐 걱정돼."

TextEng: "Trip is weak and cowardly, but I think he could be trained to be useful. When he strikes from the shadows, he can be quite formidable."
Text: "트립은 약하고 겁쟁이지만, 훈련하면 쓸모가 있을 수 있어. 그림자에서 공격할 때는 꽤 무시무시하거든."

TextEng: "This is not a test I envy you, my friend. Still, I would rather be alive than dead. I assume that the voice speaking to me also spoke to you. So what shall you do?"
Text: "이건 부럽지 않은 시험이야, 친구. 그래도 죽는 것보단 사는 게 낫지. 나에게 말하는 목소리가 너에게도 말했겠지. 그래서 어떻게 할 거야?"

TextEng: "Magic, intelligence, a knowledge of tactics, and an ability to discern the motivations and lies of others. If I am in your party, I will try to be sure that no one deceives you."
Text: "마법, 지성, 전술 지식, 그리고 타인의 동기와 거짓말을 꿰뚫는 능력. 내가 일행에 있으면 보좌관이 되어 줄게."

TextEng: "All of these abilities wrapped up in a perfectly magnificent package... how could you resist?"
Text: "이 모든 능력이 완벽하고 멋진 포장에 담겨 있으니... 어떻게 거부할 수 있겠어?"

TextEng: "The power of the rakshasa is well known, though I am far limited in comparison to how I was before banishment. My people stripped me of my sorcererous powers, forcing me to learn something new."
Text: "락샤사의 힘은 널리 알려져 있지만, 추방당하기 전에 비하면 크게 약해졌어. 내 종족이 선천적 마법 능력을 빼앗았거든."

TextEng: "I am now a wizard, and I find my new calling to be more to my liking. I also still retain some of my natural spell resistance, despite the weakness of my exile."
Text: "이제 나는 마법사이고, 새 소명이 더 마음에 들어. 약해진 상태지만 선천적 주문 저항력도 어느 정도 남아 있어."

TextEng: Jaboli nods slowly. "I am good at analyzing people and what they say, so that I can determine what motivates them, and often I can tell if they are lying. This could be useful to you."
Text: 자볼리가 천천히 고개를 끄덕입니다. "사람을 분석하고 그들의 말에서 동기를 파악하는 데 능해. 거짓말인지도 종종 알아낼 수 있지. 유용할 거야."

TextEng: "I was always smarter than most of my peers. I find the intellectual challenge of wizardry to be more in line with my own nature. So, yes, I am good at it."
Text: "동료들보다 항상 똑똑했어. 마법학의 지적 도전이 내 본성에 더 맞아. 그래서 마법에 능하냐고? 그래."

TextEng: "I am also good at analyzing people and what they say, so that I can determine what motivates them, and often I can tell if they are lying. This could be useful to you."
Text: "사람을 분석하고 그들의 말에서 동기를 파악하는 데도 능해. 거짓말인지도 종종 알아낼 수 있지. 유용할 거야."

TextEng: "I have a different view on life than my people do. I would rather not discuss the details of my exile right now. I have other qualities though."
Text: "내 종족과는 다른 인생관을 가지고 있어. 추방의 자세한 내용은 지금 이야기하고 싶지 않아. 하지만 다른 자질이 있지."

TextEng: "I am good at analyzing people and what they say. I can determine what motivates them, and often I can tell if they are lying. This could be useful to you."
Text: "사람을 분석하고 그들의 말에서 동기를 파악하는 데 능해. 거짓말인지도 종종 알아낼 수 있어. 유용할 거야."

TextEng: "Not at all. It is just that such a statement would be very egotistical and very typical for one of my species. As you already know, I have a rather different view on life then the rest of my species."
Text: "전혀. 그런 말은 매우 이기적이고 전형적인 락샤사 스러울 뿐이거든. 이미 알다시피 나는 상당히 다른 관점을 가지고 있어."

TextEng: "Will you choose the path of wisdom and discernment and choose me for an ally? Oh, what a typically rakshasa thing to say. Sorry, I didn't mean it that way."
Text: "지혜와 분별의 길을 택하고 나를 동맹으로 택하겠나? 아, 전형적인 락샤사 같은 말이군. 미안, 그런 뜻은 아니었어."

TextEng: "You are a scholar of the arcane arts, as am I. While I have greatly enjoyed our time together and the things we have learned and shared, I find it highly unlikely that you would choose me."
Text: "너도 나처럼 비전 마법의 학도지. 함께한 시간과 배우고 나눈 것들이 즐거웠지만, 나를 선택해야 한다고 주장하기는 어렵군."

TextEng: "Besides, such a statement would be very egotistical and very typical for one of my species. As you already know, I have a rather different view on life than the rest of my species."
Text: "게다가 그런 말은 매우 이기적이고 전형적인 락샤사 스러울 뿐이야. 이미 알다시피 나는 상당히 다른 관점을 가지고 있어."

TextEng: "As you wish. What would you like to discuss, friend?"
Text: "좋아. 뭘 이야기하고 싶은데, 친구?"

TextEng: "Such a callous attitude; are you afraid that you might learn something? Or are you so intimidated by my powerful, female, feline confidence that you forget how to behave in civilized conversation?"
Text: "냉정하군. 뭔가를 배우게 될까 봐 무서운 거야? 아니면 내 강인한 여성적 고양이 같은 자신감에 위축된 거야?"

TextEng: "Never mind, my... friend, I am sure you have your own goals in this conversation, so steer it towards a topic more to your liking."
Text: "됐어, 친구, 이 대화에서 네 나름의 목표가 있겠지. 더 마음에 드는 주제로 이끌어 봐."

TextEng: "Rakshasa believe that they are so superior to all other races that they have the right to do whatever they want. We enslave entire races, wiping out civilizations to further our own selfish designs."
Text: "락샤사는 다른 모든 종족보다 우월하다고 믿어서 원하는 대로 할 권리가 있다고 생각해. 우리는 종족 전체를 노예로 삼고, 문명을 몰살시키지."

TextEng: "I look at my people and I see a power and nobility eclipsed by foolish strife and selfish cruelty. If we could only turn from our corruption and focus on a just society, great things could be accomplished."
Text: "내 종족을 보면 어리석은 분쟁과 이기적인 잔인함에 가려진 힘과 고결함이 보여. 타락에서 벗어나 집중할 수만 있다면..."

TextEng: Jaboli grins wildly at you. "Enough of the philosophical discussions though; let us go back to our usual banter. Have you made a decision yet?"
Text: 자볼리가 활짝 미소 짓습니다. "하지만 철학 토론은 이쯤 하고, 평소의 수다로 돌아가자. 결정했어?"

TextEng: "I do not claim that we should all run out and give everything we own to the weaker races, or such nonsense."
Text: "우리 모두 가진 것을 약한 종족에게 나눠 줘야 한다거나 그런 헛소리를 하는 게 아니야."

TextEng: "I simply think that we should uphold a common set of laws that all people should obey. Nobles should not be exempt from these laws, nor the rich."
Text: "단지 모든 사람이 지켜야 할 공통의 법이 있어야 한다고 생각할 뿐이야. 귀족도, 부자도 이 법에서 면제되어서는 안 돼."

TextEng: "That would be the wisest choice. I hope you shall return, friend."
Text: "그게 가장 현명한 선택이야. 돌아오길 바라겠어, 친구."

TextEng: Jaboli frowns and growls, "And it did so to my fellow rakshasa, but I do not wish to speak of that. Tell me, have you decided upon my fate yet?"
Text: 자볼리가 인상을 찌푸리며 으르렁거립니다. "그것이 내 동료 락샤사에게 일어난 일이지만, 그 이야기는 하고 싶지 않아. 말해 봐, 내 운명을 결정했어?"

TextEng: "No, I do not believe that anyone is above justice. That is why I will understand if you do not chose me."
Text: "아니, 누구도 정의 위에 있지 않다고 믿어. 그래서 나를 선택하지 않아도 이해할 거야."

TextEng: "Not for good; for justice! Killing someone might not be a good thing, but it can be a just thing."
Text: "선이 아니라 정의를 위해! 누군가를 죽이는 것이 좋은 일은 아닐 수 있지만, 정의로운 일일 수는 있어."

TextEng: "And what did your best wisdom and judgment decide?"
Text: "그래서 네 최고의 지혜와 판단은 뭘 결정했지?"

TextEng: "Then I shall wait patiently until you are ready. It would not be wise to choose quickly."
Text: "그러면 준비될 때까지 참을성 있게 기다리겠어. 서둘러 선택하는 건 현명하지 못하지."

TextEng: Jaboli's eyes widen and she lets out a ferocious howl before her spirit loses its substance and fades away.
Text: 자볼리의 눈이 커지며 맹렬한 포효를 내지르더니 영혼이 실체를 잃고 사라집니다.

TextEng: She sighs and nods. "I cannot say this is entirely unexpected. Good luck, friend." Her spirit fades away into the darkness.
Text: 한숨을 쉬며 고개를 끄덕입니다. "완전히 예상 밖은 아니야. 행운을 빌어, 친구." 영혼이 어둠 속으로 사라집니다.

TextEng: "I think your judgment is perfectly sound, and you followed it. Things shall be well."
Text: "네 판단이 완벽하게 맞고, 그대로 따른 거야. 잘 될 거야."

TextEng: "I would like you to return to help me."
Text: "돌아와서 나를 도와줬으면 해."

TextEng: "I have a few questions for you first."
Text: "먼저 몇 가지 물어볼 게 있어."

TextEng: "That is all my questions."
Text: "질문은 다 했어."

TextEng: "What do you think about the others?"
Text: "다른 동료들에 대해 어떻게 생각해?"

TextEng: "I have other questions."
Text: "다른 질문이 있어."

TextEng: "Thanks for your opinion."
Text: "의견 고마워."

TextEng: "How badly could her insecurity be a problem?"
Text: "카이달라의 불안감이 얼마나 문제가 될 수 있어?"

TextEng: "I need to speak to the others before I decide."
Text: "결정하기 전에 다른 사람들과 이야기해야겠어."

TextEng: "What skills can you offer me, exactly?"
Text: "정확히 어떤 능력을 제공할 수 있지?"

TextEng: "Tell me why I should choose you."
Text: "왜 널 선택해야 하는지 말해 봐."

TextEng: "I haven't heard anything to make me think you are worth saving yet."
Text: "아직 네가 살릴 가치가 있다는 말을 못 들었는데."

TextEng: "Are you a good wizard?"
Text: "마법을 잘하는 편이야?"

TextEng: "Anything else useful?"
Text: "다른 쓸만한 건?"

TextEng: "Why were you exiled?"
Text: "왜 추방당했어?"

TextEng: "You mean I shouldn't choose you?"
Text: "날 선택하면 안 된다는 뜻이야?"

TextEng: "Let's talk about something else."
Text: "다른 이야기를 하자."

TextEng: "I couldn't care less about your view on life."
Text: "네 인생관 따위 관심 없어."

TextEng: "And what are your views?"
Text: "네 견해가 뭔데?"

TextEng: "Sounds good to me."
Text: "좋은 생각이야."

TextEng: "I have made a choice."
Text: "선택했어."

TextEng: "What is a just society?"
Text: "정의로운 사회란 뭐야?"

TextEng: "Sounds like a noble ideal."
Text: "고귀한 이상이네."

TextEng: "Sounds very unrealistic."
Text: "매우 비현실적인 것 같은데."

TextEng: "Sounds stupid to me."
Text: "바보 같은 소리야."

TextEng: "So you are one of those holier-than-thou types?"
Text: "그러면 넌 그 '나는 누구보다 도덕적' 부류야?"

TextEng: "So you see yourself as a force for good?"
Text: "그러면 넌 선의 세력이라고 자처하는 거야?"

TextEng: "I've changed my mind. I am not ready to choose yet."
Text: "마음이 바뀌었어. 아직 선택할 준비가 안 됐어."

TextEng: "I judge you unfit to live. Goodbye."
Text: "넌 살 자격이 없다고 판단한다. 안녕."

TextEng: "I cannot choose you, sorry."
Text: "널 선택할 수 없어, 미안."

TextEng: "Against my better judgment, I think I will need your skills."
Text: "판단에는 어긋나지만, 네 능력이 필요할 것 같아."

TextEng: "How are you, my friend? Are you ready to send me to my final rest?"
Text: "어떻게 지내, 친구? 나를 마지막 안식으로 보내 줄 준비가 됐어?"

TextEng: Kaidala, the nymph druid, rises over her corpse, smiling, until she begins to listen to an inaudible voice. The voice upsets her and she turns her large, watery eyes towards you.
Text: 님프 드루이드 카이달라가 시체 위로 떠오르며 미소 짓다가, 들리지 않는 목소리에 귀 기울이기 시작합니다. 그 목소리가 그녀를 동요시키고, 커다란 눈물 어린 눈으로 당신을 돌아봅니다.

TextEng: "I shall await your decision."
Text: "네 결정을 기다리겠어."

TextEng: "There is something wrong with you, <FirstName>, I can sense your distress. Who do you speak to? Tell me, is there anything I can do to ease your mind?"
Text: "뭔가 잘못된 거야, <이름>, 네 고뇌가 느껴져. 누구와 이야기하고 있는 거야? 말해 줘, 마음의 짐을 덜어 줄 수 있는 게 있을까?"

TextEng: "Indeed, it is what waits for all who cannot bear to live. I shall await your decision."
Text: "맞아, 그것이 살기 참을 수 없는 자에게 기다리는 것이지. 네 결정을 기다리겠어."

TextEng: "It has been done before, this is true; but long and hard is that road. I think you shall not succeed. I shall await your decision."
Text: "전례가 있긴 하지, 사실이야. 하지만 그 길은 길고 험해. 성공하지 못할 것 같아. 네 결정을 기다리겠어."

TextEng: "There is something wrong with you, <FirstName>, I can sense your distress. Who do you speak to? Tell me, is there anything I can do to ease your mind?"
Text: "뭔가 잘못된 거야, <이름>, 네 고뇌가 느껴져. 누구와 이야기하고 있는 거야? 말해 줘, 마음의 짐을 덜어 줄 수 있는 게 있을까?"

TextEng: "I shall await your decision."
Text: "네 결정을 기다리겠어."

TextEng: "No! You cannot choose me! Let the others live, <FirstName>. I am happy in death."
Text: "안 돼! 나를 선택하면 안 돼! 다른 사람들을 살려 줘, <이름>. 나는 죽음 속에서 행복해."

TextEng: "There should be no need. You can leave me here and rest easy with your decision."
Text: "그럴 필요 없어. 나를 여기 두고 가면 네 결정에 편히 쉴 수 있을 거야."

TextEng: "Do not be long, lifeholder. I grow impatient."
Text: "오래 끌지 마, 생명의 소유자여. 인내심이 바닥나고 있다."

TextEng: "I am ready to hear it. May I rest from my journey now, or do you still require my assistance?"
Text: "들을 준비가 됐어. 이제 내 여정에서 쉴 수 있는 거야, 아니면 아직 내 도움이 필요한 거야?"

TextEng: "Death is not so terrible, <FirstName>. Finally I can go and be happy, as I never could be in life. You know well how hard these years have been to me, so I do hope you will let me go."
Text: "죽음은 그리 끔찍하지 않아, <이름>. 드디어 살면서 결코 할 수 없었던 행복을 찾을 수 있거든. 이 세월이 나에게 얼마나 힘들었는지 잘 알잖아, 그러니 부탁이야."

TextEng: "I don't see what choice there is to make, but take all the time you need. I am content here."
Text: "무슨 선택을 해야 하는지 모르겠지만, 시간을 충분히 들여. 나는 여기서 만족해."

TextEng: Kaidala's soul lets out a deafening screech as the soul harvester drags it off into eternal torture.
Text: 카이달라의 영혼이 귀를 찢는 비명을 지르며 영혼 수확자가 영원한 고문 속으로 끌고 갑니다.

TextEng: She smiles and says, "Thank you." Then suddenly she turns and sees the soul harvester waiting for her. "Noooooooooo!"
Text: 미소를 짓고 말합니다. "고마워." 그러다 갑자기 뒤를 돌아보며 자기를 기다리는 영혼 수확자를 발견합니다. "안 돼에에에에!"

TextEng: She heaves a heavy sigh. "So be it. I shall do my best."
Text: 무거운 한숨을 쉽니다. "그렇다면 할 수 없지. 최선을 다하겠어."

TextEng: "I will do my best. It is the least I can do for you."
Text: "최선을 다할게. 네게 해 줄 수 있는 최소한의 보답이야."

TextEng: "Will you go and speak to the others now? Or have you made your choice?"
Text: "이제 다른 사람들에게 가서 이야기할 거야? 아니면 선택을 했어?"

TextEng: "I know he is a good man, but Calibast's fiery countenance is too much for me. It is harder for me to be near him. I would not condemn him to death for it though."
Text: "그가 좋은 사람인 건 알지만, 캘리바스트의 불타는 모습은 나에게 너무 힘들어. 그 곁에 있기가 더 어려워. 하지만 그 때문에 죽음을 바라지는 않아."

TextEng: "Indeed, I view all of our companions as far more worthy than I."
Text: "사실, 우리 동료들 모두가 나보다 훨씬 가치 있다고 생각해."

TextEng: "I owe them nothing less. They have all helped me in the past. I would do anything to help them, or you."
Text: "당연하지. 모두 과거에 나를 도와줬으니까. 그들을 위해서라면 뭐든 하겠어. 너를 위해서도."

TextEng: "Of course I would... if that is necessary. He has always been kind to me, and it is in my mind alone that he would pose a danger to me. Fires took my home, and he is a creature of fire."
Text: "물론이야... 필요하다면. 그는 항상 나에게 친절했고, 위험하게 느끼는 건 내 마음속에서만이야. 불이 내 고향을 앗아갔으니 그의 불꽃이 고통스러워."

TextEng: "The others all want to live, so I make your choice easier. Take two of them and leave me be."
Text: "다른 동료들은 모두 살고 싶어 해. 그러니 내가 네 선택을 쉽게 해 줄게. 둘을 데려가고 나는 놔둬."

TextEng: "His passions run hot, for drinking, wenching, and fighting. It bothers me some, but... he is a good man, I believe."
Text: "그의 열정은 뜨거워. 음주, 여자, 싸움에. 좀 거슬리지만... 좋은 사람이라고 생각해."

TextEng: "All of his passions burn hot. I have even thought that his fascination with you maybe burned hotter than any... but I could be wrong. It is not my place to say such things."
Text: "그의 모든 열정이 뜨거워. 너에 대한 그의 관심이 다른 어떤 것보다 더 뜨거울 수도 있다고 생각한 적도 있지만... 확실하지는 않아. 내가 할 말은 아니야."

TextEng: "I am a druid, and can heal you, or wield the powers of nature to assist you. I do not fear death, so I am not afraid to enter battle either. I prefer to use natural weapons, such as a club or quarterstaff."
Text: "나는 드루이드야. 치유하거나 자연의 힘을 빌려 도울 수 있어. 죽음을 두려워하지 않으니 전투도 두렵지 않아. 자연의 힘으로 싸우는 걸 선호하지."

TextEng: "If I had my former powers back... then I would be formidable indeed. But that is in the past. The destruction of my home ruined me, and stole my natural gifts."
Text: "예전 힘을 되찾는다면... 정말 대단할 텐데. 하지만 그건 과거야. 고향의 파괴가 나를 망가뜨리고 타고난 능력을 빼앗았어."

TextEng: "The terror of the night when my forest was put to the torch by superstitious fools is burnt into my mind for eternity."
Text: "미신에 사로잡힌 바보들이 내 숲에 불을 지른 그 밤의 공포가 내 마음에 영원히 새겨져 있어."

TextEng: "The flames roared and devoured all of my creatures. All of my sisters, the dryads. Even me. The flames licked at my face and my hair. The flesh on my body was scorched black when you found me."
Text: "불길이 으르렁대며 내 생물들을 모조리 삼켰어. 내 자매들인 드라이어드도. 나까지. 불꽃이 내 얼굴과 머리카락을 핥았어. 몸의 살이 녹았어..."

TextEng: "Oh, <FirstName>, the pain in my body is gone, but my mind and my soul... they burn, even now they still burn." Tears flow down her cheeks, the scars on the one side are still red and sore, despite the passage of time.
Text: "오, <이름>, 몸의 고통은 사라졌지만 내 정신과 영혼은... 타고 있어, 지금도 여전히 타고 있어." 눈물이 뺨을 타고 흐르며, 한쪽의 흉터가 기괴하게 눈물을 비켜 보냅니다.

TextEng: "No, it is in the past, the present and the future. Every time I see my reflection, every time I close my eyes to sleep, every time I run a hand over my ravaged face, it is there to haunt me."
Text: "아니, 그건 과거이자 현재이자 미래야. 내 모습을 볼 때마다, 잠들기 위해 눈을 감을 때마다, 파괴된 얼굴 위로 손을 올릴 때마다..."

TextEng: "Maybe to you it is just a moment in history; to me it is the only moment... the only one that matters."
Text: "네게는 역사의 한 순간일 수 있지. 나에게는 유일한 순간이야... 중요한 유일한 순간."

TextEng: "We... we tried, but the earth where my forest stood, it is scarred. The people who burned it... they make certain that nothing grows on it. Even the smallest shoot is quickly pulled or burned."
Text: "우리가... 시도했지만, 내 숲이 있던 땅은 상처 입었어. 불을 지른 사람들이... 아무것도 자라지 못하게 해. 작은 새싹마저도..."

TextEng: "What was there in life for me that was so great? I am happy to finally be rid of that burden."
Text: "살면서 뭐가 그렇게 좋았다고? 그 짐에서 드디어 벗어나게 되어 기뻐."

TextEng: "There is no future for me. Not in this life. Even you must see that."
Text: "나에게 미래란 없어. 이 삶에서는. 너도 그걸 알아야 해."

TextEng: She stares at you with hollow eyes. "Go away, <FirstName>. I wish to be free of your company. Free of this wretched existence. Choose someone else to torment."
Text: 텅 빈 눈으로 당신을 응시합니다. "가 버려, <이름>. 네 곁에서 벗어나고 싶어. 이 비참한 존재에서 벗어나고 싶어. 괴롭힐 다른 사람을 골라."

TextEng: She smiles hesitantly at you, for the first time in many months. "You are too optimistic for this world, <FirstName>. You shame me. I guess sometimes that is a good thing."
Text: 몇 달 만에 처음으로 머뭇거리며 미소 짓습니다. "넌 이 세상에 너무 낙천적이야, <이름>. 부끄럽게 만드는군. 가끔은 그것도 좋은 거겠지."

TextEng: "What else would you like to discuss?"
Text: "다른 건 뭘 이야기하고 싶어?"

TextEng: "It... it is understandable. If only time could hold still for a while, that I could catch my breath. Maybe then the pain would be eased."
Text: "이... 이해해. 시간이 잠시만 멈춰 줄 수 있다면, 숨을 고를 수 있다면. 그러면 고통이 좀 가라앉을지도."

TextEng: "But you have a choice to make. What more do you need from me?"
Text: "하지만 선택을 해야 하잖아. 더 필요한 게 뭐야?"

TextEng: "I have noticed you speaking to something, but whatever you think you see, it is not real, <FirstName>. Put it from your mind. Obviously your own death has scattered your wits."
Text: "네가 뭔가에게 말하는 건 알아, 하지만 네가 보는 것이 무엇이든 진짜가 아니야, <이름>. 마음에서 떨쳐 내. 네 자신의 죽음이 정신을 흩뜨린 게 분명해."

TextEng: "You have been a... friend... of sorts. Perhaps you were my only friend, but I do not think that is enough for me to hold onto life. Have pity and let me go!"
Text: "넌... 어느 정도 친구였어. 어쩌면 유일한 친구였을 수도 있어, 하지만 그것만으로 삶에 매달리기엔 부족해. 불쌍히 여기고 보내 줘!"

TextEng: "Please, <FirstName>, though I have grown fond of you, there has never been anything more than friendship between us. Perhaps if we had more time together..."
Text: "제발, <이름>, 정이 들긴 했지만 우리 사이에 우정 이상의 것은 없었어. 시간이 더 있었다면..."

TextEng: "But no... no one could ever love a scarred and maimed creature such as myself. Have pity on me, <FirstName>. Let me go."
Text: "하지만 아니야... 흉터투성이의 불구 같은 존재를 사랑할 사람은 없어. 불쌍히 여겨 줘, <이름>. 보내 줘."

TextEng: "I do not understand what you are talking about. Truly, I tell you it is not so bad here. Once you let me go, I shall move on to a nicer place, of that I am confident."
Text: "무슨 말인지 모르겠어. 정말이야, 여기가 그렇게 나쁘지 않아. 나를 보내 주면 더 좋은 곳으로 갈 수 있을 거야, 확신해."

TextEng: Kaidala smiles sadly at you. "That is for the best, as I have said all along."
Text: 카이달라가 슬프게 미소 짓습니다. "그게 최선이야, 처음부터 계속 말했듯이."

TextEng: "Still, if my healing arts are needed, then I shall do my best to assist you."
Text: "하지만 내 치유 능력이 필요하다면, 최선을 다해 도울게."

TextEng: "I know we have, but all good things must come to an end. You should let me go; but if you choose otherwise, then I promise you my best."
Text: "그랬지, 하지만 좋은 것은 모두 끝이 있어. 나를 보내 줘. 하지만 달리 선택한다면 최선을 다하겠다고 약속할게."

TextEng: Kaidala's eyes mist over. "If... if it means so much to you, then I will join you. But I think it is not fair to our other companions."
Text: 카이달라의 눈에 안개가 낍니다. "만약... 네게 그렇게 중요하다면, 함께하겠어. 하지만 다른 동료들에게 공평하지 않다고 생각해."

TextEng: "I shall devote my healing powers, and as many of the powers of nature still in my command to your service. You do hold a special place in my heart, <FirstName>, perhaps we shall see where it leads us."
Text: "치유 능력과 아직 남아 있는 자연의 힘을 네게 바치겠어. 넌 내 마음속에 특별한 자리를 차지하고 있으니까, <이름>."

TextEng: "It cannot see Blackest Death, but soon it shall feel our teeth and our claws."
Text: "칠흑의 죽음이 보이지 않지만, 곧 우리의 이빨과 발톱을 느낄 것이다."

TextEng: "What are you talking about, <FirstName>? It is only you and I and the voice that told me to wait for your choice."
Text: "무슨 말을 하는 거야, <이름>? 여기는 나와 너, 그리고 내 선택을 기다리라고 한 목소리뿐이야."

TextEng: "I am one of the soul harvesters. I am that which waits and steals. There is a fate that waits for those who strive to end their own lives. Those who despise themselves."
Text: "나는 영혼 수확자다. 기다리고 훔치는 존재다. 스스로 목숨을 끊으려 한 자에게는 기다리는 운명이 있다. 부여받은 삶의 선물을 경멸하는 자에게는."

TextEng: "There is much sustenance to be found in the pain and agony of a soul such as this! I cannot touch you, nor can you touch me. I am Blackest Death for those who are dead."
Text: "이런 영혼의 고통과 번민에서 풍성한 양분을 얻을 수 있다! 나는 너를 건드릴 수 없고, 너도 나를 건드릴 수 없다. 나는 스스로 목숨을 끊으려 한 자에게 칠흑의 죽음이다!"

TextEng: "What do I care? If I don't choose her, you can have her."
Text: "내가 알 바 아니야? 카이달라를 선택하지 않으면 네가 데려가도 돼."

TextEng: "This is the price she must pay then."
Text: "그녀가 치러야 할 대가겠지."

TextEng: "Even if you take her, I shall find a way to free her from you, someday!"
Text: "네가 데려가도, 언젠가 그녀를 구해낼 방법을 찾겠다!"

TextEng: "You cannot touch her if I choose to bring her back!"
Text: "내가 되살리기로 하면 넌 건드릴 수 없어!"

TextEng: "I need to speak to the others before I decide."
Text: "결정하기 전에 다른 사람들과 이야기해야겠어."

TextEng: "You don't want another chance at life?"
Text: "삶에 다시 한번 기회를 원하지 않아?"

TextEng: "I have made a choice."
Text: "선택했어."

TextEng: "I've made a mistake. I need a little more time before I choose."
Text: "실수했어. 시간이 좀 더 필요해."

TextEng: "Enjoy your time in the underworld; you'll not be leaving it soon!"
Text: "저승에서 즐거운 시간 보내. 금방 나오지는 못할 거야!"

TextEng: "I cannot choose you, Kaidala."
Text: "널 선택할 수 없어, 카이달라."

TextEng: "Against my better judgment, I think I will need your skills."
Text: "판단에는 어긋나지만, 네 능력이 필요할 것 같아."

TextEng: "I would like you to return and assist me."
Text: "돌아와서 나를 도와줬으면 해."

TextEng: "I have a few questions for you."
Text: "몇 가지 물어볼 게 있어."

TextEng: "Death will not be pleasant for you."
Text: "죽음이 그대에게 유쾌하지 않을 거야."

TextEng: "That is all my questions."
Text: "질문은 다 했어."

TextEng: "Who would you say I should not choose?"
Text: "누구를 선택하면 안 된다고 생각해?"

TextEng: "I have other questions."
Text: "다른 질문이 있어."

TextEng: "That is an admirable sentiment."
Text: "존경스러운 마음이야."

TextEng: "Would you work with Calibast if I chose both of you?"
Text: "내가 둘 다 선택하면 캘리바스트와 함께할 수 있겠어?"

TextEng: "What skills do you have, exactly?"
Text: "정확히 어떤 능력을 가지고 있어?"

TextEng: "Why do you long to die?"
Text: "왜 죽고 싶어 하는 거야?"

TextEng: "What is the creature that stands behind you?"
Text: "뒤에 서 있는 그 존재가 뭐야?"

TextEng: "You are of little use to me in this condition."
Text: "이 상태로는 나에게 쓸모가 별로 없어."

TextEng: "You need to get over this. It's in the past."
Text: "극복해야 해. 과거의 일이야."

TextEng: "Why couldn't you be healed?"
Text: "왜 치유를 받을 수 없었어?"

TextEng: "You disgust me with your pathetic sniveling."
Text: "한심한 울음질에 역겹다."

TextEng: "I suppose you are right."
Text: "네 말이 맞는 것 같아."

TextEng: "I shall never give up!"
Text: "절대 포기하지 않겠어!"

TextEng: "We will find a way to heal you."
Text: "널 치유할 방법을 찾을 거야."

TextEng: "I am sorry to bring back those memories."
Text: "그 기억을 떠올리게 해서 미안해."

TextEng: "There is something waiting to torture your soul."
Text: "네 영혼을 고문하려고 기다리는 존재가 있어."

TextEng: "Then I guess you shall die."
Text: "그러면 죽는 수밖에 없겠네."

TextEng: "How can you know what feelings I have for you, if you die?"
Text: "네가 죽으면 내 감정을 어떻게 알겠어?"

TextEng: "I shall destroy you first!"
Text: "먼저 처치해 주마!"

TextEng: "We have had some good times together, Kaidala."
Text: "우리 함께 좋은 시간을 보내긴 했지, 카이달라."

TextEng: "Is our friendship not enough to make you want to live?"
Text: "우리의 우정만으로 살고 싶지 않아?"

TextEng: "Why do you wait for her?"
Text: "왜 그녀를 기다리고 있는 거냐?"

TextEng: "Tell me what you are, foul creature!"
Text: "네가 뭔지 말해라, 추악한 존재여!"

TextEng: "Oh, you come to cast Trip down into the darkened halls of death, I am so sure of it! Please, do not do this thing to me!" Trip's wiry whiskers begin to twitch nervously.
Text: "오, 트립을 죽음의 어두운 전당으로 내쫓으러 왔구나, 분명 그럴 거야! 제발, 이런 짓은 하지 마!" 트립의 뻣뻣한 수염이 떨리기 시작합니다.

TextEng: With a yowl of fright, Trip's shade rises up above his torn and ravaged body. His eyes stare with a glassy look as he listens to an inaudible voice. Finally he sighs and looks at you.
Text: 공포에 울부짖으며 트립의 그림자가 찢기고 헐벗은 시체 위로 떠오릅니다. 유리 같은 눈으로 들리지 않는 목소리에 귀 기울이다 마침내 당신을 바라봅니다.

TextEng: "Good choice! Always overrule your better judgment if it is good for Trip!"
Text: "좋은 선택이야! 트립에게 좋으면 판단을 무시해도 돼!"

TextEng: "I would be proud to do so! You shall not regret your choice!"
Text: "기꺼이! 네 선택을 후회하지 않을 거야!"

TextEng: "Questions? I can answer questions. I have no fear of words... unless they are mean, cruel words... or loud words... I do not like loud words either. You cannot trust them!"
Text: "질문? 질문에는 답할 수 있어. 말은 무섭지 않으니까... 심술궂고 잔인한 말만 아니면... 큰 소리도 싫어. 큰 소리를 치면 안 돼. 큰 소리도 싫으니까."

TextEng: "Good, good, your questions were starting to frighten me. Now, if you just want to choose me, then we can get on to making you a wealthy <man/woman>."
Text: "됐어, 됐어, 네 질문이 무서워지기 시작했어. 자, 그냥 나를 선택해 주면 부자로 만들어 줄게."

TextEng: "Forget the nasty cat thing. She is mean and cruel and would eat me, if she did not know I would give her some kind of disease! Yes, I am a pest to her, so better not to take any chances."
Text: "그 고약한 고양이 같은 것은 잊어. 심술궂고 잔인하고, 트립이 어떤 병을 옮길지 모른다는 것만 아니면 나를 잡아먹었을 거야! 그래, 나는 그녀에게 골칫거리야. 좋지!"

TextEng: "Do not take the dwarf man either! He hurts the eyes and hides the shadows with his fiery features! And the nymph? Why I am a perversion of nature, and proud of it! She would 'cure' me of myself."
Text: "드워프 남자도 데려가지 마! 불타는 모습이 눈이 아프고 그림자를 가리잖아! 님프는? 나는 자연의 변태이고, 자랑스러워!"

TextEng: "But you will choose another besides me... I see that now. So choose either of the latter, but let the hungry Jaboli beast rot and die! Then she cannot eat me."
Text: "하지만 나 말고 다른 걸 선택할 거지... 이제 알겠어. 둘 중 아무나 골라, 하지만 배고픈 자볼리는 썩어 죽게 놔둬! 그러면 나를 못 잡아먹잖아."

TextEng: "Help? Yes, Trip will help you! Just bring me back and see what we can do. You can be my champion and I shall be your shadow! I will keep you safe from harm!"
Text: "도움? 그래, 트립이 도와줄게! 나만 되살려 주면 뭘 할 수 있는지 보자고. 네가 나의 용사가 되고 나는 네 그림자가 될게! 위험에서 지켜 줄게!"

TextEng: "Have you seen that hideous face? She claims to have her honor to protect and says she would never eat me, but I know the truth."
Text: "그 끔찍한 얼굴 봤어? 자기 명예를 지킬 거라서 절대 안 잡아먹는다고 하지만, 나는 진실을 알아."

TextEng: "Smells like cat, feels like cat, sounds like cat, smack me if it isn't a cat! The only thing stopping her from eating me is my disease."
Text: "고양이 냄새, 고양이 촉감, 고양이 소리, 고양이가 아니면 때려 줘! 그녀가 나를 안 잡아먹는 유일한 이유는 내 병 때문이야."

TextEng: "Choices, choices, they are yours to make, so says the new voice! For a voice in my head, it certainly seems to be most persistent. The other voices don't trust this new voice."
Text: "선택이란, 선택, 네가 할 선택이라고 새 목소리가 말해! 머릿속 목소리치고는 참 끈질기네. 다른 목소리들은 이 놈을 믿지 말라고 하지만!"

TextEng: "Hmm, maybe if she ate me she would turn into a rat! She might make a sexy rat, do you not agree?"
Text: "흠, 어쩌면 나를 잡아먹으면 쥐가 될지도! 섹시한 쥐가 될 것 같지 않아?"

TextEng: "That is what they say, but at least I'm handsome! I also have it on good authority that I am very charming... for a rat-like creature... but enough about me..."
Text: "다들 그러지, 하지만 적어도 나는 잘생겼잖아! 그리고 확실한 정보에 따르면 나는 아주 매력적이래... 쥐 같은 생물치고는... 하지만 내 이야기는 충분해..."

TextEng: "What do you mean? Wait, I suppose if I were eaten I wouldn't much care if she was a sexy rat. Let's not talk about this anymore."
Text: "무슨 뜻이야? 잠깐, 잡아먹히면 그녀가 섹시한 쥐인지 어떤지 신경도 못 쓰겠지. 이 얘기 그만하자."

TextEng: "A good point, a very good point! I applaud your wisdom! That is why I enjoy traveling with you; such uncommonly good sense."
Text: "좋은 지적이야, 아주 좋은 지적! 네 지혜에 박수를 보내! 그래서 너랑 다니는 게 좋은 거야. 드물게 좋은 판단력이지."

TextEng: "I sneak. Yes, I sneak so well no one ever hears me. I pick a lock, I disable a trap, and I have even picked a pocket or two. Not yours though... never yours."
Text: "잠입이야. 그래, 아무도 트립 소리를 못 들어. 자물쇠도 따고, 함정도 해제하고, 주머니도 좀 털었지. 네 건 안 털었어... 절대로."

TextEng: "But best of all is my ability to find hidden things. Caches of gold, secret doors, and all of these marvelous things are so easy for me to find. Without me you would be a poorer <man/woman>."
Text: "하지만 최고는 숨겨진 것을 찾는 능력이야. 금 보관소, 비밀 문, 이런 멋진 것들이 나한테는 아주 쉬워. 나 없이는 많은 것을 놓칠 거야!"

TextEng: "I could be useful... I could... I could... oh, what could I do? Oh, I know, I can find things, yes. I am very good at finding things that no one else can see. You like things, right? Well, of course you do."
Text: "쓸모가 있을 수 있어... 있을 수... 있을... 뭘 할 수 있지? 아, 알겠다, 물건을 찾을 수 있어. 아무도 못 보는 것을 찾는 데 아주 능해."

TextEng: "Red things, purple things, old things, new things, gem things, magic things, things that you can really sink your teeth into and maul for a while, rubbing them through the dust and dirt to add the extra flavor..."
Text: "빨간 것, 보라색 것, 낡은 것, 새 것, 보석, 마법 물건, 이빨로 물어뜯고 한참 굴리며 놀 수 있는 것들, 뺨에 비비면서..."

TextEng: Trip nods enthusiastically. "You are correct and it is true, very possibly, indeed. But you will take me anyways, because you want what is best for you, not what is best for Trip!"
Text: 트립이 열심히 고개를 끄덕입니다. "네 말이 맞고 사실이야, 아마 틀림없이 정말로. 하지만 어차피 나를 데려갈 거야, 네게 좋은 걸 원하지 나쁜 걸 원하진 않잖아!"

TextEng: "Oh yes, Trip promises such help as you would never believe. Come, you could choose me now and then the suspense would end. I am not a big fan of suspense. Not so much."
Text: "오 그래, 트립은 네가 상상도 못할 만큼 도와줄 거야. 자, 지금 나를 선택하면 긴장감이 끝나잖아. 나는 긴장감을 좋아하지 않아. 전혀."

TextEng: "I can be a good helper, really I can. No one moves through the shadows or picks a lock quite like Trip. And forget about traps, I take care of them for you, yes?"
Text: "좋은 조수가 될 수 있어, 정말이야. 그림자 속을 누비거나 자물쇠를 따는 건 트립만 한 사람이 없지. 함정도 잊어, 내가 다 처리해 줄 테니까."

TextEng: "That is the right path for your thoughts, yes! Listen to that voice of reason! It tells you of the times Trip saved your life when the bad shadows come calling. YOU NEED TRIP! That's what it says!"
Text: "네 생각이 올바른 방향으로 가고 있어! 이성의 목소리에 귀 기울여! 나쁜 그림자가 올 때 트립이 네 목숨을 구한 적 있다고 하잖아!"

TextEng: Trip's spirit slumps a little. "I guess I should have seen that coming. No one likes Trip. I should just go and bash my head in I suppose. Oh wait, I'm already dead. Well, that's a far better light to see it all in."
Text: 트립의 영혼이 조금 풀이 죽습니다. "그렇게 될 줄 알았어야 했는데. 아무도 트립을 좋아하지 않아. 가서 머리를 박아야겠어. 아, 잠깐, 이미 죽었지."

TextEng: "Now, maybe you don't want me for my excellent charm, but think of those large explosions that occur when a trap goes off. Think of the locked doors you might need through. Trip can help you with these and more!"
Text: "내 뛰어난 매력이 싫다 해도, 함정이 터질 때의 거대한 폭발을 생각해 봐. 열지 못하는 잠긴 문도 생각해 봐. 나 없이는 그런 것들이 방해가 될 거야!"

TextEng: "Nothing! No voices, no my good friend! There are no voices in here!" He taps his head, then whispers, "Shut up, you must not speak so loud. <He/She> might hear you and not pick us."
Text: "아무것도 아냐! 목소리 같은 거 없어, 좋은 친구! 여기 안에 목소리 같은 건 없다고!" 머리를 두드리더니 속삭인다. "쉿, 그렇게 크게 말하면 안 돼. 들을지도 몰라."

TextEng: The quivering spirit twitches feverishly. "The others? They will lie to you, yes they will! But heed the words of Trip; trust no one... ever! Except me... I am the exception to the rule."
Text: 떨리는 영혼이 열병처럼 경련합니다. "다른 사람들? 거짓말할 거야, 틀림없어! 트립의 말을 들어. 아무도 믿지 마... 절대로! 나만 빼고... 나는 진실만 말해."

TextEng: "But you know this, sorry, sorry. I grovel at the feet of your wisdom and would serve you well."
Text: "하지만 그건 이미 알지, 미안, 미안. 네 지혜 앞에 엎드려 잘 모실게."

TextEng: "Very well, I accept. Oh, wait; you didn't say what your choice was. Please, tell me you will take me with you!"
Text: "좋아, 수락한다. 오, 잠깐, 선택을 말 안 했잖아. 제발, 나를 데려간다고 해 줘!"

TextEng: "Oh, <FirstName>, you are making me very nervous. It would be better for both of us if you would just choose Trip right now."
Text: "오, <이름>, 나를 초조하게 만들고 있어. 그냥 지금 당장 트립을 선택하면 둘 다 좋을 텐데."

TextEng: Trip's soul lets out a piercing screech as it is torn away from its body and off into dark eternity.
Text: 트립의 영혼이 귀를 찢는 비명을 지르며 몸에서 찢겨져 어둠의 영원 속으로 끌려갑니다.

TextEng: "No, no, no! Please, not into the darkness!" Trip scratches and claws to no avail as his spirit is drawn into another plane of existence.
Text: "안 돼, 안 돼, 안 돼! 제발, 어둠 속으로 들어가기 싫어!" 트립이 필사적으로 할퀴고 발버둥치지만 소용없이 영혼이 다른 차원으로 끌려갑니다.

TextEng: "Against my better judgment, I think I will need your skills."
Text: "판단에는 어긋나지만, 네 능력이 필요할 것 같아."

TextEng: "I would like you to return to help me."
Text: "돌아와서 나를 도와줬으면 해."

TextEng: "I have a few questions for you first."
Text: "먼저 몇 가지 물어볼 게 있어."

TextEng: "That is all my questions."
Text: "질문은 다 했어."

TextEng: "What do you think of the others?"
Text: "다른 동료들에 대해 어떻게 생각해?"

TextEng: "I have other questions."
Text: "다른 질문이 있어."

TextEng: "I guess that helps. Somehow."
Text: "도움이 되긴 하네. 어떻게든."

TextEng: "I need to speak to the others before I decide."
Text: "결정하기 전에 다른 사람들과 이야기해야겠어."

TextEng: "Why do you think she will eat you?"
Text: "왜 그녀가 널 잡아먹을 거라고 생각해?"

TextEng: "A sexy rat? There's an image I didn't need!"
Text: "섹시한 쥐? 필요 없는 상상이었는데!"

TextEng: "You are very strange."
Text: "넌 정말 이상해."

TextEng: "I... I don't even know how to answer that."
Text: "나는... 그건 어떻게 대답해야 할지 모르겠어."

TextEng: "If she ate you, you could hardly appreciate a sexy rat!"
Text: "잡아먹히면 섹시한 쥐인지 아닌지 알 수도 없잖아!"

TextEng: "What skills can you offer me, exactly?"
Text: "정확히 어떤 능력을 제공할 수 있지?"

TextEng: "Tell me more about why I should choose you."
Text: "왜 널 선택해야 하는지 더 말해 봐."

TextEng: "I think you're better off dead."
Text: "넌 죽어 있는 게 더 나은 것 같아."

TextEng: "If I choose you, I'll be expecting plenty of treasure!"
Text: "널 선택하면 보물을 잔뜩 기대하겠어!"

TextEng: "I guess you are good at finding extra treasures."
Text: "추가 보물을 잘 찾긴 하는 것 같네."

TextEng: "You are too strange, Trip. I'm not sure I could stand to have you around much more."
Text: "넌 너무 이상해, 트립. 더 같이 다닐 수 있을지 모르겠어."

TextEng: "What other voices are you talking about?"
Text: "다른 목소리들이란 게 뭐야?"

TextEng: "I have made a choice."
Text: "선택했어."

TextEng: "I've made a mistake. I can't choose yet."
Text: "실수했어. 아직 선택할 수 없어."

TextEng: "I like you better dead than alive. Goodbye."
Text: "죽어 있는 게 살아 있는 것보다 나아. 안녕."

TextEng: "I cannot choose you, sorry."
Text: "널 선택할 수 없어, 미안."

TextEng: The deer sniffs at you, perhaps surprised that you managed to get so close.
Text: 사슴이 당신의 냄새를 맡으며, 이렇게 가까이 다가온 것에 놀란 듯합니다.

TextEng: The deer is startled at first, but then eyes you with intrigue, wondering what you could possibly want.
Text: 사슴은 처음에 놀랐지만, 이내 호기심 어린 눈으로 당신을 바라보며 대체 무슨 용건인지 궁금해합니다.

TextEng: The deer begins to make an elaborate farewell, but trails off as its mind gets distracted by a colorful bird flying by.
Text: 사슴이 정성껏 작별 인사를 하려 하다가, 곁을 날아가는 화려한 새에 정신이 팔려 말을 잇지 못합니다.

TextEng: The deer doesn't really seem to understand the question.  The best answer it can give you is that it would really appreciate it if you didn't eat deer. It would be good if you ate wolves though.
Text: 사슴은 질문을 잘 이해하지 못하는 것 같습니다. 겨우 알아낸 대답이라곤, 아무도 자기를 잡아먹지 않으면 정말 좋겠다는 것뿐입니다.

TextEng: It blinks a couple of times and wonders how you would feel if you were on the bottom of the food chain. It's just happy to have survived this long.
Text: 몇 번 눈을 깜박이더니, 먹이 사슬의 맨 아래에 있으면 기분이 어떨지 반문합니다. 그래도 아직 잡아먹히지 않은 것만으로 감사하게 여기고 있습니다.

TextEng: The deer seems to have difficulty distinguishing between what you consider to be monsters and everything else that hunts deer.
Text: 사슴은 당신이 말하는 몬스터와 자기를 사냥하는 다른 모든 것의 차이를 구별하지 못하는 것 같습니다.

TextEng: After some time, you get the impression that it has seen a number of goblins wandering the area. It really doesn't hate goblins any more than it hates humans.
Text: 한참 뒤, 고블린 여러 마리가 이 지역을 돌아다니는 것을 보았다는 인상을 받습니다. 고블린을 특별히 미워하지는 않지만, 그들이 자기를 잡아먹으려 했으니 그다지 좋아하지도 않습니다.

TextEng: "Hello, deer."
Text: "안녕, 사슴아."

TextEng: "Happy grazing. Goodbye."
Text: "즐거운 풀 뜯기를. 안녕."

TextEng: "Is there anything I can do for you?"
Text: "내가 도울 일이 있니?"

TextEng: "How is life treating you?"
Text: "살아가는 건 어떠니?"

TextEng: "Have you seen any monsters?"
Text: "몬스터를 본 적 있니?"

TextEng: The dog sniffs at you with a growl, then calms down and looks about for possible enemies.
Text: 개가 으르렁거리며 당신의 냄새를 맡더니, 이내 진정하고 주변에 적이 없는지 둘러봅니다.

TextEng: The dog gazes up at you and wags its tail. It hopes that you will be nice to his mistresses.
Text: 개가 올려다보며 꼬리를 흔듭니다. 주인 아가씨들에게 잘해 주길 바라는 것 같습니다.

TextEng: The dog wags its tail again in farewell, then looks around for enemies.
Text: 개가 작별 인사로 다시 꼬리를 흔들더니, 주변에 적이 없는지 살핍니다.

TextEng: The dog seems to think that if you give his mistresses gold in exchange for stuff, they will be happy and he will get some choice table scraps that night.
Text: 개는 당신이 주인 아가씨들에게 금화를 주고 물건을 사면 그녀들이 기뻐할 것이고, 그러면 자기에게 뭔가 맛있는 것을 줄 거라고 생각하는 것 같습니다.

TextEng: It recalls a recent attack on the caravan where it managed to kill a few scaly creatures. Most of the time it doesn't get the chance, because his mistresses always take care of it.
Text: 최근 대상에 대한 습격에서 비늘 달린 생물 몇 마리를 죽였던 기억이 떠오릅니다. 대부분의 경우 싸울 기회는 없지만, 이번에는 용감히 싸웠다고 합니다.

TextEng: You get the impression that the dog doesn't quite understand what they do exactly, but he knows that the monsters avoid them whenever they do it.
Text: 개는 주인들이 정확히 무엇을 하는지는 잘 모르는 것 같지만, 몬스터들이 그녀들을 피한다는 것은 압니다. 주인들이 안전하기만 하면 그걸로 만족입니다.

TextEng: You get the impression of wagons surrounding two elven women. In the dog's mind they are the sweetest, most wonderful creatures in the whole world.
Text: 두 엘프 여인을 둘러싼 마차들의 이미지가 떠오릅니다. 개의 마음속에서 그녀들은 세상에서 가장 다정하고 훌륭한 존재입니다.

TextEng: "Hello, dog."
Text: "안녕, 개야."

TextEng: "Goodbye."
Text: "안녕."

TextEng: "Is there anything I can do for you?"
Text: "내가 도울 일이 있니?"

TextEng: "Have you seen any monsters?"
Text: "몬스터를 본 적 있니?"

TextEng: "Who are your mistresses?"
Text: "주인이 누구야?"

TextEng: The hermit sips his glass of honey mead and looks at you with a startled expression. "Who are you? What do you think you are doing in here?"
Text: 은둔자가 꿀 술을 홀짝이며 놀란 표정으로 당신을 바라본다. "누구요? 여기서 뭐 하는 거요?"

TextEng: "You have come to steal my honey, haven't you? You... you look familiar. Did I catch you stealing my honey before?"
Text: "내 꿀을 훔치러 왔지? 그렇지? 당신... 어디서 본 적 있는 것 같은데. 전에 내 꿀을 훔치는 걸 잡은 적이 있었나?"

TextEng: "I... I am tired. Why don't you just wander out of here and run your errands for the keep now? Don't steal any honey on your way out."
Text: "나... 피곤하다. 그냥 나가서 성채를 위한 심부름이나 다녀오게. 나갈 때 꿀 훔치지 말고."

TextEng: "I... I guess that makes sense. Here is... wait... my gold is gone. Oh, sure! First my honey and now my gold! I hate thieves! I don't trust you anymore. Get out of my house!"
Text: "그... 그건 그렇구나. 여기... 잠깐... 금이 없어졌잖아. 그래, 당연하지! 먼저 꿀이고 이제 금이야! 도둑은 질색이야! 더 이상 못 믿겠어!"

TextEng: "I could not ask that of you. No, you are too important. The voice said you had important things to be doing for the keep. If you could just find someone to assist me, that would be good enough."
Text: "그건 부탁할 수 없어. 안 돼, 당신은 너무 중요한 사람이야. 목소리가 성채를 위한 중요한 일이 있다고 했거든. 누군가 정직한 사람만 찾아 주면..."

TextEng: "That... that would be nice. Please try to find someone honest."
Text: "그러면... 좋겠다. 정직한 사람을 찾아봐 줘."

TextEng: "There is nothing wrong with my honey! I have the best honey for leagues. Why, my honey sells so well that I have added a new hive so that I can get more."
Text: "내 꿀에는 아무 문제 없어! 이 근방에서 제일 좋은 꿀이라고. 꿀이 너무 잘 팔려서 벌통도 새로 하나 추가했다고!"

TextEng: "You are just trying to trick me so you can steal my honey! Well, this is one hermit who won't be tricked so easily! You can just get out of my house and do what business you must for the keep, young <man/woman>!"
Text: "내 꿀을 훔치려고 속이는 거지! 이 은둔자는 그렇게 쉽게 속지 않아! 내 집에서 당장 나가!"

TextEng: "So you can steal my honey, you mean! You think I will fall for that old trick?"
Text: "내 꿀을 훔치려는 수작이지! 그런 오래된 속임수에 넘어갈 줄 알아?"

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Failure]</Start> "You can threaten me all you want, but I will not be falling for your foolishness!"
Text: <StartCheck>[실패]</Start> "아무리 협박해도 소용없어. 그런 헛소리에 넘어가지 않겠다고!"

TextEng: "I shall not be destroyed by the likes of you!"
Text: "나 같은 사람을 해치울 수는 없을 거다!"

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Success]</Start> "If you think that's for the best, I guess I'll have to trust you. The one on the far left is new. I will speak to the bees and ask them not to harm you."
Text: <StartCheck>[성공]</Start> "그게 최선이라고 한다면, 당신을 믿어야겠지. 맨 왼쪽이 새 벌통이야. 벌들에게 말해서 해치지 않게 하겠어."

TextEng: "Wait! I remember now. There was some kind of voice. I was supposed to welcome you, make you feel comfortable. Right. Well... Welcome! Make yourself comfortable..."
Text: "잠깐! 이제 기억났다. 무슨 목소리가 있었어. 당신을 환영하고 편안하게 해 주라고 했지. 그래. 자... 환영한다! 편하게 지내게..."

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Success]</Start> "Oh dear, my poor bees! You must save them. The one on the far left is new. I will speak to the bees and ask them not to harm you."
Text: <StartCheck>[성공]</Start> "세상에, 내 불쌍한 벌들! 구해 줘야 해. 맨 왼쪽이 새 벌통이야. 벌들에게 말해서 해치지 않게 하겠어."

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Failure]</Start> "You are a sneaky one, but I will not be falling for your foolishness!"
Text: <StartCheck>[실패]</Start> "교활한 녀석이군, 하지만 그런 헛소리에 넘어가지 않겠어!"

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Success]</Start> "If you think that's for the best, I guess I'll have to trust you. The one on the far left is new. I will speak to the bees and ask them not to harm you."
Text: <StartCheck>[성공]</Start> "그게 최선이라고 한다면, 당신을 믿어야겠지. 맨 왼쪽이 새 벌통이야. 벌들에게 말해서 해치지 않게 하겠어."

TextEng: "That's impossible... or is it? I was in such a hurry... I don't know if I searched the crate very carefully. No... you are just trying to trick me so you can steal more honey!"
Text: "그건 불가능... 아닌가? 너무 서두르다 보니... 상자를 제대로 뒤졌는지 모르겠어. 아냐... 속이려는 거지. 꿀 훔치려는 속임수야!"

TextEng: "It is one of the ones on the end. On the left side, I am pretty sure. But you stay away from my honey! My bees will sting you if you touch their hives!"
Text: "끝에 있는 벌통 중 하나야. 왼쪽이라고 꽤 확신해. 하지만 내 꿀에 손대지 마! 벌통에 손대면 벌들이 쏠 거야!"

TextEng: "Good hermit, look at me. Look past the scars and you will see my nature."
Text: "착한 은둔자님, 저를 보세요. 흉터 너머를 보시면 저의 본성을 알 수 있을 거예요."

TextEng: "Mighty lady... you are a nymph! But what are you doing in this land? Are you here to establish a sacred grove?"
Text: "위대한 님프시여... 당신은 님프! 하지만 이 땅에서 뭘 하시는 겁니까? 신성한 숲을 세우러 오셨습니까?"

TextEng: "Nay, good hermit. My journey with <FirstName> is not of that nature. You must listen to what I say. Something is poisoning your honey and causing your mind to be weakened. We will help you."
Text: "아닙니다, 착한 은둔자님. <이름>과의 여정은 그런 것이 아닙니다. 제 말을 들어 주세요. 무언가가 당신의 꿀을 오염시켜 정신에 이상을 일으키고 있어요."

TextEng: "This is true? But a creature such as yourself would have no reason to lie to a druid. It must be so."
Text: "정말입니까? 하지만 당신 같은 존재가 드루이드에게 거짓말할 이유는 없겠지. 분명 사실일 거야."

TextEng: "I recently added a new hive. The one on the far left is new. I will speak to the bees and ask them not to harm you."
Text: "최근에 벌통을 새로 하나 추가했어. 맨 왼쪽이 새 벌통이야. 벌들에게 말해서 해치지 않게 하겠어."

TextEng: "The voice? Oh, yes, the voice. I was supposed to welcome you, make you feel comfortable. Right. Well... Welcome! Make yourself comfortable..."
Text: "목소리? 아, 맞다, 목소리. 당신을 환영하고 편안하게 해 주라고 했었지. 그래. 자... 환영한다! 편하게 지내게..."

TextEng: "Please do. Let us go quickly, <FirstName>. Who knows how long this poor man's mind will be with us. Let's discover what poisons the sweet honey."
Text: "그래 주세요. 어서 가요, <이름>. 이 불쌍한 사람의 정신이 얼마나 더 버틸지 모르니까요. 달콤한 꿀에 무엇이 독을 풀었는지 알아봐요."

TextEng: "Did I? What a strange thing. I am sure I must have had a reason... can't think of one though."
Text: "그랬어? 이상한 일이네. 분명 이유가 있었을 텐데... 생각이 안 나."

TextEng: Kaidala closes her eyes. "There is something unnatural in that drink. I'm not sure what, but I suspect that's where the hermit's problems stem from."
