Text: 카이달라가 눈을 감습니다. "저 음료에 뭔가 부자연스러운 게 있어요. 뭔지는 확실하지 않지만, 은둔자의 문제가 거기서 비롯된 것 같아요."

TextEng: Trip sniffs near the glass of mead. "Ick! Something more than just honey in this drink, Trip is certain. Don't be drinking the stuff."
Text: 트립이 꿀 술잔 가까이에서 킁킁거립니다. "윽! 이 술에 꿀 말고 다른 뭔가가 있어, 트립이 확실해. 이거 마시지 마."

TextEng: "Did you find anything?"
Text: "뭔가 찾았나?"

TextEng: "I'm not going to be able to keep the bees off of you for long, so hurry up."
Text: "벌들을 오래 막아 둘 수 없으니 서둘러."

TextEng: "You did? I wonder what it was doing in an old crate in the forest? I guess it doesn't matter now."
Text: "찾았어? 숲속 낡은 상자에 그게 왜 있었을까? 뭐 이제 상관없지."

TextEng: "That... that looks like the blade of an assassin. I wonder what it is doing in an old crate in the forest? I guess it doesn't matter now. You can keep the blade. I'm sure it is worth quite a bit."
Text: "그건... 암살자의 칼날 같군. 숲속 낡은 상자에 그게 왜 있었을까? 뭐 이제 상관없지. 가져가게."

TextEng: "Here is some honey, from one of the good hives. But I grow more tired by the hour so, forgive me, but I must bid you goodbye."
Text: "여기 꿀이 있어, 좋은 벌통에서 나온 거야. 하지만 점점 더 피곤해지니, 미안하지만 이만 작별이야."

TextEng: "That nice, young girl from the keep came and helped me. You wouldn't believe it, but she found a poisoned blade in my beehive. I think I am getting better now. Thank you for all your help."
Text: "성채의 착한 아가씨가 와서 도와줬어. 믿기 힘들겠지만, 벌통에서 독 묻은 칼날을 찾았다더군. 이제 좀 나아지는 것 같아."

TextEng: "Oh, it's so hard to get comfortable these days. I need to go to the keep and sell some honey... but I just can't go near people right now. Even just having you here... it scares me."
Text: "아, 요즘은 편해지기가 너무 힘들어. 성채에 가서 꿀을 팔아야 하는데... 사람 가까이에 갈 수가 없어. 낯선 사람을 생각만 해도 겁이 나서 어찌해야 할지..."

TextEng: "Take this jar of honey. It is the least I can do for all of the trouble you went to. Goodbye."
Text: "꿀 한 항아리 가져가게. 네가 애써 준 것에 대한 최소한의 보답이야. 안녕."

TextEng: "Thank you so much for all your help. I am starting to recover my mind and I think I might make a visit to the keep to sell my honey soon."
Text: "도와줘서 정말 고마워. 정신이 돌아오기 시작했어. 곧 성채에 가서 꿀을 팔러 갈 수 있을 것 같아."

TextEng: "Thank you. You too."
Text: "고맙네. 당신도."

TextEng: "Did you now? And who might be so bold as to steal from me?"
Text: "그래? 누가 감히 나한테 도둑질을 해?"

TextEng: "I would rather not have my honey stolen any more. I guess I could pay you something for the information. How does two hundred gold sound?"
Text: "꿀을 더 이상 도둑맞고 싶지 않으니. 정보 값으로 뭔가 줄 수 있겠지. 금 200닢이면 어떻겠나?"

TextEng: "How much do you think I make from selling honey? You can have two hundred gold, or you can keep the information to yourself. Your choice."
Text: "꿀 팔아서 얼마나 번다고 생각하나? 금 200닢이든 정보를 가지고 있든, 네 선택이야."

TextEng: "Kobolds? That's not so good. Honey is definitely something you want to share with kobolds. It affects their minds in strange ways."
Text: "코볼트? 그건 좋지 않군. 꿀은 코볼트와 나눠야 할 것이 확실히 아니야. 그들의 정신에 이상한 영향을 미치거든."

TextEng: "I guess that's one way of solving the problem. Too bad though, I would have liked to study them and possibly help them."
Text: "문제를 해결하는 한 가지 방법이겠지. 아쉽지만, 연구하고 어쩌면 도울 수도 있었을 텐데."

TextEng: "Here is two hundred gold for your trouble. I am glad you came back to tell me."
Text: "수고비로 금 200닢이야. 돌아와서 알려 줘서 기쁘군."

TextEng: "That is troubling. Still, I should be able to study them and perhaps even help them. I am glad you told me about this."
Text: "걱정되는군. 그래도 연구해서 어쩌면 도울 수 있을 거야. 알려 줘서 고맙네."

TextEng: "Yes, of course. Don't steal any honey on your way out either!"
Text: "그래, 물론. 나갈 때 꿀 훔치지 말고!"

TextEng: "Here is two hundred gold for the information. And why don't you take this old club I used to like. I have better weapons now, but maybe you can find a use for it."
Text: "정보 값으로 금 200닢이야. 그리고 내가 쓰던 곤봉도 가져가게. 이제 더 좋은 무기가 있지만, 네게는 쓸모가 있을지도 몰라."

TextEng: "Not at all. It does quite the opposite. It makes them relax and experience strange dreams. An entire kobold tribe on honey is completely defenseless."
Text: "전혀 그렇지 않아. 오히려 정반대야. 긴장을 풀고 기묘한 꿈을 꾸게 하지. 꿀에 취한 코볼트 부족은 완전히 무방비 상태가 된다고."

TextEng: "Did you? Well, well, well... three holes in the ground."
Text: "그래? 이거, 이거, 이거... 땅에 구멍 세 개."

TextEng: "Sorry, an old joke. Deep thoughts for a shallow mind. That sort of thing. So, who is the assassin?"
Text: "미안, 오래된 농담이야. 얕은 머리에 깊은 생각, 뭐 그런 거지. 그래서, 암살자가 누구지?"

TextEng: "Like a big child that taunts another child with candy, you bring information and say 'I know something you don't know'."
Text: "아이가 다른 아이에게 사탕으로 놀리듯, 정보를 가지고 와서 '나는 아는데 너는 모르지'라고 하는 거로군."

TextEng: "But since I do not care one way or the other, my feelings are not hurt. Any more waves you would like to crash against my beach?"
Text: "하지만 나는 이쪽이든 저쪽이든 신경 쓰지 않으니, 기분이 상하지는 않는다. 내 해변에 더 부딪힐 파도가 있나?"

TextEng: He rolls his eyes and whistles like a bird. "I make as much sense as sunshine on a rainy day. One does not necessarily disclude the other."
Text: 그가 눈을 굴리며 새처럼 휘파람을 붑니다. "비 오는 날의 햇살만큼이나 내가 이치에 맞겠지. 하나라고 다른 하나를 빼지는 않는 법이야."

TextEng: "Worth? Like the hour to the hand of a clock, it is information, but not something that the clock cares about."
Text: "가치? 시계 바늘에게 시간이란 정보이지만, 시계가 신경 쓸 바는 아닌 것처럼."

TextEng: "You can tell me the information, and I'll appreciate it, but I don't care enough to pay you for it."
Text: "정보를 알려 주면 고맙게 여기겠지만, 돈을 줄 만큼 신경 쓰지는 않아."

TextEng: "Garrot? I've met him. Interesting fellow. Didn't realize he was an assassin, but it does explain why he's so nervous. Twitchy fellow."
Text: "개로? 만난 적 있어. 흥미로운 친구였지. 암살자인 줄은 몰랐는데, 그렇게 신경질적인 게 설명이 되는군. 안절부절못하는 녀석이었어."

TextEng: "Having to deal with people makes me terrified. To think of actually going back into the keep... it is too much for me. I do not know how I will ever manage to sell my honey."
Text: "사람을 상대하는 게 무서워 죽겠어. 성채로 다시 돌아갈 생각을 하면... 나한테는 너무 벅차. 어떻게 꿀을 팔 수 있을지 모르겠어."

TextEng: "Might have to go have a talk with him about leaving poisons where others can get at them. Thank you for the information. Is there anything else?"
Text: "독을 아무 데나 놓아두지 말라고 한마디 해야겠군. 정보 고맙네. 다른 할 말이 있나?"

TextEng: "As you were so kind and helpful to me, I should return the favor."
Text: "네가 나에게 친절하고 도움이 됐으니, 나도 보답해야겠지."

TextEng: An odd, wild-eyed man, with bees swarming around his body, looks at you warily. "You're here to steal my honey, aren't you? That's it... aye, must be! Wait... no, the voice. It said <he/she> would come."
Text: 벌이 온몸에 몰려든 기이한 야생의 눈을 가진 남자가 경계하며 당신을 바라봅니다. "내 꿀을 훔치러 왔지? 그렇지... 맞아, 틀림없어!"

TextEng: "A voice in my head... never a good sign. It said... it said... wait, who are you? If you come to steal my honey, you're in for some serious trouble. Or did the voice send you?"
Text: "머릿속의 목소리라... 좋은 징조는 아니지. 그 목소리가 말하길... 말하길... 잠깐, 당신 누구야? 내 꿀을 훔치러 왔으면 단단히 각오해. 내 벌들이 제대로 쏠 거야!"

TextEng: "It told me that a <man/woman> would be coming here and I should make them feel welcome."
Text: "어떤 사람이 올 거니 환영해 주라고 하더군."

TextEng: "It's mine! I found the bees, I fed the bees, I take care of the bees, I gather the honey combs, and I bottle the honey; so you can't have any!" The hermit pauses, breathing rather hard.
Text: "내 거야! 벌을 찾은 것도 나, 먹인 것도 나, 돌본 것도 나, 벌집을 모은 것도 나, 꿀을 병에 담은 것도 나야. 그러니까 못 줘!" 은둔자가 으르렁거립니다.

TextEng: "Unless you plan on buying some. If you came as a customer... then I am sorry for my rant. Are you sure the voice didn't send you?"
Text: "살 거라면 모를까. 손님으로 왔다면... 아까 한 말은 미안하네. 정말 목소리가 보내서 온 건 아니고?"

TextEng: "Oh... well then. That is the name the voice gave me. My apologies. It's just that someone has been bothering my bees and stealing my honey. I've grown a touch suspicious of strangers."
Text: "아... 그렇다면. 목소리가 알려 준 이름이야. 미안하게 됐네. 누군가 내 벌을 괴롭히고 꿀을 훔치고 있어서 신경이 곤두서 있었거든."

TextEng: "But that is none of your trouble. Please, come into my home and I could make you some tea with honey, or you can have some wonderful honey mead."
Text: "하지만 그건 당신 걱정이 아니지. 자, 집으로 들어와서 꿀 넣은 차라도 한잔 하든가, 맛있는 꿀 술을 마시든가."

TextEng: "Oh, yes... the voice did say something about that. Big work, important work, the stuff of Destinies even."
Text: "아, 맞아... 목소리가 그런 말도 했지. 큰 일, 중요한 일, 운명적인 일이라고."

TextEng: "That would be... better. If I had one person I could trust to deal honestly with me. Would you find someone like that for me?"
Text: "그러면... 좋겠다. 나를 대신해서 정직하게 거래할 사람 한 명만 있으면. 그런 사람을 찾아 줄 수 있겠나?"

TextEng: "I just... I hate people... can't trust them... they steal my honey. I... I need to go inside."
Text: "난 그냥... 사람이 싫어... 믿을 수 없어... 내 꿀을 훔치잖아. 나... 안으로 들어가야겠어."

TextEng: "No... well, maybe over a pint of mead. Come, shall we go inside?"
Text: "아냐... 아니, 꿀 술 한잔 하면서라면 모를까. 자, 안으로 들어갈까?"

TextEng: "Excellent. I haven't had a visitor in a long while. Follow me please."
Text: "좋아. 오랫동안 손님이 없었거든. 따라와."

TextEng: "There is something wrong with this poor man, <FirstName>. If you could convince him to calm down, I might be able to help him."
Text: "이 불쌍한 사람에게 무슨 문제가 있어요, <이름>. 진정시킬 수 있으면 제가 도울 수 있을 거예요."

TextEng: "I think this one hears the voices too. Don't trust him, but have pity on his poor soul. The voices are cruel and vicious."
Text: "이 사람도 목소리가 들리나 봐. 믿지는 마, 하지만 그 불쌍한 영혼을 불쌍히 여겨. 목소리들은 잔인하고 악독하거든."

TextEng: "Then why don't you just leave me alone? I bet you don't have time for anything with all the honey you've been stealing from me!"
Text: "그럼 왜 날 그냥 놔두지 않는 거야? 훔친 꿀 때문에 다른 일 할 시간도 없겠지!"

TextEng: "I... I guess that makes sense. Here is 100 gold. That should motivate you to find me an assistant."
Text: "그... 그건 그렇구나. 여기 금 100닢. 조수를 찾는 데 도움이 되겠지."

TextEng: "I have business to attend to on behalf of the keep."
Text: "성채를 대신해서 할 일이 있어서 왔어."

TextEng: "I don't have time for that."
Text: "그럴 시간이 없어."

TextEng: "I'll need a finder's fee first though."
Text: "먼저 소개비를 받아야겠는데."

TextEng: "I will sell it for you."
Text: "내가 대신 팔아 줄게."

TextEng: "I will find someone."
Text: "누군가를 찾아볼게."

TextEng: <StartAction>[Insight]</Start> "Have another drink of honey mead."
Text: <StartAction>[통찰]</Start> "꿀 술 한 잔 더 마셔 봐."

TextEng: "There is something wrong with your drink."
Text: "그 음료에 문제가 있어."

TextEng: "This isn't worth the bother."
Text: "이건 수고할 가치도 없군."

TextEng: "I'll be leaving now."
Text: "이만 갈게."

TextEng: "I'll need you to control your bees so that I can look at the new hive."
Text: "새 벌통을 볼 수 있게 벌을 좀 막아 줘."

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Intimidate]</Start> "Call your bees off, or I end your life!"
Text: <StartCheck>[위협]</Start> "벌을 물러나게 해, 안 그러면 죽여 버린다!"

TextEng: "Then you must die!"
Text: "그럼 죽어야지!"

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Bluff]</Start> "Whatever is poisoning you could be killing your bees."
Text: <StartCheck>[허세]</Start> "독이 네 벌들까지 죽이고 있을 수도 있어."

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Persuade]</Start> "I just need to check the one hive."
Text: <StartCheck>[설득]</Start> "벌통 하나만 확인하면 돼."

TextEng: "I'll bet that the problem is with the new hive."
Text: "문제는 새 벌통에 있을 거라고 장담해."

TextEng: "Which is the new hive?"
Text: "새 벌통이 어느 거야?"

TextEng: "We just met outside. You invited me in."
Text: "방금 밖에서 만났잖아. 안으로 들어오라고 했잖아."

TextEng: <StartAction>[Lie]</Start> "The voice sent me, remember?"
Text: <StartAction>[거짓말]</Start> "목소리가 보냈어, 기억나지?"

TextEng: "Not yet."
Text: "아직이야."

TextEng: "I found a poisoned dagger, but I have given it away."
Text: "독 묻은 단검을 찾았는데, 이미 줘 버렸어."

TextEng: "I found this dagger."
Text: "이 단검을 찾았어."

TextEng: "Good luck."
Text: "행운을 빌어."

TextEng: "I found your honey thieves."
Text: "꿀 도둑을 찾았어."

TextEng: "How much is the information worth to you?"
Text: "그 정보가 얼마나 가치 있지?"

TextEng: "Not enough."
Text: "그걸로는 부족해."

TextEng: "I'm not telling you."
Text: "말해 줄 생각 없어."

TextEng: "There's a group of kobolds who really like it."
Text: "꿀을 아주 좋아하는 코볼트 무리가 있더라."

TextEng: "They are all dead."
Text: "다 죽여 버렸어."

TextEng: "I gave them some honey."
Text: "꿀을 좀 줬어."

TextEng: "Goodbye."
Text: "안녕."

TextEng: "Does it make them dangerous?"
Text: "꿀이 그들을 위험하게 만들어?"

TextEng: "I found the owner of that poisoned blade."
Text: "독 묻은 칼의 주인을 찾았어."

TextEng: "Have you been into the bad honey again?"
Text: "또 나쁜 꿀을 마셨나?"

TextEng: "What?"
Text: "뭐라고?"

TextEng: "I'm not telling you."
Text: "안 알려 줄 거야."

TextEng: "You don't make a lot more sense when you aren't poisoned."
Text: "독에 안 당했을 때도 별로 말이 되지 않는걸."

TextEng: "How much is the information worth to you?"
Text: "그 정보가 얼마나 가치 있지?"

TextEng: "What does that mean?"
Text: "그게 무슨 뜻이야?"

TextEng: "An innkeep named Garrot was once an assassin."
Text: "개로라는 여관 주인이 한때 암살자였어."

TextEng: "Would you be able to heal me?"
Text: "치료해 줄 수 있겠어?"

TextEng: "What did the voice tell you?"
Text: "목소리가 뭐라고 했어?"

TextEng: "Honey?"
"My name is <FullName>."
Text: "내 이름은 <전체이름>이야."

TextEng: <StartAction>[Lie]</Start> "I am <FirstName>. The voice sent me."
Text: <StartAction>[거짓말]</Start> "나는 <이름>이야. 목소리가 보냈어."

TextEng: "What scares you?"
Text: "뭐가 무서운 거야?"

TextEng: "I haven't time. I have work to do on behalf of the keep."
Text: "시간이 없어. 성채를 위한 일이 있거든."

TextEng: "Tell me your troubles."
Text: "무슨 고민이야?"

TextEng: "Thank you. I would appreciate that."
Text: "고맙네. 감사히 받겠어."

TextEng: "Would you like to have someone sell your honey for you?"
Text: "누가 꿀을 대신 팔아 주면 좋겠어?"

TextEng: The ox ignores you and continues to eat its grass.
Text: 황소는 당신을 무시하고 계속 풀을 뜯습니다.

TextEng: The ox looks at you with a frustrated glance, then goes back to ignoring you, wondering why you didn't get the point the first time.
Text: 황소는 짜증 섞인 눈초리로 당신을 바라보더니, 처음부터 무시한 뜻을 왜 모르느냐는 듯 다시 딴 곳을 봅니다.

TextEng: "Hello, ox."
Text: "안녕, 황소."

TextEng: The Spirit ignores you completely.
Text: 영혼은 당신을 완전히 무시합니다.

TextEng: This spirit eyes Kaidala with a ravenous hunger. "It is not for you I wait."
Text: 이 영혼은 탐욕스러운 굶주림으로 카이달라를 바라본다. "내가 기다리는 것은 네가 아니다."

TextEng: "I hunger. She is the source. That is the way it is. There need be no other explanation."
Text: "배가 고프다. 그녀가 근원이다. 원래 그런 것이다. 다른 설명은 필요 없다."

TextEng: "Blackest Death does not answer to you. I hunger, so leave me be."
Text: "칠흑의 죽음은 너에게 대답하지 않는다. 배가 고프니 날 내버려 둬라."

TextEng: The ghostly creature's eyes flicker with annoyance. "I will feed on this soul, once it is released."
Text: 유령 같은 존재의 눈이 짜증스럽게 깜박입니다. "이 영혼이 풀려나면 내가 잡아먹겠다."

TextEng: "Release this soul to me that I might drag it down to the darkest pits and tear at it and feed on its pain and despair."
Text: "이 영혼을 내게 풀어 달라. 가장 어두운 구덩이로 끌고 가서 갈기갈기 찢고, 고통과 절망을 먹어 치우겠다."

TextEng: The spirit hisses in strange fits and you realize it is laughing at you. "Beyond your touch is Blackest Death. Beneath my notice are you! Begone, I shall answer no more questions."
Text: 영혼이 기묘하게 쉬쉬 소리를 내는데, 당신을 비웃고 있다는 것을 깨닫습니다. "칠흑의 죽음은 네 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 있다. 내 발아래가 네 자리니라."

TextEng: "Her soul weeps and longs for death. For her, there is no release. There is no release for those who seek to end their lives before their time is done. We harvest such souls and reap their pain."
Text: "그녀의 영혼은 울며 죽음을 갈망한다. 그녀에게 해방은 없다. 스스로 목숨을 끊으려 한 자에게는 해방이 없느니라."

TextEng: "Goodbye."
Text: "안녕."

TextEng: "Why can you not leave her alone?"
Text: "왜 그녀를 가만히 내버려 두지 못하는 거지?"

TextEng: "Why Kaidala?"
Text: "왜 카이달라인 거냐?"

TextEng: "I shall destroy you!"
Text: "널 처치해 주마!"

TextEng: "What are you waiting for then?"
Text: "그럼 뭘 기다리는 거냐?"

TextEng: "What are you?"
Text: "넌 뭐냐?"

TextEng: "Who are you?"
Text: "넌 누구냐?"

TextEng: "What do you hunger for?"
Text: "무엇에 굶주린 거냐?"

TextEng: "I shall destroy you first!"
Text: "먼저 널 처치해 주마!"

TextEng: The stag arches its neck and gazes at you with a quiet nobility.
Text: 수사슴이 목을 쭉 세우고 조용한 위엄으로 당신을 바라봅니다.

TextEng: The stag drops its head in a bow and sniffs the air to catch your scent.
Text: 수사슴이 고개를 숙여 인사하더니 당신의 냄새를 맡으려 공기를 킁킁거립니다.

TextEng: The stag bows its head again and seems to be at peace with the world.
Text: 수사슴이 다시 고개를 숙이며 세상과 평화로운 듯합니다.

TextEng: The stag looks around the grove and hopes that someday someone will come and preserve this little spot of nature from the depredations of the human settlement.
Text: 수사슴이 주변 숲을 둘러보며, 언젠가 누군가가 이 작은 자연을 주변의 악으로부터 지켜 주기를 바라는 것 같습니다.

TextEng: It reflects back on a long life, filled with both danger and happiness. Overall, it is content with the lot it has been given.
Text: 위험과 행복이 가득했던 긴 삶을 돌아봅니다. 전반적으로 자신에게 주어진 삶에 만족하고 있습니다.

TextEng: The stag shows you images of koblolds hunting it and other animals to catch food for the monsterous army.
Text: 수사슴이 코볼트들이 괴물 군대의 식량을 마련하려고 자기와 다른 동물들을 사냥하는 모습을 보여 줍니다.

TextEng: Then it shows you images of goblins searching for other creatures to join with the monsterous army.
Text: 그 다음엔 고블린들이 괴물 군대에 합류할 다른 생물들을 찾아다니는 모습을 보여 줍니다.

TextEng: Finally it shows tries to impart the sense it has of something very evil and intelligent controling all of the monsters in the area.
Text: 마지막으로, 모든 몬스터를 조종하는 매우 사악하고 영리한 무언가가 있다는 느낌을 전하려 합니다.

TextEng: The stage is unsure, but it has a premonition that the creature you are looking for is somehow connected to you. That is all it knows.
Text: 수사슴도 확신하지 못하지만, 당신이 찾는 그 존재가 어떻게든 당신과 연결되어 있다는 예감이 있습니다. 그것이 그가 느끼는 전부입니다.

TextEng: "Hello, stag."
Text: "안녕, 수사슴."

TextEng: "Happy grazing. Goodbye."
Text: "즐거운 풀 뜯기를. 안녕."

TextEng: "Is there anything I can do for you?"
Text: "내가 도울 일이 있니?"

TextEng: "How is life treating you?"
Text: "살아가는 건 어떠니?"

TextEng: "Have you seen any monsters?"
Text: "몬스터를 본 적 있니?"

TextEng: What is this creature that leads the army?
Text: 군대를 이끄는 그 존재가 뭐지?

TextEng: This is a patch of rich earth.
Text: 비옥한 흙이 있습니다.

TextEng: A tree begins to sprout.
Text: 나무가 싹을 틔우기 시작합니다.

TextEng: Leave the patch of earth alone.
Text: 흙을 그냥 둡니다.

TextEng: Plant Kaidala's acorn.
Text: 카이달라의 도토리를 심습니다.

TextEng: "I have been told to take you to the caves where the miners have cleared a tunnel to the enemy's army. Are you ready to go?" Alias gives you a grin as she bows ever so slightly.
"I will just wait here then."
"I won't move a muscle, unless I need to hide from a wandering monster or something."
"Though it hardly seems worth our effort to bother with such base creatures, I suppose it would go well towards furthering our popularity."
"I would free the land of these creatures, even if it is to help a farmer. Goblins are a foul abomination and horridly ugly... not that I am one to speak."
"Goblins? Even Trip can kill nasty, ugly goblins! We will sneak up on them and tear out their throats, we will!"
"Goblins! Time to crush some skulls, <FirstName>! We shall revel in their destruction and win the hearts of these people, you and I!"
"She's a very powerful woman in these parts. I'm certain if you deal with the goblins on her land and bring her back proof of the deed, you'd win her vote for the election, easy!"

"Goblins tribes tend to rely pretty heavily on their Chief. If you can kill the Chief, the tribe usually scatters and gets absorbed into other neighboring tribes. It may sound grisly but the head of the Goblin Chief would probably be all the evidence you need."
"She really appreciates how you dealt with those goblins on her property. You're guaranteed her vote, that's for sure!"
"You want to know about me? I'm not really that exciting, I'm afraid. My Aunt Serah is a guildmaster, which is as close to fame as I get. What did you want to know about me?"
"That would be good. What would you like to know?"
She blushes lightly. "It is more of a childhood nickname. I was always pretending to be a spy and I would tell people 'That's not my name. My alias is...' and then I would use a word I liked."
"Are you ready to return to the keep, <FirstName>? I can bring you back here again, if you wish."
"Alias Nefarious, alias Rogue, alias Insidious... all of the largest or most colorful words I could find. People gave up trying to remember them and just decided to call me Alias."
She hesitates. "I really don't like it. I much prefer Alias, please."
<StartCheck>[Success]</Start> She looks down at her feet, scuffing the dirt, then mumbles, 'Bertha Blackhand'."
She flushes red and glares at you. "I'll thank you not to repeat that. Now let's not talk about me anymore."
"Thank you. Even my father called me Alias."
"You are a liar, but thank you. I won't answer to it though, so don't even try. I am Alias... even my father called me that."
"I was just born to it, I think. Even when I was only ten and my father was still around, I would wander outside the keep by myself."
"I would get in a lot of trouble for doing that, so I learned how not to get caught. That skill has saved my life many times over the years."
"Once I reached an age where people started taking me seriously, I spoke to the Banner and he allowed me to prove myself and join the guard."
"Yes, yes, staying hidden, a very important skill it is."
"Good. Follow me."
"You know, you kind of scared me at first, but now I think you're kind of cute."
"Cute? Trip is not cute! You should not say such things. Trip is fearsome! Trip is terrifying... or was that terrified? Terrific? Oh, now Trip is confused."
"Well, I think you're cute."
<StartAction>[Mutter]</Start> "Stupid humans!"
"I grew up here in the keep. My father was a soldier in Lord Kendrick's army, and I guess he must have died when they went to war."
"My mother died when I was young. She caught a cold one winter and started coughing very hard. She coughed up blood for a long time and then one morning the house was silent."
"My Aunt Serah, guildmaster for the landowners, took me in and raised me. She was always kind, but firm and hard working."
"I... I am sorry. I guess I don't really know anything about you. My father was a kind and loving man. A lot of families lost children or spouses."
"I am used to it, thank you very much! I am not complaining, just explaining. My biggest wish is that I could know what really happened to my father."
"Really? Maybe that is why I feel such a bond with you. I have felt like I could trust you from the moment you arrived."
Alias is a cute, young woman with a perpetual smirk and a twinkle in her eye.
"I just wish I knew what happened to my father. He and the other soldiers went riding off to war, but never showed up for the battle. No one has seen or heard a trace of them."
"Thank you. I just wish I knew what happened to my father. He must be dead, but how or when or where... nobody knows. A lot of families lost children or spouses."
"Nobody ever found out where they went. They went riding off to war, but never showed up for the battle. No one has seen or heard a trace of them."
"But enough about the dead. My Aunt Serah really took good care of me, when I was young. Now I am a scout for the keep. The pay is alright, and at least the work isn't monotonous."
"There must have been some powerful magic involved in making an entire army disappear! It is unnatural."
"Armies don't just disappear! This sounds like some sort of foul magic. We need to be wary."
"Trip knew a halfling once who could make a pig disappear! But it was only a trick. Nothing but powerful magic could make an army disappear."
"There is something familiar about this tale, like a legend I once read... but I cannot place it. We should keep our eyes and ears open for some kind of magic around the keep... something old."
"That reminds me. You should go and speak to The Stan, at the Trades office. He needs somebody to help an archeologist who was studying the magic of the keep."
"Who knows how this could help you? The magic might give you the power to stop the invaders. Then people would have to vote for you, wouldn't they?"
"Good day. When I was told to help you, I quickly sketched a map of the keep. There you go."
"The ruins he was investigating seem to be protected by undead. He needs someone to help him get past them."
"Oh, <FirstName>, I have a message for you. A very... strange message." Alias' face is paler that you remember and her lips are pursed in a look of bewildered concern.
"I'm sorry, <FirstName>! I hadn't heard that you won, but congratulations! I wonder if that is linked to the message... I guess it must be."
"It was Momma Dane. One minute I was chatting with her, and then all of a sudden she began to laugh maniacally."
"She leaned over and said, 'Tell my grandchild that the throne is not secure until the illithid is dead.' I asked her who she meant but she just winked and pointed towards the castle."
"Then she suddenly stood up straight and her body changed. She grew young and beautiful and she had wings. As she flew away, she cried, 'Tell <FirstName> to look for me when the battle is won!"
"Oh, I didn't think you would have a clue of what I was talking about. I'm impressed."
"I know, it must seem strange. As she floated away, I heard her laugh and say 'Oh, <FirstName>, you are everything I hoped for, and then some.'"
"As she floated away, I heard her laugh and say 'Oh, <FirstName>, you are everything I hoped for, and then some.'"
"Be careful, <FirstName>, Momma Dane wanted you to become the <Lord/Lady> of the Keep. She must have something planned."
"I also know my way around the countryside and some of the caves, as I am one of the local scouts. I am proud to be working with a hero such as yourself."
"I will remain here, in case you need me to take you anywhere else. Congratulations... my <lord/lady>. I always had faith in you!"
"There was always something unnatural about that woman, yet it seemed ridiculous to mention it at the time. Now I wish I had."
"This woman had wings, but whether she is a creature of good or evil, Trip is unsure."
"All I ever sensed was a strong desire to see you on the throne of the keep, <FirstName>. I have no idea if she had plans beyond that."
"That has a strangely ominous ring to it."
"I am glad I caught up to you, <FirstName>. I was just speaking to my Aunt Serah, and she said that some of the guildmasters are trying to push for a quick election."
"If the election is held right now, you would lose. She wants you to know that she is willing to help you, but only if you help her."
<StartAction>[Sigh]</Start> "You know, it isn't a weakness to admit that you need help. When an opportunity presents itself, you should grab a hold of it."
"I do not mean to pester you. I just thought it would be to your advantage to have some help."
"Let us hope later will not be too late. I will be at the fountain, if you need me."
"I will do all I can to help you attain Lordship of the Keep. My first suggestion is that you visit the guildmasters. Do you have questions for me?"
"All nature's creatures must come to rely on others, even if all they do is use them for their own purposes. We should do this job and gain this Serah's favor."
""Even Trip is not afraid of goblins, <FirstName>! Unless there are many goblins... or even more than a few goblins... come to think of it, maybe it is better if we just avoid any danger at all."
"The lass makes sense, <FirstName>. Are you afraid of some wee goblins?"
"We will need this Serah's help if we are to win this election, <FirstName>. Make no mistake about it!"
"My Aunt Serah could postpone the election, but you haven't cleared the goblin caves for her yet. Would you like to do so now?"
"My Aunt Serah could postpone the election, but she needs you to do a job for her first."
"There is a cave on her property that some goblins moved into. Unfortunately the military has been weak since Lord Keldrik left with most of our army."
"If you were to get rid of the goblins for her, I'm sure Aunt Serah would support your cause. I can even lead you to the caves myself."
"Though it hardly seems worth our effort to bother with such base creatures, I suppose it would go well towards furthering our popularity."
"I would free the land of these creatures, even if it is to help a farmer. Goblins are a foul abomination and horridly ugly... not that I am one to speak."
"Good luck. Come speak to me if you would like a guide to take you outside the city. I will stay by the fountain in the market square until you need me."
"Goblins? Even Trip can kill nasty, ugly goblins! We will sneak up on them and tear out their throats, we will!"
"Goblins! Time to crush some skulls, <FirstName>! We shall revel in their destruction and win the hearts of these people, you and I!"
"You have cleared the goblin caves, or so I have heard, but you have not reported the job finished to my Aunt. I will take you to her so that you can tell her and she can postpone the vote for you."
"There is a cave on Aunt Serah's property that some goblins moved into. Unfortunately the military has been weak since Lord Keldrik left with most of our army."
"If you were to get rid of the goblins for her, I'm sure Aunt Serah would support your cause. I can even lead you to the caves myself."
"Great! Follow me and try to keep up!"
"Though it hardly seems worth our effort to bother with such base creatures, I suppose it would go well towards furthering our popularity."
"I would free the land of these creatures, even if it is to help a farmer. Goblins are a foul abomination and horridly ugly... not that I am one to speak."
"Goblins? Even Trip can kill nasty, ugly goblins! We will sneak up on them and tear out their throats, we will!"
"Goblins! Time to crush some skulls, <FirstName>! We shall revel in their destruction and win the hearts of these people, you and I!"
"Wait! I haven't told you about my Aunt Serah yet. Would you like me to tell you about a quick, easy way to make some gold, gain a vote and earn yourself more time for the election?"
"I have important news, <FirstName>. The guildmasters are pushing for a vote. They wish to get the election over with." A sheen of sweat marks Alias' face and she seems grateful to have found you.
"Excellent! I am so nervous... I hope it goes well for you. Follow me."
"I will tell her. Oh... I am so anxious to see you become the <lord/lady>, I can hardly wait. It's like the eve before the summer solstice fair. Well, I'll head back to the fountain now."
"I am sorry, but she can no longer postpone the election. She is sure you will win anyway. Follow me."
"My Aunt Serah could postpone the election, but you haven't cleared the goblin caves for her yet. Would you like to do so now?"
"My Aunt Serah could postpone the election, but she needs you to do a job for her first."
"There is a cave on her property that some goblins moved into. Unfortunately the military has been weak since Lord Keldrik left with most of our army."
"If you were to get rid of the goblins for her, I'm sure Aunt Serah would support your cause. I can even lead you to the caves myself."
"Though it hardly seems worth our effort to bother with such base creatures, I suppose it would go well towards furthering our popularity."
"I would free the land of these creatures, even if it is to help a farmer. Goblins are a foul abomination and horridly ugly... not that I am one to speak."
She looks a little surprised. "Oh, sorry. I thought it might be useful information for you."
"Goblins? Even Trip can kill nasty, ugly goblins! We will sneak up on them and tear out their throats, we will!"
"Goblins! Time to crush some skulls, <FirstName>! We shall revel in their destruction and win the hearts of these people, you and I!"
"You have cleared the goblin caves, or so I have heard, but you have not reported the job finished to my Aunt. I will take you to her so that you can tell her and she can postpone the vote for you."
"Great. Just follow me, like always."
"Good luck. Come speak to me if you would like a guide to take you outside the city. I will stay here until you need me."
"It is both my job and my pleasure. The keep already pays me, so I can help you for free. Where would you like to go?"

"If you're just looking for stuff to do, the Guildhall's always a good place to start. Besides, I never turn down a chance to poke my nose into my Aunt Serah's business and see what she's up to. And The Stan's always fun to talk to, too."
"The Stan is the master of the trades guild. He's unusual, but he usually all manner of crazy quests that he wants people to do for him."

"He pays pretty well, too, which is always nice. Of course, there are other guildmasters in the Guildhall, too, and then some others that are spread around the keep, so you could just explore if you wanted to."
"Right away, m'<Lord/Lady>."

"Archeologists are funny, always digging around in the dirt for something that everybody's already forgotten about. I say if we forget something happened, there's probably a good reason for it. But that's just my opinion. I'll take you there pronto."
"I'm glad we found those because I hear he had enough in store to lay a fair-sized siege. Come on, I'll take you there."

"Dwarves are so industrious. It's a shame about the air quality, though. I wouldn't be able to live a day if all there was to smell was dust and dwarves... But enough of my blather. I'll take you right there."
